articleTitle: A study of C-band 5G system interference to Radio Altimeter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: There is growing concern that potentially harmful interference from 5G communications systems in C-band could interfere to the operation of radio altimeters (RA) operating at 4.2 - 4.4 GHz. Some countries and international organizations have already taken remedial action. The minimum distance to the interferer is a measure of how close an interfering transmitter can be to a receiver without causing performance degradation. The objective of this paper is to investigate the required distance between a C-band 5G mobile base station and an aircraft when the interference power is below the thresholds of three primary coupling mechanisms: Receiver overload, desensitization, and false altitude generation.

articleTitle: Research on DDoS Attack Detection Based on Machine Learning in SDN Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The difference between Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and traditional networks is that SDN allows for flexible definition of network devices’ forwarding functions through software programming. It decouples the control plane from the forwarding plane, enabling centralized control of the entire network through a controller. This feature is both an advantage and a weakness of SDN, as the control plane is vulnerable to attacks that can result in the paralysis of the entire network, particularly when facing distributed denial-of-service attacks. Therefore, a combined KNN and SVM algorithm-based attack detection model is proposed. The model selects related five-dimensional features based on the characteristics and classification of DDoS attacks and packet header information, and then uses the SVM-KNN algorithm for feature training and classification. Simulation results show that the proposed detection algorithm has higher accuracy and lower false positive rate compared to the SVM and KNN algorithms, with relatively less detection time.

articleTitle: Construction Design and Kinematics Analysis for the Three Legs Type Gas Piping Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the current gas pipeline robots generally have a small diameter range, weak climbing ability, fewer robots to adopt to small pipe diameter, unstable control system and poor control efficiency. A small pipe diameter adaptive modular synchronous autonomous reducing gas pipeline robot with diameter of 300mm to 400mm is innovatively designed. The robot adopts a symmetrical mechanism that can realize synchronous reducer at both ends, and the tail is provided with universal joint to realize the robot modularity. A three-dimensional model of pipeline robot was established by SolidWorks, and statically analysis was carried out on the driving arm and supporting arm of gas pipeline robot. The results showed that the maximum stress of driving arm and supporting arm were 36.66MPa and 36.61MPa, and the maximum strain was 5.16×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>mm and 5.16×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>mm, all within safe limits. In addition, the dynamics analysis of straight pipe, bend pipe, reduced diameter pipe, climbing ability and traction force of prototype is carried out. The velocity of prototype in the straight pipe varies between 9mm/s, and the displacement varies 0.5mm. The actual traction force of prototype is increased by 107.12N compared with the theoretical value.

articleTitle: Automatic Reading Method for Pointer Meters Based on Improved Deeplabv3+
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In response to the problems of imprecise and poor segmentation of pointer meters by the original Deeplabv3+ algorithm in complex environments, this paper proposes an automatic meters reading method based on the improved Deeplabv3+. Firstly, the semantic segmentation algorithm Deeplabv3+ is structurally improved, including replacing the backbone network with Res-Net50, using DenseASPP instead of ASPP and adding a new coordinate feature refinement module to improve the feature extraction and the perception of edge information, so as to extract the dials and pointers of meters more accurately. The experimental results show that the improved Deeplabv3+ prompts MPA by 2.46% and MIOU by 3.59% compared with the original model. These results are better than other segmentation algorithms. Subsequently, the post-segmented image is expanded into a rectangular map by polar coordinate transformation, and the readings are completed using the distance method. It is verified that the average relative error between the adopted automatic reading algorithm and manual reading is 0.25%, meeting the accuracy requirement. The proposed automatic reading method proves its strongly potential in intelligent meter identification.

articleTitle: Airport Foreign Object Small Target Detection Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To address the current issues in the field of airport runway foreign object detection, such as small data volume, low data quality, and limited data variety, a road foreign object dataset is proposed in this paper. The dataset is created through large-scale data collection and annotation, aiming to simulate the foreign object detection scenarios on airport runways and construct a diverse and detailed road foreign object dataset. This dataset consists of 12 categories of foreign objects, including metal devices, mechanical tools, and miscellaneous items. Furthermore, the dataset proposed in this paper was trained and tested using commonly used object detection algorithms. The experimental results demonstrated the significance of preprocessing the original dataset, and the Mean Average Precision(mAP) metric of the YOLO-V5-n algorithm cited in this paper outperformed other algorithms. The road debris dataset proposed in this paper provides a valuable database for the airport runway debris detection field.

articleTitle: Research on Visualization Method for Detection Power of Guidance and Warning Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The radar power map is a representation of radar detection performance. Due to the difficulty in measuring the power indicators of the guidance and warning radar, many radar units lack objective and accurate basis for evaluating the power of the radar during the use of radar equipment. The traditional radar power map drawing mainly relies on target aircraft flight inspection (inspection) data and mathematical model calculations. This article studies the method of correcting the free space power map based on a large amount of flight data accumulated after the deployment of radar positions. A method of correcting the detection distance and elevation of guidance and warning radar based on measured data is proposed, and the calculation method of radar detection probability based on measured data is discussed. A study was conducted on the methods for digitizing power maps. It has accurately reflected the radar detection performance, providing an effective reference for the radar to exert more combat effectiveness. Finally, the effectiveness of this correction method was verified through comparison.

articleTitle: A visual recognition method for the automatic detection of distracted driving behavior based on an attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For distracted driving behavior in real driving scenarios there are problems such as complex detection backgrounds, different target scales, and weak anti-interference ability. In this paper, an improved YOLOv5 model is proposed. First, the PAN in the neck network layer of the model is modified to a Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network (BiFPN), which improves the ability of feature fusion of the model. Next, three Convolutional Block Attention Modules (CBAMs) are introduced into the detection layer to enhance the extraction of valid information from the model, and the traditional NMS is replaced with DIoU-NMS, which improves the correspondence between the generated frames and the target frames, reduces the missed detection rate of the model, and further improves the detection performance of the model. Then, a dataset containing 14 types of distracted driving was built and augmented using data augmentation to improve the generalization capability of the model. Finally, experimental results show that the improved model achieves precision and mean average precision of 91.6% and 89.2%, respectively, which are 7.5% and 1.6% higher than the original model. This demonstrates that the improved model can effectively improve the detection performance of distracted driving behavior.

articleTitle: A High PSRR Curvature Compensated Bandgap Voltage Reference for LDO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A high power supply rejection ratio (PSRR) curvature compensated bandgap voltage reference (BGR) is proposed in TSMC 0.18μm BCD process. By adopting curvature compensated technique that MOS transistor operates in subthreshold region, the temperature performance of the proposed high PSRR curvature compensated BGR is efficiently improved. The PSRR of the proposed high PSRR curvature compensated BGR is efficiently improved by adopting self-biased pre-regulator. Simulation results show that the proposed high PSRR curvature compensated BGR achieves the temperature coefficient of 2.56 ppm/°C. Output voltage variation of the proposed high PSRR curvature compensated BGR is only 69.2 μV when power supply voltage changes from 3 V to 6.5 V. The proposed high PSRR curvature compensated BGR achieves PSRRs of -131 dB, -128 dB, -92 dB, -77 dB and -57 dB at 10 Hz, 1 kHz, 100 kHz, 1 MHz and 100 MHz respectively.

articleTitle: An Improved ORB Feature Point Extraction Algorithm based on Image Enhancement and Adaptive Threshold
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In scenes with varying illumination, there can be poor quality of the captured images, resulting in feature points not being extracted or not being extracted in sufficient quantity when using the fixed-threshold ORB algorithm to extract feature points. To address this problem, an improved ORB feature point extraction algorithm is proposed. The image quality is improved using the adaptive gamma transform. According to the greyscale distribution of the image, the brightness change of the image is judged and the image is divided into three types of images: no obvious brightness change overall, brightness change overall and local brightness change. The feature point extraction is completed by adopting a global adaptive threshold or global adaptive threshold combined with a local adaptive threshold for different image types respectively. The experimental results show that the improved ORB feature point extraction algorithm can significantly increase the number of image feature points extracted with good robustness in lighting change scenes.

articleTitle: Object Detection and Counting in UAV Images Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Object detection in UAV images is an important part of intelligent traffic control. However, there are many problems such as diverse target scales, small targets and occluded targets in UAV images. To solve these problems, an improved network structure of YOLOv5s is proposed. Firstly, a decoupling detection module is introduced in the head of the network to improve the detection accuracy and speed up the convergence. Secondly, a small object detection layer was added to the original network structure and multi-scale feature fusion was performed to enhance the prediction ability of the algorithm for multi-scale objects and small objects. Finally, a pedestrian detection and counting model of aerial images based on deep convolutional network is designed to count the current crowd and vehicle traffic in the form of quantity detection. Our proposed algorithm model’s mean average precision (mAP0.5) in the publicly available VisDrone2019 dataset attains 40.3% while fulfilling the requirement of real-time detection, which is 5.9% higher than the YOLOv5 algorithm. The improved model’s detection accuracy surpasses those of other mainstream algorithms by a considerable extent.

articleTitle: Casting defect detection based on improved DETR
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Casting products are widely used in many industrial fields. Castings are prone to defects in the production process. Due to the high utilization rate of castings, the quality of castings has become the focus of industrial production. Therefore, casting defect detection is very important in the production process. This paper proposes a casting defect detection method based on improved DETR to improve detection accuracy. Firstly, multi-scale feature fusion is added in the feature extraction stage; then, the ECA-NET attention mechanism module is introduced to improve the backbone network; secondly, the attention mechanism in the Transformer module is improved by using relative position encoding; finally, in the casting data, the improved algorithm is trained and tested on the set. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the improved DETR model proposed in this paper can reach 49.6%, which is 6.3% higher than the original DETR algorithm. Compared with other mainstream target detection algorithms, the casting defect detection model proposed in this paper can effectively identify Casting defects and achieve high detection accuracy.

articleTitle: An Active Learning Model Production Method for Electric Power Inspection Image Multi-target Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of intelligent electric power inspection technology, electric power companies use UAVs, cameras, robots and other equipment for power transmission line inspections, and take a large number of inspection images. In recent years, the image multi-target detection model has been maturely applied in the intelligent inspection of electric power. The current image intelligent detection model mainly relies on a large number of image sample labels. Power companies have a small number of labeled image samples, and a large number of unlabeled. But manual data annotation is very expensive, and cost lots of time and money. Moreover, there will be certain errors in manual annotation, so it is necessary to repeat the annotation and verification to reduce the error. But this will also increase the cost. This article proposes an active learning model production method for electric power inspection image multi-target detection. We select samples for annotation according to some strategies, and select labeled samples for verification. This method can reduce the cost of sample annotation, and improve the model. productivity. Compared with the traditional random labeling strategy, our method can achieve the same accuracy with only 20% of the annotation cost. With 50% of the annotation cost, the mAP index will increase by 12%.

articleTitle: The listing price prediction of used sailboats based on LM-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the rise of sailing sports, the number of second-hand sailboats has been growing rapidly, and how to accurately and quickly assess the listing price of second-hand sailboats has become a difficult problem facing the second-hand sailboat market. In order to accurately and quickly predict the listing price of used sailboats, this paper proposes a prediction model based on LM-BP neural network, which adopts the fastest descent method and adjusts the weights and thresholds of the network by back propagation (BP). Due to the combination of the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm with the BP neural network, the model outperforms the ordinary BP neural network model. Experiments show that the model is able to predict the listing price of used sailboats well with an accuracy of 95.34%, which is significantly higher than the ordinary BP neural network. Keywords data cleaning, machine learning, LM-BP neural network, Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm.

articleTitle: PRI-based radar signal binning algorithm and simulation implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In a radar signal sorting system, sorting based on PRI features is an important part of the system, and PRI classification is generally divided into two parts, one is to determine the PRI value, and the other is to perform sequence retrieval based on PRI. This paper first describes the PRI characteristics of several typical radar signals, and then introduces in detail several classical PRI feature extraction algorithms, such as the dynamic extended correlation algorithm, the statistical histogram algorithm and the CDIF algorithm, and carries out theoretical analysis and experimental validation of these algorithms.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv5-based detection model for Mycobacterium
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In response to the time-consuming and labor-intensive traditional tuberculosis bacillus detection methods, which are prone to human error and cannot achieve real-time detection, a tuberculosis bacillus target detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv5 is proposed. The Swin Transformer Block is used to calculate global image feature similarity information using a sliding window self-attention mechanism, which is embedded in the backbone network and integrated with the local semantic information extracted by the traditional convolutional network to fully exploit the model’s feature extraction capabilities. The Bridge Attention is used to strengthen the C3 module by using multiple adjacent C3 modules as references and integrating them on the channel to highlight target edge features and suppress irrelevant background information, thereby improving the model’s feature extraction capabilities. A bidirectional feature pyramid network is used to replace the original feature fusion network, which integrates shallow network image features with deep network image features while reducing the number of parameters. The improved algorithm in this paper has increased the average accuracy by 4.72% in the tuberculosis bacillus dataset and achieved a detection speed of 41 frames/second. Under factors such as complex background and multiple small-sized tuberculosis bacillus targets, the recall rate has been increased by 2.24%, meeting the accuracy.

articleTitle: YOLO-based multi-class target detection for SAR images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The current SAR image target detection mainly focuses on single category target detection problem in single task scenario, and no research has been conducted on multi-category target detection in different scenarios. YOLO is widely used in target detection tasks because of its speed and accuracy. In this paper, the YOLOv3, YOLOv5 and YOLOv8 algorithms, which have better detection performance and are more widely used, are used to perform target detection on the SAR image multi-category target detection dataset MSAR-1.0, and the detection results are analyzed from both the SAR image multi-category target detection dataset and the YOLO algorithm.

articleTitle: A Radar Signal Sorting Algorithm Based on Improved PRI Transform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: When the traditional PRI transform algorithm is used to sort jittered signals, the algorithm will fail when the jitter is greater than 5%, and the traditional PRI transform algorithm is not ideal for sorting sinusoidal pulse sequences, slip pulse sequences, and a mixture of these three pulse sequences. Based on this, the algorithm is improved on the basis of the traditional PRI transform algorithm, combined with the expertise learned.

articleTitle: Forming Parameter Optimization based on Kriging Model and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: When optimizing the processing parameters for hydraulic forming of sheet metal, improving the process parameters based on actual experiments will increase costs, while finite element simulation will lengthen the design cycle. This study proposes a feasible solution by using a Kriging predictive surrogate model to replace the time-consuming finite element model and combining it with multi-objective genetic algorithm for parameter optimization. The optimal process parameters obtained from the simulation validation of finite element analysis prove the feasibility of this solution. This integrated approach of using machine learning and optimization algorithms is practical and promising for improving efficiency and reducing costs in the manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: Research on the Local Communication Technologies in the Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As the smart grid rapidly develops, the Internet of Things (IoT) terminals within the power system are experiencing a surge in growth, resulting in an increasing dependence on communication networks. The terminal communication access network has already exceeded voltage level limitations and now extends to a broad range of power business areas. The need to construct a reliable and efficient local power communication access network has become pressing. This article initially examines current terminal access network technologies, outlining the pros and cons of each. Subsequently, tailored local communication network solutions are proposed for various power businesses based on their specific characteristics.

articleTitle: Transformer Internal Mechanical Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Improved CEEMDAN and IMVO-HKELM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to identify the internal mechanical fault of transformer accurately and effectively, a method of transformer internal mechanical fault diagnosis based on improved complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (ICEEMDAN) and improved multi-verse optimization algorithm optimized hybrid kernel based extreme learning machine (IMVO-HKELM) is proposed. Firstly, to avoid the generation of false modal components, an improved ICEEMDAN is used to decompose the original vibration signal of the transformer. Secondly, the Pearson correlation coefficient method is used to select the modal component with the highest correlation and calculate its MFE value. Then, the MFE value is used as the feature quantity to construct the feature dataset, and the core parameters and regularization coefficients of HKELM are optimized using the spiral update and adaptive compressibility factor improved MVO. Then, the MFE value is used as the feature quantity to construct the feature dataset, and the HKELM kernel parameters and regularization coefficients are optimized by using the spiral update and adaptive compressibility factor improved MVO. Finally, the feature dataset is input into the established IMVO-HKELM model for classification and recognition. The experimental results indicate that the proposed method can accurately diagnose mechanical faults of transformer winding and iron core looseness, with a diagnostic accuracy of over 99%, and can provide certain guidance for the formulation of on-site maintenance strategies for transformers.

Author Keywords: hybrid kernel based extreme learning machine

articleTitle: GIS discharge fault diagnosis based on wavelet packet singular spectral entropy and WOA-SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To achieve high accuracy diagnosis of GIS discharge faults, this paper proposes a GIS discharge fault diagnosis method based on wavelet packet singular spectral entropy and whale optimization algorithm optimized support vector machine (WOA-SVM). First of all, this study simulates typical discharge faults of GIS through experiments, and collects ultra high frequency signals during discharge. Secondly, the wavelet packet singular spectral entropy of the discharge signal is extracted as the input for GIS discharge fault type discrimination. Then, compare the fault classification performance of three algorithms: SVM with grid search parameters, SVM with PSO parameter optimization, and WOA-SVM. Finally, the accuracy, rate of convergence and fitness curve of the three methods are compared. Experimental results show that the recognition accuracy of the proposed WOA-SVM achieves 95.48%, which is more than 3.8% higher than other comparison algorithms, and its adaptability is better and its rate of convergence is faster.

articleTitle: Traffic sign detection algorithm based on YOLOv5 combined with BIFPN and attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of autonomous driving technology and advanced assisted driving, the task of traffic sign detection is becoming more and more important. However, due to the complex scene of traffic signs and small targets, the detection accuracy is low and the false detection rate is high. For this reason, an improved YOLOv5 algorithm model is proposed. The algorithm introduces the CBAM attention mechanism module to improve the feature extraction ability of the network model in complex scenes, and integrates the bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network to achieve multi-scale feature fusion. The method is compared with the original YOLOV5, Faster-RCNN, and other classic algorithms in the field of target detection on the same data set. The detection effect is better in the scene of night vision and occlusion of the target. The mAP value of the improved YOLOv5 has increased by 2.1% to 91.6%.

articleTitle: Cloud Native Network Security Architecture Strategy under Zero Trust Scenario
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Zero Web of trust access is an IT security solution that provides secure remote access to organizational applications, data and services based on Well-defined expression access control policies. But in the cloud native scenario, the load reconfiguration strategy under the zero trust gateway and Microservices side vehicle model architecture needs to be solved urgently. Based on the understanding of the zero trust mechanism of cloud native Microservices system, this paper analyzes the genetic defects in the inherent mechanism of cloud native, especially the service governance framework mechanism, from a new perspective. These genetic defects will not disappear with the intergenerational development of mobile cloud native. Therefore, they are also known as the endogenous security common problems of cloud native. This article presents the endogenous security threats that may be introduced by security flaws such as "default information authenticity" and "ubiquitous data visibility". Guided by the theory of endogenous security in cyberspace, it proposes the idea and method of using "zero trust" to break the "default trust" and using "implicit mapping" to achieve "limited visibility" of user data to solve the common problems of cloud native endogenous security, And a new zero trust gateway architecture ecology and corresponding applicability function quantification load balancing strategy have been reconstructed. Experiments show that the zero trust architecture and quantification function proposed in this paper are progressiveness.

articleTitle: Research on robot balance based on Kalman filter algorithm and LQR controller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, the convenience brought by robots to people has been countless. During the development of the robot, the body shape of the robot is becoming slimmer, which leads to the unstable condition of the top when the lower end moves. In order to improve the accuracy and robustness of the robot, a control strategy based on Kalman filter and LQR algorithm is proposed to solve the problem. When some slender robots move, their equilibrium model is similar to inverted pendulum, which is a typical representative of nonlinear system. Therefore, in this paper, LQR controller is designed to realize its stability control. In view of the problem that the measurement noise and system state are not completely measurable in the controller design of robot balance, this paper designs a controller based on the continuous time Kalman filter and LQR control theory, which has a good effect in noise filtering and output estimation. Simulation and experimental results show that the controller is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Design of High Temperature Closed-loop Detection Circuit for Silicon Resonant Pressure Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Silicon resonant pressure sensors are the mainstream of the development of pressure sensors and have a broad application prospect in civil and military fields. At this stage, the domestic self-developed high precision silicon resonant MEMS pressure sensor has been put into stable production and application. Among them, the widest application temperature range of military-grade products can reach -55℃ to 85℃, and there is still a lot of room for improvement in the application of high temperature fields. Therefore, this paper takes the electrostatic excitation and capacitive detection method of silicon resonant MEMS pressure sensor's sensitive element as the research object and studies its high temperature closed-loop detection and control circuit. Let the silicon resonant pressure sensor can closed loop in the temperature environment of 120℃ and can be collected with high precision frequency, to meet the sensor 0.02% FS accuracy indicators.

articleTitle: Pedestrian detection based on SENet with attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Pedestrian detection is a fundamental task in computer vision with wide-ranging applications such as autonomous driving, surveillance, and human-computer interaction. The advancement of deep learning has revolutionized pedestrian detection, enabling more accurate and robust detection systems. In this study, we propose a novel approach that combines the power of SENet with the attention mechanism to improve pedestrian detection performance. We proposed the pedestrian detection technology based on the SENet attention mechanism consists of several key steps. First of all, the use of residual neural network backbone advanced features extracted from the input image; Then introduces SENet based architecture to the attention of the module, characteristic response to realign the channel direction, emphasizes the information related to the pedestrian characteristics, at the same time suppressing irrelevant details, our attention to the existing channel module modified, increase the space information learning in the feature maps, highlight the characteristics related to the target area in the figure, is helpful to keep out the pedestrian space characteristic of effective information.

articleTitle: Diffusion model for mural image inpainting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on crack detection and digital inpainting of ancient fresco cultural heritage, and proposes a method to use diffusion model for fresco inpainting. It effectively preserves the detail information of the frescoes and reduces the damage to the original frescoes in the inpainting process. Finally, a diffusion model is used to digitally repair the mural, and the repair performance is optimized by adjusting the parameters to achieve natural repair of mural cracks. The experimental results show that the model in this paper has significant advantages in the digital restoration task and provides a new effective method for the conservation and restoration of ancient frescoes. In addition, this study has important implications for the technological development in the field of mural restoration and heritage conservation, and contributes to the progress and technological innovation in related fields.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Industrial Product Design Based on Weighted Scoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The index elements of product design process are combined with the mathematical model based on the weighted scoring principle by studying the product design and elements in the process of product design. Specific in the process of product design elements listed the product evaluation content analysis of the evaluation indicators and formulate specific values, the importance of the comparison of indicators set the weighting coefficient, the establishment of mathematical model, and finally come to the scientific evaluation procedures and calculation methods, to solve the evaluation total score of the program. Through the method, the research and development focus in the process of product design could be clarified and the objective evaluation index data of product design scheme could be obtained quantitatively, which provided objective selection basis for comparing different design schemes and scheme selection. Therefore, the aims to solve the industrial product design process, clear product technology feasibility, advanced performance, economic rationality and other functions and index elements, could be relatively simple and scientific and reasonable quantitative analysis and evaluation. The method improves the design quality of products, defines the breakthrough focus of product research and development, and promotes the design scheme of industrial products to more effectively and reliably meet the expectations of customers and the needs of the market.

articleTitle: GMPPT Control of Photovoltaic Array System Based on BP-IWOA under Partial Shading
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Solar photovoltaic power generation is an ideal alternative to traditional energy sources because it is naturally rich and environmentally friendly. Under the condition of partial shading, the PV array P-V characteristic curve presents multiple peaks, namely a global maximum power point (GMPP) and several local maximum power points (LMPP). Maximum power extraction of PV array plays a crucial role in improving the efficiency of solar power generation. Compared with the traditional tracking method, when tracking the maximum power point, the local maximum power point will fall into the local maximum power point. In this paper, under the condition of partial shading, a GMPPT control algorithm based on the combination of BP neural network and IWOA improved whale algorithm for 1x4 series photovoltaic array is proposed to track the global maximum power point. BP neural network generates approximate global maximum power point. The improved whale algorithm IWOA enhances the local search capability by adding inertia factor and modifying adaptive parameters so as to find the global maximum power point GMPP quickly and accurately. In this paper, the performance difference between BP-IWOA GMPPT control algorithm and traditional WOA GMPPT control algorithm under partial shading is compared in Matlab/Simulink. The results show that compared with the traditional WOA algorithm, BP-IWOA has better tracking performance and stronger anti-interference ability under the external environment change.

articleTitle: Radar signal binning based on improved SDIF algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: When the traditional SDIF algorithm is applied to the binning of jittered signals, the jitter of the PRI leads to a cumulative dispersion phenomenon, so that the accumulated value never exceeds the detection threshold, leading to the failure of the SDIF algorithm. Based on this, the algorithm is improved on the basis of the traditional SDIF algorithm, combined with some of the literature and the expertise learnt. The experimental simulation results show that the improved SDIF algorithm has better results than the traditional SDIF algorithm in handling jitter signals.

articleTitle: Design of a Small-Type Wheeled Pipeline Robot Driven by Monocular Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the foundation of existing mature pipeline robots, a small-type pipeline robot is developed by using wheel locomotion mechanism in this paper, which is applicable to small pipelines with an inner diameter of about 120mm. The support mechanism of the proposed pipeline robot is acted by springs, similar to that of the wall-pressing pipeline robots. The waterproof probe capturing video in CCTV format is arranged on the proposed robot and then the image is converted into USB format through a converter, which is found after a lot of effort, allowing the image to be transmitted to the computer for real-time processing. In the later stage, deep learning methods capable of detecting imaging characteristics of landmarks of pipe or depth of field such as YOLOv8 are planned to be used to model the interior of the pipeline, to achieve the goal of driving the pipeline robot with vision.

articleTitle: Research on Application Ecological Architecture Technology of Digital Substation System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Empowering traditional industries with digital technology, continuously enhancing the innovation and driving force of the real economy. Digital transformation is an urgent need to promote the construction of a new power system and serve the goal of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality. With the continuous deepening of substation digitization, the focus of digitization technology has gradually shifted from building a basic digital base to building a digital application ecosystem. This article focuses on the advantages, existing problems, application ecosystem architecture, meta application definition, application card design, and page integration layout of digital application ecosystem construction. Exploring a new model for rapid deployment and integration of heterogeneous applications, as well as full lifecycle operation and management of applications, with the aim of continuously improving the intelligent operation and maintenance management capabilities of substation equipment, and enhancing the digital expression capabilities of equipment.

articleTitle: Road Target Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to address the issues that the YOLOv5 network structure encounters in road target detection, such as low accuracy in identifying small targets at long distance, limited precision due to environmental factors, and insufficient understanding of complex road information, this article proposes a road object detection algorithm based on an improved Yolov5 and designed a new Yolov5 network model - FRM-Yolov5.The improved algorithm consists of three parts. Firstly, the Fasternet network is used to replace the original backbone network, and the RepGFPN is used to replace the neck network. Both have optimized network structures to enhance the extraction of feature information. Finally, the Mish activation function is used to replace the original SiLU activation function to improve the nonlinear expression ability of the network and enhance the generalization of the network model. By applying the improved network and the original network to the COCO2017 dataset for comparative experiments, the experimental results show that the mAP value of the improved algorithm reached 68%, a 2.5% improvement compared to the original network.

articleTitle: Decomposition Model of Wind Power Gear Fault Signal Based on IGWO-VMD Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In wind power generation systems, gears are frequently faulty components, and their failure rate accounts for a very high proportion of wind turbine failures. Fault diagnosis of wind turbine gears is beneficial for timely maintenance and can effectively reduce economic losses. This article utilizes an improved parameter adaptive optimization variational mode decomposition (VMD) method to decompose gear vibration signals and construct a fault feature vector set. By comparing VMD and Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) for decomposing multiple fault vibration signals of gears, it has been proven that VMD has higher decomposition accuracy. The parameters of VMD were optimized using the improved grey wolf optimization algorithm (IGWO). Through comparative experiments, it was verified that the IGWO algorithm has better optimization efficiency. Finally, through an example, it was verified that the gear fault diagnosis model based on IGWO-VMD has good recognition performance for different wear levels of gears.

articleTitle: A LLM-Based Simulation Scenario Aided Generation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the simulation training system, the generation of simulation scenarios is a basic problem that needs to be studied. Firstly, expounds on the technical characteristics of LLM and knowledge graph; then structurally describe the simulation scenario related content, and build scenario knowledge graph; according to the characteristics of scenario aided generation, a simulation scenario generation method based on LLM is proposed, which uses prompt to fuse knowledge graph and LLM, next, the implementation steps of this method were elaborated; finally, the specific application proves that the method proposed in this paper is a good reference for the generation of simulation scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on the Power IoT System based on FSK Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the design of a FSK communication system that operates on the licensed spectrum of 230MHz, specifically tailored for power applications. The system incorporates advanced techniques to improve its performance and efficiency.One key aspect is the utilization of Viterbi decoding at the receiver end, which enables the extraction of soft information from the received signals. This soft information provides enhanced reliability and accuracy in data decoding, leading to improved overall system performance. To further enhance the system's performance, turbo coding is employed. In terms of frame structure design, this paper proposes a FSK communication system that supports multiple frequency access points. This allows for efficient utilization of available spectrum resources and facilitates seamless integration with various local power services. Additionally, a non-scheduling mechanism is implemented to enable flexible and dynamic access to the communication channel without requiring centralized coordination.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Algorithm of Roundness Measurement Data Based on Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Roundness is one of the important accuracy indicators of rotating parts such as shafts, which directly affects the fit, rotation accuracy and service life of components. Accurate roundness error evaluation provides a reliable guarantee for improving the machining accuracy and assembly accuracy of parts. A variety of methods for evaluating roundness measurement data have been proposed at home and abroad, such as the typical pseudo-incremental algorithm and search algorithm. In this paper, the adaptive genetic algorithm is used to solve this problem, which can automatically change the crossover probability and genetic probability according to the value of the fitness function of the individual, thereby ensuring that the individual with excellent performance can be passed on to the next generation, with high speed and high calculation accuracy. Advantages, the algorithm in this paper is implemented by MATLAB software, and finally the verification process of the algorithm is completed with measurement example data.

articleTitle: Research on path planning for mobile robots based on improved A-star algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A-star algorithm, as A-star commonly used in the traditional path planning algorithm, has a good performance in the static map. The idea of optimization is mainly around the enlightening function, search neighborhood, curve smoothing and using two-way A-star algorithm to improve the computational efficiency of the algorithm. In simulation experiments using the modified A-star algorithm, the experimental results show that the modified A-star algorithm is better than the traditional A-star algorithm in the number of search points, path length and running time, and the planned path is smoother. Finally, the improved A-star algorithm is applied to the wheeled robot in the real indoor environment to verify the feasibility of the improved A-star algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on the cooperative optimized operation of power system source-grid-load-storage based on Gurobi mathematical programming
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The world is facing the problems of continuous growth of energy demand and a deteriorating climate environment, and the construction of clean energy systems has become an important trend in the future energy field. In recent years, the scale of wind power and photovoltaic power generation on the grid in China has been expanding, which increases the operating pressure of the power system. The integrated operation of a power system can coordinate and control the complementary power-side and flexible load-side interaction, which has important value for the sustainable development of energy systems. Based on this, this paper firstly establishes a Gurobi mathematical planning-based power system source-grid-load-storage cooperative operation optimization model under the dual carbon objective. Secondly, the system integration cost and unit output is solved by three scenarios. The results show that the source-grid load-storage coordination optimization model proposed in this paper can improve the system operation economy and new energy consumption capacity to a certain extent, and verify the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: A feature fusion-based malicious code detection strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Traditional malicious code detection techniques have the problem of low detection accuracy and inefficiency due to their weak feature representation. For this reason. We propose a feature fusion-based malicious code detection method. The improved ONG and malicious code detection method based on the combination of multiple N-values of ONG is able to mine highly expressive malicious code feature sequences and improve the detection capability of malicious code. We introduce the feature extraction process of ONG. Firstly, we use the disassembly tool to obtain the assembly code of the detected file. The .text opcode is extracted from it. Combined with the generation of multiple N-value ONG sequences, the more valuable feature sequences are filtered out by using the information gain feature selection algorithm, and the KNN and RF classification algorithms are used to classify the ONG feature sequences with different N-values separately for malicious code classification training, and finally the ONG is combined and the final feature sequence is formed by combining ONGs and feature selection. Through the performance test, the proposed multi-N-value ONG combination strategy outperforms both the bytecode N-gram sequence features and the single-N-value ONG in terms of the accuracy of malicious code classification.

articleTitle: Fuzzy sliding mode controller for rocket pitching channel with input constraint
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper aims to study and analyze the attitude control problems of the rocket pitching channel during boosting phase. Firstly, a linearization control model was established for the pitching channel of a rocket based on the linear perturbation method. Secondly, a fuzzy sliding mode controller was designed for the pitching channel of a rocket projectile considering the constraint rudder deviation based on linear sliding surface, auxiliary system, and fuzzy control system. Finally, the Lyapunov stability theory was used to verify the stability of the designed control strategy, and the effectiveness of the control scheme was verified through digital simulation.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Lightweight Technology for Digital Twin Models of Complex Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As their complexity and size grow, digital twin models need help with performance challenges, including sluggish processing and poor transmission efficiency. In order to do this, this research suggests an efficient edge-folding-based approach for mesh models. By adopting the triangular grid area as the weight and boundary restriction and using the quadratic error metric matrix's prediction and correction model to perform quick calculations and optimize the grid model, this approach considers the local peculiarities of the grid model. According to experimental findings, the algorithm can produce more precise simplified models of complicated equipment and significantly raise the quality of simplified digital twin system models. The study findings presented in this work provide detailed guidance for developing and using the digital twin system and aid in resolving issues related to model data transfer and WebGL based visualization performance.

articleTitle: Transforming Automated Customer Service Responses Using ChatGLM Model: A Case Study of Expressway Toll Station Information System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This article presents a case study on using the ChatGLM model to transform automated customer service responses in an expressway toll station system. The traditional methods are impractical for millions of daily inquiries, leading to robotic responses. The ChatGLM model enhances dialogue capabilities by providing accurate and informative responses, trained on a large dataset of customer service conversations. The article discusses voice question answering challenges in toll booths and potential improvements through ongoing research. The proposed intelligent voice recognition system offers benefits like understanding natural language queries, context understanding, adaptability, and multilingual support. The methodology describes the GPT model architecture and fine tuning for the toll station system. The experiments outline the toll station assistant system development, including voice input, NLP-based task processing, and text-to-voice synthesis. The fine-tuned ChatGLM model's process and evaluation results demonstrate its effectiveness compared to baseline models. In conclusion, the ChatGLM model significantly enhances the toll station voice assistant response service.

articleTitle: A Positioning Method for Pavers and Compactors Under Non-Satellite Positioning Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Being aimed at the problem of relative positioning between pavers and rollers in non-satellite environments such as tunnels during highway construction, a method of relative positioning between machines based on laser radar is proposed. Firstly, on the basis of the problem modeling analysis, the overall scheme design is performed, and the radar data segmentation, data fitting, and pose calculation methods based on the reflector are studied. Also, the test platform is constructed and tested in the laboratory environment. The test results show that the method can effectively realize the relative positioning between dissimilar devices, and the positioning accuracy can comply with the requirements of practical applications.

articleTitle: Some Thoughts on Using Artificial Intelligence to Improve Data Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, massive multi-modal data continues to accumulate and precipitate, how to efficiently use rich data resources, improve data quality, and enhance data empowerment has become a key and challenging issue facing all fields. This paper aims to improve the data quality by using artificial intelligence to study the abnormal data processing methods in the field of communication network. The research focuses on how to locate data outliers and identify noisy data to provide protection for multi-source data aggregation; On the basis of obtaining the location of the missing value of the data, how to accurately and automatically fill the necessary data to maintain data integrity; How to accurately calibrate noisy data on the basis of knowing that the data deviates from the normal state to ensure that the abnormal data is handled correctly.

articleTitle: Research on acquisition method of robotic shot blasting process knowledge based on PCA-rough sets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, the derusting of ship deck has been replaced by the low-efficiency, serious pollution, and backward manual hand-held grinder grinding to the high-intelligence,high-efficiency,and environmental-friendly deck shot blasting robot shot blasting. However, due to the different requirements for derusting grades, not all parts need deep cleaning. Excessive blasting will not only slow down the working speed, but also increase the consumption of shot materials. Choosing a reasonable shot blasting process for shot blasting robots can improve the quality of shot blasting. Improve and reduce production costs. Therefore, this paper proposes a shot blasting process data acquisition method based on principal component analysis-rough set, which is used to guide the robot shot blasting. First, select the target data set from the robot shot blasting process database, check and preprocess the selected target data set; use principal component analysis to reduce the dimensionality of the deck shot blasting multi-source heterogeneous data, and construct a decision table Attribute, sample attribute parameter selection, establishment of decision table and value reduction algorithm based on decision matrix to remove redundant condition attributes, explore the influence of equipment parameters, operating specifications, environmental conditions, etc. on the rust removal level, and obtain shot blasting process knowledge. Knowledge has important guiding significance for improving the efficiency of shot blasting robots and reducing costs.

articleTitle: A Method for Transforming PDMS and CREO 3D Models Based on Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve inconvenience of crossing platform model data extrapolation in engineering design software, the model and data format of common design software Plant Design Management system(PDMS) and CREO were studied, and the data composition of rvm file in PDMS platform and stp file in CREO platform were analyzed, Besides, the MongoDB database was established. And in order to contain complete model information, the 3D engineering data standard and the 3D engineering data format compatible with multiple platforms were designed, which is defined as AOS format, Then, a representation method for the model object class and the connection relationship between objects were designed, which can fully describe the 3D design model information of the project. Meanwhile, develop a data standard conversion interface to complete the bidirectional conversion of PDMS platform data to CREO and the inverse conversion. Through deployment in actual projects, it has been demonstrated that the established 3D engineering data standards and conversion interface models have high conversion efficiency, and the information push is accurate, data packet loss is low, which can effectively solve the problem of crossing platform transmission barriers for 3D models.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of Artificial Intelligence on Social Public Opinion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In today's information network age, the traditional social public opinion has turned into a social network public opinion form,the traditional artificial monitoring has been unable to adapt to the era of social public opinion governance, the existence of artificial intelligence replaced artificial public opinion monitoring function, This paper through the analysis of the positive and negative impact of social public opinion governance, points out that the artificial intelligence to social public opinion model analysis, emphasizes the social public opinion of artificial intelligence management is incomplete,and the person who possessed with more professional and comprehensive ability combining with artificial intelligence can be better governance social public opinion, and respect the value of life.

articleTitle: Modeling Research on Structured Processing Algorithm for Power Business Work Orders Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: China's power enterprises use mature information storage technology in information construction. Since the implementation of the 95598 power supply service hotline, a large amount of real business data has been accumulated in the customer service systems of various enterprises. However, enterprises only use traditional data processing methods to obtain indicators such as manual service rate and satisfaction, making it difficult to discover hidden business rules in the data and even more difficult to abstract mathematical models with business characteristics. Data mining can extract useful information from massive amounts of data and construct descriptive or predictive models to help enterprises solve practical problems and make correct judgments and decisions. Research the application technology of power system work order analysis based on artificial intelligence, solve the problem that 95598 work orders have weak ability to support professional management, form the AI structured processing and model training module for power business work orders, and realize the integration application of unstructured single data and structured data.

articleTitle: Study on the stability of air traffic control radar radome under wind Load
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Wind load is one of the main loads on the air traffic control radar radome. Wind load can affect the strength and stability of the radome, and indirectly affect the use of the air traffic control radar antenna, thereby affecting the duty task of the air traffic control radar. The wind load research of the air traffic control radar radome is one of the important links in its design. This article uses the finite element analysis software ANSYS to establish a finite element model of the radar radome and conducts simulation calculations under wind loads. The calculation results indicate that the designed radar radome meets the safety requirements for wind resistance, and the simulated data can also provide data support for practical engineering fields.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Sensitive Information Control Based on Power Internet of Things Assets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the presence of a large number of intelligent devices in the power grid IoT, the IoT terminals in the power grid exhibit characteristics such as intelligence, networking, and interactivity, often deployed in uncontrolled environments, resulting in high difficulty in control and high risk of unauthorized access and violation control. Moreover, at the beginning of the design of sensitive information collection systems for power IoT terminals, most of them did not consider corresponding security protection mechanisms, which makes them very susceptible to attacks and exploitation by hackers, leading to incomplete information collection, sensitive information leakage, and other abnormalities. Therefore, for institutions such as the power grid that have a large number of IoT devices and some other network assets, a fast and accurate GO language based high concurrency scanning tool for internet assets; Research device fingerprint collection methods for ports, and integrate fingerprints through YAML to achieve efficient and accurate device fingerprint collection; Research Big data visualization display based on Echarts, realize data analysis visualization, and help relevant personnel quickly locate risk assets; Research the precise risk warning and notification function based on containerized deployment to help relevant personnel quickly carry out relevant defense. This technology greatly saves manpower, material costs, and economic losses, and reduces the possibility of network attacks on the power IoT network.

articleTitle: Design of Low-offset and High-speed CTLE Cell based on 65 nm Process
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the SMIC 65nm CMOS process, a high-speed continuous-time linear equalization (CTLE) with the proposed direct-current offset cancellation (DCOC) circuit is designed, error amplifier-capacitor filter and current adder are added basing on the traditional DCOC circuit, which improves offset cancellation ability under ensuring stability. Mean value of the offset voltage at output is suppressed to 17 μV with 1.1 mV standard deviation. Operating at 1.2V power supply, the design achieves 7 GHz bandwidth with 4.7 dB peak gain, 51 dB loop gain, 72 ° phase margin, -52 dB DC gain and 1.9 mW power consumption, DCOC circuit only contributes 0.1 mW.

articleTitle: Research and Practice on Operator Package governance Based on Package Similarity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: There are numerous packages in the telecommunications operation support system, which not only brings significant operational difficulties to enterprises, but also makes it difficult for customers to choose from a large number of packages. How to manage operator packages has always been one of the difficult issues for operators. This article introduces a quantitative analysis of package similarity, using the core parameters of the package as the feature parameters calculated by the similarity model. At the same time, it innovatively introduces classification model learning weights to achieve more accurate similarity calculation between packages, According to the similarity of packages, combined with business rules and judgments, remove some similar homogeneous packages.Through practice, it has been proven that the model can effectively identify homogeneous packages and achieve the governance goal of removing homogeneous packages without affecting enterprise revenue.

articleTitle: Risk Coupling Analysis of Transmission Line Power Accident based on N-K Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to deal with the hidden danger of risk coupling scientifically in the process of transmission line power accident and fill in the lack of research on electrical risk coupling, this paper applies TF-IDF algorithm to extract keywords through statistical analysis of 263 cases of electrical injury accidents in China, combined with the accident cause model, the risk factors of electrical injury accidents is divided into four aspects : personnel factors, equipment factors, management factors and environmental factors. The risk coupling mechanism and coupling mode in risk coupling theory are explained. The N-K model is used to construct the risk coupling model of electrical injury, and the risk degree of risk coupling effect is quantified. The results show that the more factors involved in risk coupling, the greater the quantitative value of coupling risk. In the coupling of three risk factors, the risk value of personnel-management-environment coupling is the largest, and the biggest coupling risk value is personnel-management coupling in the two-risk coupling. Therefore, in the process of electrical production, a management risk control mechanism should be established to reduce the coupling risk effect, especially to reduce the risk of personnel-management coupling and personnel-management-environment coupling.

articleTitle: Dataset construction and algorithm application based on hair follicle detection results
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Hair disorders are currently highly prevalent and gradually becoming younger, directly damaging the image of the individual, so diagnosis and treatment of hair disorders is necessary and urgent. At this stage, hair follicle detection techniques have been highly imaged as a routine method of diagnosis. In response to the fact that there are currently no publicly available datasets that can apply the results of hair follicle detection to computer vision tasks, this paper, in cooperation with Sichuan Daisen Biotechnology Co. Ltd. obtains some of the hair follicle detection images accumulated during its medical consultations, and provides a method of constructing a dataset that can be applied to assisted diagnosis of hair follicle detection, and constructs two datasets that can be applied to the vast majority of deep learning algorithms. And the detection application is realized on some existing classical object detection algorithms. The feasibility of the dataset is verified by comparing and analyzing the detection results with the classical dataset PASCAL VOC2007, which effectively improves the diagnostic work of doctors for hair follicle detection.

articleTitle: A Two State Adaptive Ant Colony Algorithm Framework for Solving Multi-objective Optimization Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of ant colony algorithm in solving multi-objective optimization problems and enhance the universality of the algorithm, this paper introduces cloud model theory and proposes an adaptive ant colony algorithm framework between "development" and "exploration". In the algorithm, the concept of cloud model dominant solution is introduced, and pheromone update mechanism, pheromone status evaluation mechanism and the determination mechanism of cloud model dominant solution are constructed. At the same time, a multi-objective adaptive mechanism based on cloud model has been constructed, enabling the algorithm to maintain a balance between exploring unknown feasible solutions and developing known Pareto optimal solutions, thereby improving the search efficiency of the algorithm. In the simulation comparative experiment of solving multi-objective traveling salesman problem, the experimental results show that the framework proposed in this paper is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Research on power system stability control data storage and management technology based on blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the problems existing in the current stability control system control mode, such as low work efficiency, difficulty in tracing the process, difficulty in online supervision and data updating, the blockchain technology is embedded in the stability control system control framework. Utilizing the advantages of blockchain technology, the data information involved in each stage of the stability control system control process is blockized, encapsulated and distributed, making the key data information traceable and tamper proof, thus realizing the storage and sharing of stability control data. In this paper, the technical architecture, network architecture and storage architecture of the stability control chain are designed to realize the storage management of the stability control data on the chain, which improves the intelligent and automatic level of the stability control system control.

articleTitle: Precise positioning technology of UAV based on lidar
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the current inspection mode of high-voltage transmission lines in power grid, it is mainly through manual hand-held instruments or naked eyes to inspect facility defects, which is not only difficult and intense, but also inefficient, and cannot adapt to the safe operation and development of modern power grid. In recent years, with the rapid development of unmanned aerial vehicle technology and related sensor technology, unmanned aerial vehicle has been widely used in electric inspection. Therefore, a real-time RTK and SLAM localization scheme based on lidar is proposed. The location information of UAV can be stably obtained both indoors and outdoors, ensuring the safe operation of the UAV.

articleTitle: Electric Field Simulation of Stator Winding End with Heat Pipe Cooling for Large Horizontal Generators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To solve the difficulty of heat dissipation at the stator winding end of a tubular hydro-generator, this paper proposes a heat pipe cooling solution for the tubular generator set. By laying heat pipes on the outer insulating surface of the stator winding end, efficient heat dissipation can be achieved, which is beneficial for reducing the temperature rise of the stator winding end, improving the axial temperature distribution uniformity of the stator winding, and thus enhancing the operation reliability of the generator. Ensuring the insulation safety of the stator winding end while meeting the cooling performance is the key to the implementation of this new cooling structure. In this paper, an electric field simulation model of the generator stator winding end is established, and the influence of heat pipe cross-sectional shape, geometric dimensions, and layout topology on the electric field distributions of the air gap and the surface of anti-corona layers at the stator winding end is obtained. An optimized design scheme for the heat pipe cooling solution is provided, which serves as a basis for the design of the heat pipe cooling structure for tubular generator sets.

articleTitle: Research and application of zero trust based secure access to the power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The massive power grid IoT terminals are characterized by intelligence, networking, and interactivity, and are often deployed in uncontrolled environments. These massive IoT terminals are widely interconnected and interact, making it difficult to achieve low-cost terminal access authentication and efficient secure interaction technology. In order to comprehensively improve the comprehensive defense capability of the power Internet of Things security and address the deficiencies and deficiencies of current power Internet of Things terminal security protection, terminal authentication mechanism, and dynamic access control, this article first studies the power Internet of Things and zero trust security mechanism, and then conducts in-depth research on key technologies such as power Internet of Things terminal trustworthiness, power Internet of Things terminal layer device access authentication, and power Internet of Things dynamic access control, Propose a zero trust based security protection framework for the power Internet of Things, and combine it with the zero trust security protection system. In the actual environment of the power Internet of Things, study the security protection architecture of the power Internet of Things, and achieve the security protection requirements of the perception layer, network layer, and application layer of the power Internet of Things. In the scenario of secure access to distributed power sources, method validation is carried out. In response to common flooding attacks, packet attacks, and malicious code attacks, the zero trust architecture based secure access method to the power Internet of Things can effectively detect and timely block it, avoiding attackers from controlling the power Internet of Things terminals to carry out network attacks on the smart grid and triggering power grid security incidents.

articleTitle: Image classification of small sample grape leaves based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Grapes are common fruits in life, but grape varieties are diverse, mainly by the naked eye to distinguish, in order to solve the problem of low efficiency of artificial differentiation, using deep learning to achieve classification of a variety of grape varieties, constructing a CNN-GLS model, taking five kinds of grape leaf images as the research object. By learning and extracting the feature information of grape leaves through multi-layer convolutional network, adding a data enhancement layer to the network to reduce model overfitting, using the Leaky Relu activation function to avoid aliasing in the gradient direction, adding flat layer Flatten "flattening" convolutional pooled data, and one-dimensional multi-dimensional data, Adam optimizer can improve sparse gradient performance, reduce training time, and improve network efficiency. The experimental results show that the accuracy of small sample grape leaf species recognition based on convolutional neural network CNN-GLS model is 95.13%, and the model has robustness and high generalization ability, which is of great significance for the taxonomic identification of plants.

articleTitle: Enterprise energy efficiency analysis based on subjective and objective weighting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the data of various statistical statements can't reflect the production and operation status of enterprises timely and effectively, the energy efficiency level index system is constructed based on the subjective and objective comprehensive weighting method by combining the data of electric quantity, electric charge, power factor and load. On this basis, the energy efficiency level of enterprises is analyzed and the energy efficiency level of enterprises is classified. By comparing the energy efficiency levels of typical enterprises, the ecological circle of "typical enterprises + small and medium-sized enterprises" is constructed, and corresponding energy efficiency management and optimization development strategies are formulated.

articleTitle: Motion control of hydraulic telescopic boom crane
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper discusses the modeling and motion controller design of telescopic boom crane. Through inverse kinematics, the Cartesian coordinates of the crane boom tip are converted to the actuator space. At the same time, the trajectory of the actuator is used as the input of the drive system. The hydraulic drive system uses a fuzzy PID controller to track the position of the actuator. The simulation results show that the controller has a good control effect. This method can be extended to other boom cranes.

Author Keywords: telescopic boom crane inverse kinematics fuzzy PID

articleTitle: A non-code division multi-user detection method for forward links with low signal-to-noise ratio
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Satellite communication links often need to meet the performance requirements of multi-user concurrency, which improves the communication efficiency but also introduces the interference between users. Affected by electromagnetic space loss, the user power received by the receiver may be different, which requires the receiver to have certain anti-interference capability, that is, to ensure the detection probability of low-power users(LP-Users) submerged by noise and other high-power users(HP-Users). In this paper, the reasons for the decrease of detection probability are analyzed, and a new detection method is proposed, that is, every time the detection is guaranteed under the condition of single user as far as possible, so as to weaken the interference of other users on the currently searching user.
