Finally, by comparing the simulation performance before and after the algorithm improvement, it is concluded that the method presented in this paper can improve the acquisition probability of LP-Users without being restricted by the spread ratio.

articleTitle: Improved Neural Network LADRC for Sensorless Control of PMSM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) has been widely used in permanent magnet synchronous motor control because of its superior interference feedforward compensation performance since it was proposed. However, due to the inaccuracy of the motor parameter estimation and its change with the working state, when the motor is running at low speed, the fixed parameter ADRC strikes a balance between dynamic performance and noise filtering, so it will produce excessive speed fluctuations. To this end, the neural network is introduced into the linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC), and four states are selected as the inputs of the neural network, and two output values are assigned to the LADRC as system parameters. The use of the dynamic parameters can improve the robustness of the control system, reduce steady-state speed fluctuations, and reduce reliability problems in complex scenarios. Then the effectiveness of the proposed control method is verified by simulation. Finally, the proposed control method is applied to the sensorless control of the high frequency square wave injection mode of permanent magnet synchronous motor, which reduces the speed fluctuation at low speed.

articleTitle: An new image histogram regularization based on probabilistic transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Usually, when contour enhancement is performed on an image, it is necessary to emphasize the image contour by widening the gray level gap or highlighting sensitive gray levels. The common method is to use the histogram regularization method, but this method will face the problem that the transformed histogram cannot obtain a high overlap with the target histogram, which leads to the insufficient effect of contour enhancement. In this paper, we propose a forced probabilistic histogram transformation method, which uses probabilistic transformation to achieve a forced mapping of the same gray level to different gray levels of the target histogram, effectively mapping the gray levels into the restricted interval while obtaining a higher degree of overlap. The effectiveness of the forced probability histogram regularization algorithm be derived from the experiments of actual contour enhancement and the comparison of SML (Single Mapping Law) histogram regularization method in terms of overlap and time complication .

articleTitle: Vision-assisted Compliant Alignment Method for Large Component
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Large component alignment is the final manufacturing phase of large-scale products such as aircraft and spacecraft, directly affecting the final performance and quality of these products. In order to improve the assembly efficiency and first pass yield, this paper proposed a vision-assisted compliant alignment method for large component, taking advantage of vision measurement and compliant assembly to realize adaptive alignment. Firstly, the principle of vision-assisted compliant alignment is elaborated. Secondly, the key enablers are presented, including vision-based rough pose measurement method and force/torque-based pose adjustment decision network. Finally, an alignment experiment is conducted to prove the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Evaluation System for Industrial Risk and Safety Emergency Management Based on AHP-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This study aims to develop a risk and safety emergency management performance evaluation system suitable for industrial operation through the prevention and control of potential crises and risks during the operation of industrial machinery, combined with the AHP-BP neural network. This system effectively evaluates the risk response and management capabilities of industrial robots, promotes industrial transformation and improvement, and provides strong support and guarantee for industrial emergency risk and safety management decision-making.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of improved license plate segmentation and recognition algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: License plate recognition system is an important part of information collection in intelligent transportation system, so it is of great practical significance to study it deeply. In this paper, the character segmentation and recognition algorithm of license plate after positioning correction are studied. Aiming at the problems such as the low accuracy of license plate recognition, slow speed of traditional license plate recognition algorithm for complex environment. Aiming at the special license plate or the license plate with stained border, the license plate is divided into seven equal parts by column, and an improved border removal algorithm is proposed, which only deals with the special column of the license plate. In the character segmentation algorithm, the improved projection method is used to realize the accurate segmentation of the disconnected characters. The principle of the algorithm is simple and the processing time is fast. In the character recognition algorithm, the correlation matching method based on Manhattan distance is adopted. The experimental test results show that the algorithm in this paper has improved the accuracy and speed of license plate recognition.

articleTitle: Research on association matching analysis technology between power grid faults and meteorological disaster information
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the expansion of the power grid scale and the increasing complexity of the power grid structure, meteorological factors are increasingly important in the influence of the range and frequency of the power grid. This paper aims to study the association matching analysis technology of power grid faults and meteorological disaster information, in order to improve the prediction and response capabilities of power grid faults and meteorological disaster information. Firstly, the definition, characteristics, and impact of power grid faults and meteorological disasters were introduced, as well as existing relevant research results. Then, an indicator evaluation system for comprehensive monitoring, warning, and warning of the external operating environment of the power grid was constructed based on historical power grid faults and operational information. Finally, the association matching analysis technology was elaborated in detail, including data preprocessing, association rule analysis, fault model construction, and association accident plans pushing.

articleTitle: Implicit Modeling Network of Human Critical Points based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Human pose estimation tasks require the use of visual cues and anatomical relationships between joints to locate key points, but convolutional neural network-based approaches have difficulty focusing on remote contextual cues and modeling the dependencies between distant joints. In this paper, we propose an implicit modeling method based on an attention mechanism to implicitly model the constraint relationships between key points by computing feature correlations between joints through multi-stage iterations. To address the problem that the network may weaken the invisible key points during training, a focal loss function is used to make the network more focused on complex key points. The experimental results show that the implicit modeling network can improve the performance of the human posture estimation network, and the algorithm with the HRNet network as the backbone network can improve the performance of the human posture estimation network in the MPII dataset, the benchmark dataset for human posture estimation, compared with the original network. The accuracy of the algorithm with HRNet network as the backbone was improved by 1.7% compared to the original network.

articleTitle: Simulation model of arteriovenous fistula and stenosis detection based on Windkessel theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Non-invasive monitoring is an effective method to improve the monitoring level of arteriovenous fistula. In this study, a simulation model of the arteriovenous fistula is established based on the extracorporeal circulation imitation system, which provides a repeatable experimental platform for subsequent research on arteriovenous fistula stenosis. Based on this model, simulation experiments with different degrees of stenosis are completed, and the photoplethysmography (PPG) sensor is used to collect stenosis signals. The analysis of the collected signals processing shows that as the stenosis becomes more serious, the high-frequency components in the PPG signals’ spectrum become clearer. In this work, establishing the simulation model and applying the PPG sensor provides a new idea for the non-invasive monitoring of arteriovenous fistula.

articleTitle: Hover Control Design for Brushed Motor Quadcopter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper presents the design and control of a quadcopter that is specifically engineered to hover at one meter. The quadcopter design utilizes the mechanics behind the brushed motor, contrary to the common brushless motors. We used the proposed quadrotor physical model properties to define the mathematical expressions of the model. To achieve stable hovering at one meter, we developed a control algorithm based on a proportional-integral-derivative (PID) controller. The controller adjusts the thrust of each motor in real-time to maintain the desired altitude. A comparison is done with a proportional-integral (PI) and proportional-derivative (PD) controller to validate the best controller for the system. Simulation in Simulink validated the system design and showed that the quadrotor achieved stable hover flight, even in the presence of minor wind gusts. In conclusion, we have designed and developed a quadcopter that can hover at a fixed altitude of one meter with high accuracy and stability. A system with such ability is a critical requirement for many applications that require precise hovering, such as aerial photography, surveying, and inspection.

articleTitle: Design of indoor temperature and humidity monitoring system based on Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to achieve real-time monitoring, control and intelligent management of indoor temperature and humidity, an indoor temperature and humidity controller system is designed. The DHT11 is used to collect the indoor temperature and humidity data, and then the Kalman filter algorithm is used to process the data to derive the optimal estimation result, and the optimal estimation result is displayed on the cell phone APP, while the execution components can be controlled remotely to change the indoor temperature and humidity environment. In addition, the user can set the alarm threshold of temperature and humidity through the keyboard module of the microcontroller. If the collected temperature and humidity data is not within the normal range, the STM32 microcontroller will drive the buzzer to issue an audible alarm. Users can monitor the temperature and humidity data collected by the sensor in real time through the LCD1602 and use the relay to control the actuating components to change the temperature and humidity environment of the room. This design can complete real-time monitoring and control of indoor temperature and humidity data in a stable and reliable manner, and at the same time, the measured results are more accurate after data processing by Kalman filtering algorithm. In addition, this system is convenient, easy to implement, stable and reliable, and can be widely applied to the intelligent management of indoor temperature and humidity environment.

articleTitle: Edge computing task offloading and resource allocation policies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In moving edge computing system, the unloading strategy of users will affect the energy consumption and computing cost, and then affect the benefits of users. However, most studies do not consider the effect of user uninstallation strategy and resource request strategy on benefits in random distribution of edge servers. To solve this problem, a computational offloading and resource allocation strategy based on improved dual auction algorithm is proposed. First, the interaction process between users and edge servers is modeled as Stackelberg game, and it is proved that there is a unique Nash equilibrium point in this game. Secondly, the uninstallation intention of users for different servers and the amount of computing resource requests are calculated, and the users and the optimal server are auctioned. Finally, the traversal method is used to exchange users and servers in part of the last round of auction, so as to achieve the optimal overall benefit of the system. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce the system loss.

articleTitle: Low cost and robust control for brushless DC motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Brushless DC motor (BLDCM) is widely used in aviation, automobile and other fields, due to its high efficiency, reliable, low noise and low maintenance. However, controlling BLDCM is challenging because of its nonlinear, time-varying, and uncertain characteristics. To improve the control performance of motor speed, an adaptive PI controller based on fuzzy logic is proposed in this paper. The principle and mathematical model of BLDCM is analyzed, and a new algorithm that modifies motor speed by combining classic PID and fuzzy PID using a switch module is introduced to realise low cost and robust control. The effectiveness and superiority of the controller are verified by simulation experiment.

articleTitle: A Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Motion Planner for Human-Robot Collaboration in Pathological Experiments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper presents a robotic motion planner to address the collision issue between the robotic arm and human arm in human-robot collaboration tasks. We transform the motion planning problem of the robotic arm into a Markov decision process based on real pathological experimental scenarios, by constructing models such as state space, action space, and reward function, to achieve motion planning for a pre-designed task. The planner extracts the position information of the human arm from existing trajectory data sets to generate a real-time hand model, which serves as an obstacle in the collaborative workspace. Based on the reinforcement learning algorithm, the robotic arm adjusts its behavior towards the hand obstacle through a self-designed reward function. Meanwhile, we modify the output action policy of the motion planner by adding OU-Noise to enhance the robotic arm’s exploration capability of the overall space. We deploy the pybullet simulation environment on an Ubuntu20 system and conduct multiple experiments using the CR5 collaborative robotic arm model. Experimental results show that this method can efficiently and accurately plan the motion trajectory of the robotic arm in complex collaboration scenarios, achieving avoidance behavior towards the human arm.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation by Fusing Color and Depth Information for Region Merging
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: When there are occlusions and shadows in the image, it is difficult for the traditional algorithm to extract the object contour accurately by using only the appearance information. In this paper, an improved Mean-shift algorithm is used to obtain the initial set of oversegmentation subregions. Then the color contrast of the subregions is calculated, the depth contrast is calculated in the depth image, and the fusion contrast is obtained by a dynamic weighted curve fitting method. Finally, the seed regions of the target and background are automatically selected according to the depth information, and MSRM algorithm is used to complete the image segmentation based on the principle of maximum similarity. Experiments on NYU-V2 and Middlebury database show that compared with the current general algorithm, the proposed algorithm can improve the accuracy of segmentation and improve the visual effect of segmentation images.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Fusion Residual Dense Dehazing Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A multi-scale fusion residual dense dehazing network is proposed to address the problems of high model complexity and incomplete dehazing in most existing end-to-end dehazing algorithms. In the residual dense block (DSRB), the feature information is extracted by increasing the convolutional kernel perceptual field using smooth dilation convolution, and the continuous memory mechanism is formed by means of dense jump connections to improve the characterization ability of the network. DWC and PWC convolution are used to generate channel attention and pixel attention mechanisms to fuse shallow features and deep features at each scale and focus on target features adaptively. Finally, the method of this paper is tested on the SOTS test set of RESIDE, and the results show that the model complexity of this paper’s method is low, and the PSNR and SSIM metrics are improved, and the visual effect is good.

articleTitle: Research Status and Prospect of Industrial Internet Based on Cloud Computing and the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The industrial Internet fully combines the new generation of information technology with industrial fields. Through the comprehensive interconnection of cross equipment, cross system, cross plant area, cross region and cross industry, it can realize the optimal allocation of various production and service resources in a wider range, more efficient and more accurate, and promote the industrial economy from scale and cost advantages to quality and benefit advantages. This paper focuses on the status quo, key technologies and application prospects of industrial Internet.The combination of cloud computing and the Internet of Things provides strong support for the industrial Internet. Cloud computing provides the tools and services needed to build IoT applications, helping to achieve efficient and accurate IoT based applications. This paper summarizes and analyzes the research and development trends in this field, and puts forward suggestions for further construction and deployment of industrial Internet networks.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Government Investment on Economic Growth in Xinjiang Based on Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of government investment and private investment on economic development in Xinjiang based on data mining techniques, analyses the current situation of government investment and economic development based on theoretical foundations, and analyses the contribution of government investment to economic growth from an empirical perspective. The findings show that government investment has a positive impact on economic growth in the long-term equilibrium relationship, and private investment has a driving effect on economic growth in the short-term fluctuation relationship, and the econometric model effectively illustrates that the benign coordination of government investment and private investment can promote the economic transformation and upgrading.

articleTitle: Research on Gear Surface Defect Detection Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper takes gear as the research object and develops a gear surface defect detection system based on machine vision to identify gear surface defects. The purpose is to replace manual detection of gear surface defects with machine vision, thereby improving the reliability and efficiency of detection, reducing errors and subjective factors. A set of image acquisition systems that can achieve high precision, efficiency, and intelligence is designed. In order to detect gear surface defects, the gear image is subjected to gray-scale conversion, preprocessing, region of interest labeling and interception, binarization, morphology processing, and feature extraction to achieve the extraction of gear surface defect detection. The experiment results indicate that the proposed method has a certain degree of reliability in detecting gear surface defects. It provides a reference for detecting surface defects of similar gears.

articleTitle: Six-GraphSecurity: Industrial Internet Intrusion Detection Based On Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The rapid development of the industrial internet has presented significant security challenges for the current industrial system, and intrusion detection has emerged as an effective solution. However, the current state of industrial internet intrusion detection is not promising, necessitating the introduction of new and more effective methods. Graph Neural Network (GNN) technology has witnessed continuous advancement and successful applications in network security, exhibiting potential in anomaly detection and malicious traffic identification. Applying GNN to the field of network security has become a prominent concern. Nevertheless, the existing solutions for intrusion detection based on GNN remain limited, leaving ample room for development and innovation in the industrial internet intrusion detection domain. This paper proposes Six-GraphSecurity, an intrusion detection scheme based on GNN. It employs graph representation of network flows and leverages a six-layer GraphSage model for classifying industrial internet dataset. Experimental results demonstrate the superior accuracy of the GNN compared to traditional Machine Learning (ML) algorithms.

articleTitle: Depth Image Restoration Algorithm Based on Bilateral Filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Depth images are also known as distance images, whose grey scale values characterise the distance of an object, and depth images play a key role in 3D scene reconstruction, virtual viewpoint synthesis, and 3D video technology. Depth image has a variety of acquisition methods, among which, active ranging uses the device itself to emit energy to complete the acquisition of depth information, with fast and cheap characteristics, but the depth image produced by active ranging equipment in the edges of the object and the occlusion region often produces voids, which is not conducive to the subsequent research applications. In this paper, we propose a depth image quality enhancement algorithm that combines the colour image and the depth image to improve the confidence of bilateral filter repair by evaluating the weights of the pixels in the neighbourhood of the pixel to be repaired, and the experimental results show that the method achieves a better repair effect for the voids in the original depth image.

articleTitle: Research on the application of collection system data in the analysis of incorrect wiring of smart energy meters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Using various curve data of the electricity information collection system, combined with the nature of the load and field test data, study the metering parameters of the smart energy meter under the fault state. Analyze the conclusion of wrong wiring, correct the wrong power, put forward reliable preventive measures to ensure the accurate operation of the electric energy metering device, and effectively avoid power errors.

articleTitle: A BDS/GPS Combined RTK Positioning Algorithm based on Partial Ambiguity Fixing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: An Improved Partial Ambiguity Resolution Algorithm is proposed to address the issues of misjudgment or omission in subset selection and threshold setting of traditional partial ambiguity resolution algorithms. The algorithm performs an initial screening based on elevation angle and signal-to-noise ratio, and then progressively eliminates the largest variance ambiguity according to the success rate estimation until the success rate exceeds the predetermined threshold, achieving optimal subset selection. This algorithm effectively reduces the search space of ambiguity and improves the fix rate and reliability of ambiguity fixing. Experimental results show that the improved PAR algorithm has a significantly higher fix rate compared to existing algorithms, with a maximum static positioning fix rate of 95.0%. The horizontal and vertical accuracy are improved by 30%~45% and 60%~75%, respectively. Furthermore, the algorithm can effectively reduce the initialization time of RTK positioning and accelerate the convergence speed of the solution.

articleTitle: An ontology-based machine tool serving framework in industrial Internet environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The number of machine tools in the industrial internet environment is large, and manufacturing process will generate a large amount of data. To realize the networked, service-based control and collaborative sharing of machine tools is an application trend in the industrial Internet. However, the problems including data heterogeneity, how to provide production services provide, and privacy protection need to be solved first. In this paper, we propose an ontology-based machine tool serving framework (OBMSF) to solve the above issues. First, an ontology and a data storage model are used to solve the data heterogeneity problem while protecting the data privacy in the industrial internet. Then, through semantic inference rules, a production service for the monitoring of abnormalities in the machine tool operation is provided. Finally, the privacy protection problem is solved by a privacy protection program that dynamically changes the privacy rules of the machine tools in the industrial Internet.

articleTitle: Research and development of the 3D printing system for clinical diagnosis of jaw cyst
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A jaw cyst is a common disease in the oral cavity, and the treatment is usually carried out by surgery. We study the clinical significance of converting 2D CT images of jaw cysts into 3D physical models. Currently, surgeons rely solely on 2D images to determine the shape and size of cysts before surgical intervention, which can lead to inaccuracies in diagnosis and surgical planning. The article describes the development of a system that utilizes the Marching Cubes algorithm for 3D reconstruction and STL format output, allowing for the creation of 3D printed models. The system is tested using CT data from patients with jaw cysts, and the resulting physical models could accurately depict the cysts in a 1:1 ratio. This technology is a new approach to diagnosing and treating jaw cysts in oral medicine and has significant potential to improve patient understanding and surgical planning.

articleTitle: Vertex Magic Reducible Edge Labeling Algorithm for Random Graphs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this study, we combine insights from edge-magic labeling and reducible coloring to present a new concept: vertex magic reducible edge labeling. We've devised an algorithm that uses gradual adjustments and optimization techniques to assign labels to a graph's edges. Edges linked to vertices of the same degree have identical labeling sums. The labeling sequence corresponds to a series of natural numbers, with the highest number equaling the graph's edge count. With this methodology, we achieved labeling for up to 100 vertices and derived several theorems and proofs through data analysis.

articleTitle: Design of LSTM Prediction Model for Slurry Balance Shield Slurry Level
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Accurate prediction of slurry level is crucial in maintaining stable earth pressure balance during tunnel excavation. However, traditional conventional methods for slurry level prediction struggle to accurately forecast and control the level due to the high noise, hysteresis, and nonlinearity associated with slurry level data. To address this prediction challenge, this paper proposes a slurry level prediction model based on Pearson correlation coefficient lag calculation and LSTM neural network. Firstly, the lag of slurry relevant parameters is calculated using Pearson correlation coefficient, which is then used as the prediction step for the LSTM neural network model to forecast the slurry level. Finally, a dataset collected from the Beiheng project is used to evaluate the proposed model. Experimental results demonstrate that the approach significantly improves the prediction performance of slurry level compared to common shield prediction methods, with a maximum reduction of 88.11% in mean square error and 49.72% in mean absolute error compared to other models.

articleTitle: A Keyword Extraction Method for Traditional Chinese Medicine Constitution Identification Based on Batch Data Hybrid Sampling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Keyword extraction for traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) constitution identification refers to using keyword extraction methods to extract critical symptoms from task corpora to achieve the TCM constitution identification task. In this paper, we constructed a dataset for keyword extraction in TCM constitution identification and implemented keyword extraction using sequence labeling methods. However, we discovered an issue of uneven category distribution during the keyword extraction process, which affected the model's performance. To address this problem, we propose a model training method based on batch data hybrid sampling algorithm. This method divides the training dataset into several batches. It strategically balances the ratio of common and rare category data within each batch, achieving an even distribution of data categories within each training batch and reducing the impact of insufficient learning on rare categories by the model. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method improves the performance of keyword extraction for TCM constitution identification, with an average F1 score improvement of 4.29% for rare category keyword extraction.

articleTitle: SDN Network Reliability Guarantee Mechanism based on Network Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The dynamic and programmable nature of SDN technology has brought challenges to network reliability, resulting in a reduction of network reliability. To solve this problem, according to the characteristics of network architecture in SDN environment, this paper designs a network reliability assurance architecture. The architecture includes three types of equipment: control center, SDN controller and repeater. In order to solve the problems of heavy load of the controller, low efficiency of message sending and receiving, and the network reliability reduction caused by the extension of the flow table distribution time, a controller reliability guarantee mechanism is designed. In order to guarantee the quality of service of network services and reduce the problem that the reliability guarantee leads to the reduction of the utilization of network resources, the reliability guarantee mechanism of the transponder is designed. From the two dimensions of the mechanism in the timeliness of exception discovery and the performance of exception handling, it is verified that the network reliability guarantee mechanism proposed in this paper has better improved the reliability of the network and ensured the safe and stable operation of network services.

articleTitle: Ophthalmic diagnostic assistance system based on deep learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Ophthalmic diseases have globally afflicted visual functioning and activities of daily living for many people. Among these vision-threatening disorders, glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, and cataracts constitute major causes of visual deficit. Although preventative diagnosis could have precluded the development of vision loss in many individuals, suitable screening methods for early detection of ophthalmic diseases have not yet been explored. This study presents an ophthalmic disease diagnostic assistance system powered by deep learning algorithms, which can identify common ophthalmic conditions by interfacing with the Wechat Applet. The performance metrics of the proposed assistance system are a response speed of 20ms and an accuracy of 88.7% in diagnosing three common ocular diseases.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile energy storage Technology Based on Improving Distributed Energy Consumption in Substation Area
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper mainly carries out the research on mobile energy storage technology based on improving distributed energy consumption in substation area, explores the optimal configuration and operation characteristics of clean energy and energy storage systems such as distributed photovoltaic, and develops mobile energy storage devices that are suitable for low photovoltaic, and have the functions of off grid emergency power supply, and off grid switching, which can achieve real-time source load storage power balance of the distribution network in low voltage substation area, achieve power time shift, and ensure the stable and reliable operation of the distribution network in the substation area.

articleTitle: WSNs Node Localization Algorithm based on Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to achieve high-precision positioning of non ranging DV-Hop positioning algorithms in WSNs, an improved DV-Hop positioning algorithm combining multiple communication radii with IWOA algorithm is proposed.The initial WOA population is unevenly distributed, the Rate of convergence is slow, the global search ability is weak, and it is easy to fall into local optimization problems.Firstly, Tent is used to initialize the population to make the initial solution more evenly distributed in the solution space. At the same time, adaptive inertia weight coefficients are introduced to improve the nonlinear convergence factor, balancing the global search and local search capabilities. The Cauchy mutation strategy is used to enhance the algorithm's ability to jump out of local optima.Finally, the improved whale optimization algorithm will replace the least squares method in solving the coordinates of the nodes to be located. The MATLAB simulation results have shown that the improved algorithm can greatly improve node positioning accuracy in a randomly distributed environent.

articleTitle: Web Front-end Development based on Flask Architecture for Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, owing to the rapid advancements in science, technology and digital innovations, the digitalization of technical supervision for electric energy metering devices has been making steady progress. We aim to explore in depth the application of image recognition function under the Flask architecture in the Web front-end. The Web front-end has the potential to leverage on-site image recognition, background model reasoning, and image upload scoring functional modules for enabling technical personnel to digitally oversee and control on-site operations, thereby comprehensively enhancing the efficiency and precision of technical supervision for electric energy metering devices, and aiding in the supervision of power safety. In this paper, we provide a useful reference for the application of image recognition in the digital technical monitoring of electric energy metering devices on the Web front-end and points the direction for further development in the future.

articleTitle: Attribute-based Certificateless Aggregation Signcryption Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The advanced measurement system is a complete network that measures, counts, stores, analyzes and uses the user's power information. In the system, smart meters need to send the user's power data to the control center in real time, and the data security and transmission efficiency are extremely high during the transmission process. Therefore, in order to ensure the safe and fast transmission of data, this paper studies the protection methods of user identity and electricity data in the system: aiming at the huge workload problem caused by the correctness of the ciphertext in turn before the control center designs, an attribute-based certificateless aggregation sign-off scheme is proposed, and the security verification in the data transmission process is passed,and the amount of calculation in the transmission process is reduced and the transmission efficiency is improved.

articleTitle: Deep State Space Visual Prediction for Robotic Manipulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: We propose a deep state space visual prediction framework for robotic manipulation. A circumstance is concerned when part of the robotic arm is clipped out of the image captured by the camera hung above. A two-stage Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) architecture is suggested to perform state extracting and image restoring, and a Sparse Bayesian Learning (SBL) approach is applied to identify the State Space equation representing the dynamics between the state generated by the former Networks and the position of the robotic arm’s end-effector. The proposed framework is able to predict the future robotic arm’s location in a image-based fashion by incorporating the current robotics image and future trajectory of the end-effector’s position in a large prediction time period when most part of the robotic arm is unseen by the camera. The experiments operated on UR5 (6-DOF robotic arm) show a satisfying prediction results measured by IoU (Intersection over Union) of 0.947 in a robotic arm manipulation which predicts from the start position to the end position.

articleTitle: A Method for Micro-seismic Source Location Based on Principal Component Analysis and Spatial Discrete Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the large errors and complex models associated with conventional microseismic source localization, a simple and effective micro-seismic location method is proposed. Based on the analysis results of the direct solution of the four-four combination positioning method, the spatial distribution characteristic parameters of the source scattered points closely related to the positioning error are extracted: the spatial weighted centroid distance, the number of adjacent points in space, the adjacent distance sum, etc., and the analysis model of the source dispersion degree is established. The above characteristic parameters of the source spatial distribution are extracted by the principal component analysis method, and the comprehensive evaluation and ranking results of the source dispersion degree are obtained; the final result is obtained by the centroid method. The engineering data shows that the final three-component positioning errors of the source are 6.255 m, 4.552 m, and 2.010 m, respectively, and the spatial distance is 7.993 m. The method is simple and effective, and has certain practical application significance.

articleTitle: An Infrared Target Detection Algorithm Based on Spatiotemporal Total Variation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To solve the false alarm problem caused by the complex background clutters in infrared small target detection, a novel detection method based on spatial-temporal total variation regularization is proposed. First, the input infrared image sequence is transformed into spatial-temporal infrared patch-tensor (STIPT) structure. This step can associate the spatial and temporal information by using the high dimensional data structures in the tensor domain. Then, weighted Schatten p-norm and spatial-temporal total variation regularization are incorporated to recover the low-rank background component for preserving the strong edges and corners, which can improve the accuracy of sparse target component recovery. Finally, the STIPT structure can be transformed into infrared image sequence by inverse operator, and an adaptive threshold segmentation is used to obtain the real target. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method can greatly improve the accuracy and efficiency of target detection with complex background clutters.

Author Keywords: low-rank component and sparse component recovery

articleTitle: Research on Service Quality Evaluation of Rural E-commerce Logistics Based on SERVQUAL-LSQ Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This study takes rural e-commerce consumers as the theme, combines the actual situation of rural e-commerce logistics, adopts SERVQUAL model and LSQ model to evaluate the quality of the whole process of logistics service. Through SPSS for its reliability and validity analysis, thus eliminating or retain index, using the factor analysis method to calculate the weight of each index. Finally, taking Suning Tesco as an example, the expected and actual service quality of its e-commerce logistics service in rural areas is scored, the logistics service quality is calculated by the service gap model, and the improvement suggestions are given according to the evaluation results, so as to promote the development of enterprises in rural areas.

articleTitle: A telemetry range analysis method based on target attitude
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In flight test, due to the continuous attitude change of the target to be measured and controlled, the direction of the communication antenna will also change, resulting in the change of the intensity of the received signal of the ground TT&C station, which will affect the operating range of the target. Since the accurate antenna pattern is not easy to obtain, only antenna beam width and main lobe gain can be obtained in general. Therefore, it is necessary to fit the approximate gain of each direction of the main lobe according to the finite parameters. In this paper, a telemetry range analysis method based on target attitude is designed. Using the existing target antenna parameters, the intersection angle gain of the antenna main lobe is obtained by coordinate transformation and quadratic polynomial fitting. Combined with real-time attitude data, it is accurately determined whether the measurement and control link can be established between the target and the ground station effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Typhoon Path Prediction Based on the Wide & Deep Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The activity path of a typhoon is influenced by various factors, and traditional trajectory prediction methods have difficulty improving the accuracy of typhoon activity path prediction. To address the issue of low accuracy in typhoon path prediction, a heterogeneous fusion model based on the WIDE & DEEP framework, called ST_LSTM and ConvGRU, is proposed to predict the 24-hour typhoon activity path. By fusing two-dimensional and three-dimensional temporal features, the model aims to improve the accuracy of typhoon path prediction. Experimental results show that this method effectively achieves the heterogeneous fusion of temporal features in typhoon path prediction, outperforming other deep learning methods for typhoon path prediction and further enhancing the accuracy of typhoon activity path prediction.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network-based Fish Recognition Algorithm on Intelligent Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The species recognition algorithms have been paid more attentions recently. In this paper a convolutional neural network-based fish recognition algorithm was proposed on intelligent vehicles. The algorithm determines the designated vehicle position with the fixed-point position recognition function, and removes it to the corresponding position through the intelligent control system. Finally, to meet the computational requirements and accuracy in the embedded situation, a lightweight convolutional neural network was designed to complete fish identification. This method was trained on a Large Scale Fish Dataset (LSFD), and the accuracy rate reached above 97.2%. This algorithm has certain research significance in intelligent vehicles and fish recognition area.

articleTitle: Bring old mural images to life
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This research focuses on the detection and digital restoration of cracks in ancient frescoes using a CNN model. The proposed method effectively preserves the detailed information of the frescoes and minimizes damage to the original artwork during the restoration process. The CNN model is employed to digitally repair the mural and optimize the repair performance by adjusting the parameters to achieve a natural-looking restoration of any cracks. Experimental results demonstrate the notable advantages of the proposed model in the digital restoration of murals and provide an effective method for the conservation and preservation of ancient frescoes. This study also holds significant implications for the technological advancements in the field of mural restoration and heritage conservation, contributing to progress and innovation in related areas.

articleTitle: Research on Time Synchronization Monitoring Technology of Nuclear Power Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper studies the time synchronization and monitoring technology of nuclear power plants, discusses the demand and importance of time synchronization for the operation of nuclear power plants, and analyzes the current status and existing problems of time synchronization technology for nuclear power plants. In response to these problems, a nuclear power plant autonomous time service system architecture based on high-precision clock and clock monitoring mechanism is proposed, and further analysis and demonstration will help improve the stability of nuclear power plant system operation and ensure nuclear safety.

articleTitle: Prediction of Remaining Useful Life of Rolling Bearings based on Transformer Encoder
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Real-time condition detection and remaining useful life (RUL) prediction of rolling bearings is the goal and inevitable trend to achieve intelligent management and maintenance of rotating machinery and equipment. In this paper, a data-driven algorithm for RUL prediction of rolling bearings is proposed. The algorithm first extracts the bandpass energy values of the rolling bearing spectrum in both horizontal and vertical directions as features; then proposes a transformer encoder-based prediction of the health indicator (HI) value, which will determine the final predicted RUL value; finally uses the gated cyclic unit as a decoder to make an accurate prediction of the bearing health status indicator. The RUL value is then calculated using linear regression. Finally, experiments on the PHM2012 dataset and comparisons with other methods show the superiority of the proposed algorithm in terms of performance.

articleTitle: Enhancement Method for Fog-degraded Images based on Multi-scale Retinex and Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To improve the image defogging effect, a foggy image enhancement method based on multi-scale retinex(MSR) and wavelet transform is proposed. First, the H, I and S component is obtained by converting foggy image to HIS space. Secondly, the logarithmic transformation is used to improve areas with low saturation for better visual effect. Then, a new I component is acquired by combining MSR and wavelet transform to process I component. Finally, the fogless image is obtained by HIS inverse transformation. The experimental results indicate that that the algorithm proposed achieves good defogging effects both subjectively and objectively.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Audio-visual Equipment Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to meet people’s pursuit for culture and art, more and more audio-visual equipment is involved to provide colorful experience for the audience, which increases the probability of performance accident consequently. Risk evaluation of equipment is essential to find the risk factors and reduce the frequency of hazardous events. A method of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, integrated Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) as well as Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) is adopted here. Firstly, FMEA is used to identify the effective failure modes of audio-visual equipment, which may lead to some hazardous events. Secondly, the failure modes identified are used as the inputs of the fault trees to calculate the probability of the event. Lastly, the fuzzy evaluation method is introduced to construct an assessment model of audio-visual equipment. The results of simulation show the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Green Shop Scheduling Optimization Based on Improved Grey Wolf Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-objective optimization model with the objectives of shop floor completion time, machine load and total energy consumption is developed to address the inefficiency of solving the multi-objective flexible job shop scheduling problem. A flexible job shop scheduling method is designed by combining the gray wolf algorithm and the non-dominated ranking genetic algorithm. Complex numerical coding increases population diversity, and the gray wolf method uses non-dominated sorting and crowding degree notions in population updates to make it more suitable to multi-objective issues. The algorithm’s ability to perform global searches is improved by using random search coefficients. Testing using benchmark arithmetic instances reveals the modified gray wolf algorithm's effectiveness. The algorithm can optimize the multi-objective workshop problem and discover the best solution with fewer iterations.

articleTitle: Research on Fusion Processing Method for UAV Oblique Photogrammetry and LiDAR data in Coastal Zones
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Considering that traditional UAV aerial photogrammetry cannot solve the problem of few (no) control surveys on coastal zones and island reefs, this paper puts forward a high-accuracy measurement method and data processing flow for coastal zones and island reefs through the UAV equipped with oblique photogrammetry, POS and LiDAR equipment. In other words, the absolute positioning of oblique photogrammetry is achieved by registering the high-accuracy LiDAR point cloud data with the encrypted point clouds resolved by oblique photogrammetry, providing technical bases for 3D reconstruction and 4D product production of coastal zones and island reefs. Meanwhile, this paper also puts forward the bundle block adjustment method for coastal zones based on the Lie group, solving the problem of the incalculability of coastal zone surveys due to a large amount of water falling. Finally, the flight test is conducted in Shandong province for fusion processing of the oblique images and the point cloud data obtained from the oblique photography and LiDAR equipment equipped by a six-rotor UAV, verifying the feasibility of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A Bandgap Voltage Reference with Self-buffered Loop Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A bandgap voltage reference (BGR) with self-buffered loop control technology is proposed in TSMC 0.18μm BCD process. By adopting self-buffered loop control technology, the proposed BGR achieves these performances including excellent stability, lower temperature coefficient and fast loop adjustment speed. Simulation results show that temperature coefficient of the proposed BGR is only 1.807 ppm/°C when temperature is changed from -45 °C to 125 °C. The proposed BGR achieves power supply rejection ratios (PSRRs) of -80.45 dB, -80.45 dB, -79.72 dB, -67.76 dB, -47.89 dB, -29.5 dB and -24 dB at 1 Hz, 10 Hz, 100 Hz, 1 kHz, 10 kHz, 100 kHz, 1 MHz respectively.

articleTitle: Clustering-Based Signal Detection for MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a clustering-based signal detection method for multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. Inspired by the phenomenon that the received signals are divided into clusters within block-fading channels, we establish a system constrained Gaussian mixture model (SCGMM) for signal detection, in which the expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm is exploited to calculate the parameters and the a posteriori probabilities (APPs). The quality of the SCGMM clustering depends heavily on the selection of initial centroids. To obtain reliable initial centroids, we design an initialization algorithm, which can reduce the estimated error of the linear minimum-mean-squared-error (LMMSE) estimator and accelerate convergence of the SCGMM clustering. The simulation results show that the bit-error-rate (BER) performance of the proposed method can approach the performance with perfect channel state information (CSI) in the high signal-to-noise (SNR) regions.

articleTitle: Transformer Internal Mechanical Fault Diagnosis Based on Multi-characteristic Indicators and the IBA-HKELM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To address the problem that the accuracy of transformer internal mechanical fault identification is insufficient to meet the field inspection demand, a transformer internal mechanical fault diagnosis method based on multi-feature value and improved bat algorithm optimized hybrid kernel based extreme learning machine (IBA-HKELM) is proposed. Firstly, the time domain features, frequency domain features and multi-scale fuzzy entropy features of the original transformer vibration signal are extracted. Secondly, the time domain features, frequency domain features and fuzzy entropy features are fused and the multi-feature index data set is constructed by using parallel superposition. Then, the key kernel parameters and inertia coefficients of the HKELM are optimized by using the IBA to construct the IBA-HKELM. Finally, the constructed multi-feature index dataset is imported into the proposed IBA-HKELM diagnostic model for identification, and the internal mechanical fault diagnosis of transformers with high diagnostic accuracy is achieved. The experimental results show that the proposed method can accurately diagnose the mechanical faults of transformer windings and cores with a diagnostic accuracy of 98.75%, which can provide assistance in the formulation of transformer field maintenance strategies.

Author Keywords: hybrid kernel based extreme learning machine

articleTitle: Design of Communication Network and Safety Protection Scheme for Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Virtual power plant aggregates flexible resources for regulation, which can improve the flexible regulation ability of the power system. However, with the development of virtual power plant, the scale and access mode of resources have changed significantly. The existing communication network and security protection schemes are not effective enough to support the safe and reliable access of large-scale heterogeneous resources. In this paper, the communication and security problems encountered by virtual power plant from the perspective of scheduling are sorted out. The communication network schemes of virtual power plant are designed to support multi time scale scheduling, the security schemes of virtual power plant that follows the power security protection specifications are designed. Finally, the key technologies for enhancing communication performance and security protection are proposed.

articleTitle: Unbalanced Underwater Sonar Image Target Detection Based on Weak Contrast Feature Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Underwater target identification, as a core technology for underwater unmanned detection, plays a crucial role in both military and civilian applications. As the only signal that can be transmitted over long distances underwater, acoustic waves are widely used in current underwater target identification. Sonar image, as a graphical representation of acoustic waves, is also gradually be-coming a current research hotspot. The existing sonar im-age target detection framework is mainly based on optical image target detection model, which is difficult to solve the following two problems, first, the high similarity between target foreground and background in sonar image, the feature extraction process is very easy to lose the target feature information, especially the small target feature information, and second, the problem of model overfitting caused by small samples of sonar image data set and imbalance of sample data for each category given. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes an unbalanced small target underwater sonar image target detection model based on YOLOv5 model with weak contrast feature enhancement network, firstly, by adaptively enhancing large, medium and small target features in the feature extraction and feature fusion stages to improve the accuracy of the model in the target regression detection stage, and then by improving the loss function to make the model associate the originally mutually The model is then improved by improving the loss function so that the model can be associated with the localization and classification tasks that are originally independent of each other, while reducing the impact of the model due to the imbalance between positive and negative samples. The experimental results show that the detection performance of the proposed improved model reaches 96.9% on the existing public dataset UATD, which is a significant improvement in recognition accuracy compared to the advanced 2-baseline model.

articleTitle: Fixed pattern noise removal for solar images using a Self-Supervised Destriping Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of Complementary metal oxide semi-conductor (CMOS) fabrication process, CMOS Image Sensor (CIS) is widely used in solar high-resolution observations. However, the images often suffer from obvious fixed pattern noise (FPN). In this paper, we present a innovative technique framework for the FPN correction. Firstly, the noise-free image is roughly estimated by the 1D Guided filtering method and used to make up the training pairs. Secondly, a Multi-scale Attention Convolution Neural Network (MA-CNN) is proposed to achieve single image correction. In the neural network, a Multi-scale Convolution (MS-Conv) unit is designed to extract complementary FPN features at different scales. Thirdly, the channel attention mechanism is added to the network, which can more accurately separate the FPN from the image. Finally, the visual effect and quantitative assessment demonstrate that the proposed method has a better performance compared with the traditional methods.

articleTitle: Research on Industrial Equipment Fault Warning Based on AO-SOM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the intelligence level of industrial equipment is also constantly improving, and the requirements for equipment status monitoring have become more stringent. The traditional fault warning methods based on expert databases and single monitoring measurements are no longer applicable to current equipment, so a fault warning method based on AO-SOM neural network is proposed. Firstly, the neuron vector of the SOM (Self Organizing Map) neural network was optimized using the AO (Aquila Optimizer) algorithm, and an early warning neural network was established using the optimized neurons; Secondly, by combining early warning neural networks with adaptive thresholds based on confidence intervals, a warning model based on adaptive thresholds is constructed; Finally, the feasibility of the model is verified by the actual running data validation of a CNC grinder in a factory in Shandong Province. The experimental results show that the AO-SOM neural network has more accurate warning effect compared to traditional SOM neural networks and SOM neural networks based on PSO algorithm. At the same time, the early warning model based on adaptive thresholds compensates for the shortcomings of fixed thresholds in practical applications, and more accurately predicts the occurrence of equipment failures, which is of great significance for the maintenance and upkeep of industrial equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Heterogeneous Redundancy Emergency Decision Strategy based on Hierarchical State Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to meet the functional safety requirements of unmanned driving technology at critical moments under decision failure, a heterogeneous redundant emergency decision-making strategy based on hierarchical state machine is proposed. According to the centralized architecture of the whole vehicle domain, the overall redundancy hierarchical state machine model is constructed from the data end, the decision-making end to the execution end, the two-heartbeat communication detection mechanism based on the time wheel is used as the boundary condition for the main redundant decision state transfer, and the AEBS control model of redundant decision is established using RSS theory, and finally the overall hierarchical decision state machine architecture is processed recursively. Taking a pure electric bus as the test object, from the main decision start operation to the redundant decision intervention after failure, the hierarchical decomposition verification is carried out according to different trigger conditions. The results show that the overall time efficiency of redundant decision-making from trigger initiation to policy control execution is only 0.79% compared with the main decision, and the double-heartbeat timeout threshold can effectively trigger the precise intervention of redundant decision-making at 160ms, so that the decision security is further improved and computing resources are rationally utilized. At the same time, the hierarchical state machine theory can realize the circulation of various working modes of the vehicle after the failure of the main decision, so that the sub-states can be reasonably transferred in the redundancy decision, so as to meet the design feasibility and effectiveness requirements of the redundancy function.

articleTitle: Design and application of photovoltaic microgrid in green warehouse
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Solar photovoltaic power generation as a most suitable way to combine with green warehouse for renewable energy utilization, however, it is not widely used in practice. The main reason is that the energy utilization of photovoltaic power generation is not fully considered at the beginning of the architectural design, as well as the unreasonable design of microgrid system cannot bring sufficient economic benefits. The traditional fragmented and scattered area integrated distributed PV power generation system mainly adopts DC/AC inverter grid connection, the current and voltage at the inverter input is unstable, which makes a large grid loss during grid connection, thus affecting the overall utilization rate of PV power generation system. In order to improve the utilization rate of PV in green warehouse and optimize its energy consumption mode, this paper takes the proposed green warehouse in Tongren as an innovative research object, innovatively applies PV microgrid in green warehouse, makes specific design of PV microgrid system in green warehouse, and finally conducts simulation analysis on the operation of PV microgrid.

articleTitle: The Design of Postgresql’s Security Protection Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Postgresql is a widely used open source database, but it pays more attention to its general functions and performance, and the data security protection measures are seriously insufficient. Aiming at the problems of database security protection such as authentication password leakage and malicious copy of data, this paper studies postgresql database security protection mechanism and the data encryption, including database security protection model, authentication password leakage protection mechanism and underlying data malicious copy protection mechanism. Postgresql’s security protection scheme designed in this paper can break through the key problems such as abnormal data identification in high confusion mode, homomorphic migration of data operation and performance balance, and focus on solving two sensitive data leakage hidden dangers, such as fake login and copy & restore datas, so as to provide security for data storage.

articleTitle: Joint Gain-Phase Errors Calibration and 2D DOA Estimation for Sparse Planar UAV Arrays
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the gradual development of the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm electronic reconnaissance research, multi-target localization of UAV arrays has become a research hotspot. In UAV arrays, the uniform linear array (ULA) of multiple UAVs equivalents can only estimate 1D DOA, and the swarm of UAV of approximately the same height can be equivalent to the arbitrary sparse planar array (SPA), which can be used to directly estimate 2D DOA and locate the radiation source. But due to the complexity of the planar array, the estimation and calibration of the gain-phase errors face challenges such as multi-target overlap, limited accuracy owing to suboptimal convergence, and high computational cost. In this paper, for the problem that subspace-based and sparse reconstruction-based DOA methods are difficult to balance the degree of freedom (DOF) and estimation performance, we use the decoupled atomic norm minimization (DANM) method to avoid spectral peak search combined with the gradient descent method to minimize the gain-phase errors. The method can simultaneously estimate the errors and the initial 2D DOA and further accurately estimate the 2D DOA based on the error calibration. The simulations are evaluated using a representative coprime planar array (CPPA) and the results show that the method can achieve higher estimation accuracy compared to the other mainstream methods.

articleTitle: Blockchain combined with Federated Learning technology research
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Federated learning has garnered significant attention and been widely explored in various domains as a means to train models while preserving data privacy through local data sharing. However, several challenges persist within federated learning, including privacy information leakage, the reliability of uploading model parameters to servers, and communication costs. In recent years, researchers and practitioners have made substantial progress in addressing these challenges by integrating blockchain technology with federated learning. This fusion has resulted in enhanced data privacy protection, incentivized data sharing, and improved verification accountability. To provide a comprehensive understanding of the latest research findings and development trends in blockchain-based federated learning, this review paper aims to present a detailed analysis. Initially, the paper examines the inherent issues of federated learning and identifies potential security and privacy attacks that blockchain can mitigate. Furthermore, the distinct characteristics of blockchain-based federated learning are elucidated. Subsequently, an in-depth exploration of state-of-the-art approaches in blockchain-based federated learning is conducted, focusing on security and privacy mechanisms, recording and rewarding systems, as well as verification and accountability protocols. Additionally, the paper delves into pertinent topics concerning the integration of blockchain and federated learning, addressing associated challenges and considerations.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Business Model and Application Scenario Analysis Based on Large-Scale Renewable Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As the core support for the development of renewable energy, energy storage is conducive to improving the power grid ability to consume and control a high proportion of renewable energy. It improves the penetration rate of renewable energy. In this paper, the typical application mode of energy storage from the power generation side, the power grid side, and the user side is analyzed first. Then, the economic comprehensive evaluation method of the energy storage full life cycle is put forward, which uses the internal rate of return method to evaluate the energy storage system investment subject in the current technology const investment profitability. Finally, according to the economic calculation, the applicable business mode of energy storage is proposed. The effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed analysis method are verified by different energy storage application scenarios.

articleTitle: Acquisition of Radar Fault Diagnosis Rules based on Rough Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To ensure the accuracy and effectiveness of fault diagnosis rules in the process of radar health management, and overcome the shortage of traditional human experience in obtaining fault diagnosis rules, a radar fault diagnosis rule knowledge acquisition method based on rough set theory is proposed. Firstly, the basic concepts of rough set theory are introduced, and the characteristic analysis of the radar equipment fault statistical table is conducted. The basic process of acquiring radar fault diagnosis rules knowledge is then proposed. Next, an innovative data preprocessing method and a radar fault diagnosis rule acquisition algorithm based on rough set theory are proposed for unstructured knowledge tables. Finally, the obtained diagnosis rules are applied to the fault diagnosis of a certain radar transmission subsystem. The results show that compared with the traditional method of obtaining diagnosis rules through human experience, the proposed method can effectively obtain diagnosis rules from the redundant fault statistical table of radar equipment. Furthermore, this method solves the problem of the non-standardized knowledge acquisition method and difficulty in knowledge acquisition in the process of radar health management. The use of fault diagnosis rules table can lead to a more rapid and accurate fault diagnosis, saving a considerable amount of time.

articleTitle: Multi-service Intelligent Routing Algorithm for Power Local Integrated Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, the integration of multiple communication technologies in the power local integration network has become an important direction in the field of new power system information communication. However, the emergence of multi-source transmission requirements has led to the problem of increased local network load and rapid link degradation. Based on the network control capabilities provided by SDN, a multi-service intelligent routing algorithm for power local integrated communication network is proposed. Firstly, a VARLA multivariate time series prediction model is designed to jointly predict the traffic of multiple access side communication technologies, in order to fit the traffic characteristics of power business and solve the problem of traffic feature confusion caused by the integration of multiple communication technologies more accurately. On this basis, a multi service local fusion network link arrangement algorithm for congestion alleviation is proposed, which utilizes traffic prediction results to allocate the path with the minimum overall load impact for the upcoming power business flow, considering the communication quality requirements of the business itself and the performance indicators of the entire local communication network. Finally, this paper verifies the advantages of the proposed method in traffic prediction accuracy, average link load rate, path delay, and other aspects through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: An Attentional Interactive Deep Learning Model for Multi-source Electrical Consistency Checking in Power Grid Measurement Center
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet and big data, artificial intelligence technology represented by deep neural network, DNN, has ushered in a golden period of development. The application of deep learning method in the field of power grid data checking has also attracted more and more scholars' attention. A deep learning model based on attentional interaction module is proposed for multi-source electrical consistency checking. Firstly, the circuit switch and the grid data are mapped into a fixed length vector, and the corresponding embedding matrix of the switch and data is obtained. Then, the embedded matrix is sent into the attentional interaction module to obtain an embedded matrix that comprehensively considers all elements of the switch and data, and is sent to the deep neural network after adding the previous embedded matrix to extract the intrinsic characteristics of the switch and data. Finally, the vector representation of switch and data is obtained and the matching score is calculated. Experimental results show that the proposed model is effective for multi-source electrical consistency checking.

articleTitle: Prediction of soil physical and chemical properties based on improved Elman neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Global climate change has a huge impact on the future development of the world. Scientists all over the world are actively seeking ways to reduce the adverse effects of climate change, and the increase in CO2 is one of the important causes of global warming. Therefore, it is the current mission and obligation of mankind to understand and study the global carbon cycle process and deal with the results of climate change. Therefore, it is of great significance to improve the carbon sink function of terrestrial ecosystems. Grassland is the largest terrestrial ecosystem in the world and also in my country. The carbon dynamics of grassland ecosystems are closely related to the carbon cycle process of terrestrial ecosystems. Grazing is one of the most important management methods of grassland, and different grazing methods will have different impacts on the carbon source and carbon sink function of grassland ecosystems. In order to achieve the goal of carbon neutrality at peak carbon, it is necessary to configure a reasonable grazing strategy. The basis for formulating a grazing strategy is the prediction and analysis of soil chemical and physical properties. In this paper, the improved Elman neural network is used to predict the physical and chemical properties of soil.
