articleTitle: A Review of virtual test methods for autonomous vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As the autonomous driving technology advances, the testing of autonomous vehicles becomes increasingly vital. Virtual simulation testing, a new test method, has significant technical advantages in terms of efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Therefore, it establishes itself as a crucial avenue for testing and verification of autonomous vehicles in the future.This paper conducts an extensive review of virtual simulation test technology literature to comprehensively outline the key elements that constitute the self-test scenario, including the sources and construction methods. A comparative analysis is conducted to explore the technical characteristics of software in the loop, driver in the loop,hardware in the loop and vehicle in the loop. Additionally, the evaluation indices of simulation test methods are analyzed, and the developmental trajectory of simulation test technology is discussed.The research results unequivocally confirm that virtual simulation testing is an indispensable method for iterating development rapidly and realizing the technological implementation of autonomous driving. In the future, it is crucial to prioritize deconstructing and reconstructing the database for virtual simulation test scenarios in autonomous driving. It is also important to conduct hybrid simulation tests using diverse test tools, and gradually establish standardized tool chains for virtual testing of autonomous vehicles.

Author Keywords: hardware in the loop vehicle in the loop

articleTitle: Entropy-based Keyframe Established and Accelerated Fast LiDAR Odometry and Mapping
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the advancement of computer computing power, most of the current SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) algorithms use graph optimization to build graphs. The key to graph optimization is to establish nodes and edges, that is keyframes and pose constraints. However, most algorithms still use heuristic methods to determine whether to establish new keyframes. This method usually creates redundant keyframes, adding invalid nodes to the graph optimization process, which results in lower efficiency of back-end optimization. Moreover, the frequent creation of keyframes leads to the need for frequent updates to the local map in front-end point cloud matching, reducing its efficiency. In this paper, we introduce an information-theoretic method for deciding when to generate new keyframes and optimizing updates to the local map for better front-end point cloud matching. Specifically, we calculate the information entropy of each point cloud matching pose. Once it reaches the set threshold, it indicates that the previous local map does not provide sufficient information for point cloud matching, which necessitates the establishment of a new keyframe. The local map is also updated immediately. This proposed method can establish keyframes with sufficient information and improve the accuracy of point cloud matching in the public dataset evaluation.

articleTitle: A Network for Semantic Segmentation of Point Cloud reorganized by Sectoral Cylindrical Partition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The existing deep learning-based algorithms for point cloud semantic segmentation has achieved an unprecedented precision in accuracy and robustness under some classical situation. However, the uneven density and large scale of point clouds make it difficult for segmentation networks to handle these hard scenes. Therefore, effective downsampling and uniformization of the point cloud spatial distribution are meaningful research directions. Along the way, this paper firstly proposes a new sectoral cylindrical partitioning (SCP) strategy to reorganized large point clouds, and secondly designs a SCP based semantic segmentation network (SCP-SSNet), which achieves high-precision segmentation of large-scale non-uniformly distributed point clouds. SCP-SSNet consists of three modules: PC-Embedding, SCP-Homogenization, and Transf.-Fusing. Specially, the point cloud embedding (PC-Embedding) module is designed to provide long-range contextual information for the subsequent segmentation network. The point cloud feature sectoral cylindrical partitioning-based point cloud homogenization (SCP-Homogenization) module is proposed to effectively improve the problem of uneven feature distribution. The Transformer based feature fusing (Transf.-Fusing) module is introduced to fuse contextual association and position encoding, achieving high-precision semantic segmentation of point clouds. The experimental results on some public datasets demonstrate that SCP-SSNet can efficiently predict a more accurate segmentation results of point cloud and outperform the state of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: A Extreme Learning Machine with edge preserving residuals for Hyperspectral image classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of information redundancy and high time complexity of hyperspectral imagery (HSI) classification in high-dimensional situation, this paper proposes a extreme learning machine method of edge preserving residual. Specifically, HSIs are segmented through fully supervised and semi supervised superpixel multi-scale guidance, while multi-scale features are fused using residual cascades. Then, the semi-supervised classification map is subjected to edge preserving filtering to obtain edge filtering full class labels, which are further processed as a new segmentation scale standard for HSIs. Finally, the fully supervised and semi supervised features are combined for mean collaborative learning to extract image edge features while strengthening the connection between prior labels. This can reduce the complexity of classifier features to a certain extent and improve classification accuracy. On the one hand, in order to comprehensively consider the impact of different scales on classification results in superpixel multi-scale segmentation, this paper introduces residual structure, which has the advantage of multi-scale features. On the other hand, considering the positive impact of edge preserving filtering on hyperspectral classification results, this paper introduces a directional filter for denoising HSIs. In order to verify the effectiveness of this model, this paper selects three data sets: Indian Pines, University of Pavia and Salinas. The results show that this optimization model has better classification performance than some traditional classification methods in the case of small sample training, and time complexity also has a certain competitiveness.

articleTitle: Portable Road Condition Recognition System Based on Yolov5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the social problems of the large base of visually impaired people in China, the high construction cost of visually impaired facilities, and the safe travel of visually impaired people, a portable basic road condition recognition system was designed. Road condition recognition relies on convolutional neural networks, dynamic recognition model training, and the use of multi module algorithms to achieve dynamic feedback of road conditions. The hardware design is based on a raspberry pie and a camera. Images are uploaded to the cloud in real time through the camera. The program interprets its data structure and describes the results. In the training phase of the road condition recognition model, using adaptive anchor frame calculation and adaptive image zooming can accurately frame vehicles and pedestrians. The road condition recognition model recognizes and displays the color of traffic lights through binarization of images, extracts text information from road signs, roughly measures the distance between objects and users through monocular ranging, and generates corresponding voice announcements.

articleTitle: Design of "Green Passenger Station Energy Management and Control Platform" based on multi-modal data fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: By analyzing the intelligent development of railway passenger station and the requirements of green railway passenger station under the premise of "integrated transportation, the overall service and macro-security", the general idea of building "near zero carbon" green intelligent railway passenger station and building energy management and control platform is put forward. With "green + digital + intelligent" coordination as the development goal of green railway passenger station, the content and indicators of railway passenger station energy consumption monitoring were sorted out. Relying on the integrated service platform that has been built and accessed, the energy management and control platform of the passenger railway station is built to solve the shortcomings of the original platform, such as the lack of energy analysis and management and control and inadequacy. Starting from the data collection, the multi-modal data of equipment energy use is comprehensively analyzed from different dimensions such as time, space, environment and passenger flow. The key technologies of energy management and control platform detection and monitoring information collection, differentiated energy management and control strategies, data fusion analysis, multidimensional energy consumption index classification, energy efficiency comparison and energy use diagnosis are studied. Overall improvement of the comprehensive energy efficiency of passenger railway stations, for the realization of the optimal control of passenger station energy and intelligent station "three" development to provide management and prediction means.

articleTitle: Traffic Forecasting Based on Multi-scale convolutional and Multi-path residual Triple Direction LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the booming business scale of domestic telecom industry, its business order of magnitude presents exponential growth. Telecom operators put forward higher traffic forecasting requirements based on the rapid growth of network demand and increasingly complex network environment. The traditional single model network architecture is difficult to adapt to the current flexible network requirements and not able to extract the spatio-temporal correlations. In this paper, by integrating the Multi-scale convolutional and Multi-path residual block, integrating the Triple Direction Long Short Term Memory (MSMR-TriLSTM), This paper extracts the iterative features from the network traffic data set of a branch company of telecom, studies the time series prediction model in depth for the traffic data of telecom equipment and combines the clustering results of time series data, so as to realize the long-term prediction of complex traffic data. The experimental results of the proposed network model and algorithm show that, compared with the single model, the hybrid model has a significant advantage in predicting the long-term trend of server traffic. Analysis and comparison of experimental indicators show that Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) both decreased and the Accuracy of the model was as high as 88%, which indicates that the model could extract the main features of the server traffic data and had the ability of accurate and stable long-term prediction.

articleTitle: A hybrid spatio-temporal prediction method for traffic flow on sparse road networks based on graph convolutional neural networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This study addresses the problem of traffic flow prediction in sparse road networks. Road network control units are defined from the perspective of road network traffic control, and a road network graph structure is constructed using a collection of road network control units as the core. Through the spatio-temporal traffic flow data set of each control unit, a hybrid spatio-temporal traffic flow prediction method is proposed for the sparse regional road network of highways. This method enables data-driven overall pattern traffic flow prediction at the regional road network level.

articleTitle: NFV-based Time Synchronization Method for Power 5G Integrated Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The integration of multiple wireless communication systems based on 5G is an important development trend for achieving comprehensive coverage of communication networks in power systems. However, current time synchronization in the power system cannot meet the service requirements of high reliability and low latency in 5G integrated communication networks, which is characterized by wireless link and dynamize topology. In this paper, a time synchronization architecture based on 5G-MEC and integrated wireless self-organized networks is proposed to meet the time synchronization requirements of 5G integrated communication networks. Also, by constructing synchronous message passing and error compensation as virtual network services, a VNF deployment method that considers resource constraints, latency requirements, and wireless self-organized network topology is designed. Finally, in order to solve the problem of delay jitter, a time synchronization error compensation method based on diffusion Kalman filter is proposed. Simulation results show that the method proposed can effectively improve the number of synchronized service users and success rate, reduce delay jitter, and improve synchronous accuracy of power services.

articleTitle: A Novel Integrated Navigation Algorithm For The Next-generation Networking
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern cities, the outdoor environment is becoming increasingly complex. The signal transmission of GPS is blocked in a forest of tall buildings. It results in a serious decline in positioning accuracy. Therefore, based on the next generation network, this paper proposes a combined positioning scheme combining GPS/AOA/SINS. Aiming at the problem that the traditional fault-tolerant integrated navigation fault detection and isolation methods are simple and can not effectively suppress the location divergence, an adaptive fault-tolerant integrated navigation algorithm is designed. The algorithm is based on the GPS/AOA/SINS combined location scheme, and a fault detection and processing module is added in the middle of the federated Kalman filter. By weighting the gain matrix of the fault sub-filter, the confidence degree of the measured value is changed. The experimental results show that the algorithm can detect and process system faults in real time, and the reliability of integrated navigation system is improved.

articleTitle: Video Super-Resolution With Multi-Level Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A video super-resolution reconstruction algorithm with multi-level attention is proposed to fully utilize the abundant inter-frame redundancy information and balance the trade-off between reconstruction performance and speed. The algorithm achieves adaptive residual space fusion and multi-level inter-frame information fusion through a recursive adaptive aggregation network and adaptive multi-level attention modules. Specifically, each adaptive multi-level attention module is used for multi-level inter-frame information fusion. Then, multiple cascaded adaptive multi-level attention modules with shared weights are used for adaptive residual space fusion. Finally, the feature is refined and enlarged through a reconstruction network to obtain the final high-resolution video frame. This algorithm can better restore high-frequency details such as textures and edges, while enhancing the long-term temporal dependency modeling capability and achieving a balance between reconstruction performance and speed. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the video super-resolution reconstruction performance on standard datasets.

articleTitle: Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Depth Dual Mode Smooth Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of the autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) to complete the task at low speed, and achieve the requirements of high utilization rate and low energy consumption of the actuator, this paper proposes a soft switching method based on S-function to realize the smooth switching of the depth control of the vertical thruster and the depth control of the horizontal rudder. The fuzzy control strategy of actuator switching is designed to monitor and evaluate the current depth change rate and attitude of AUV in real time, and the decision-making process of dual-mode smooth switching is completed. Combined with the vertical plane motion model of AUV, the stability analysis of the proposed switching method with two depth control modes is carried out, and the results show that the proposed S-function is asymptotically stable for the system. The experimental results show that the dual-mode smooth switching strategy and method proposed in this paper are effective.

articleTitle: A Three-Dimensional Online Trajectory Planning Method for Terminal Area of Reusable Launch Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A three-dimensional online trajectory planning method is proposed to solve terminal-area energy management of reusable launch vehicles. This method includes three important aspects. First, the angle of attack profile used is programmed by a two-dimensional longitudinal dynamic equation in the energy domain instead of a three-dimensional dynamic equation. This reduces the amount of calculation and improves the calculation speed, which is suitable for online application. Second, this method uses geometry to plan the ground track, which improves the applicability of the method to the ground trajectory with complex shape. Finally, the prediction-correction technique is used to compensate the range loss caused by lateral motion. These techniques make the algorithm converge quickly in three-dimensional trajectory planning and the technical indexes such as range can reach the design value. A numerical simulation verified this method's rapidity and high precision.

articleTitle: Research on Geological Hazard Identification Technology Based on SBAS-InSAR and SAOCOM Radar Remote Sensing Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The temporal deformation monitoring of pumped storage power station slopes using SBAS-InSAR technology is an important approach for identifying and monitoring geological hazards in pumped storage power stations. In this study, SBAS-InSAR technology was employed to investigate the geological hazard risks in the entire region of the Yuanyu Pumped Storage Power Station in Shanxi. High-resolution SAOCOM radar remote sensing data and low-resolution Sentinel radar remote sensing data were used for temporal analysis of the power station. The identified hazardous points were validated based on previous survey results and on-site verification data. The results demonstrate that SBAS-InSAR technology can effectively identify the deformation areas on-site. A total of 13 geological hazard points were successfully identified in this study. The SAOCOM satellite data, with its higher resolution, exhibited stronger identification capabilities and identified more geological hazard points compared to Sentinel data. This research provides reference for the investigation of geological hazard risks in similar pumped storage power stations.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent management and control software for gas drainage in the whole mine based on cross platform architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The existing coal mine gas drainage anomaly recognition needs to use manual assistance to view relevant data analysis, lacking of independent and intelligent analysis means; The ability of timely disposal of abnormal drainage is weak, and the multi system linkage control function is lacking when gas disasters occur; The software deployment environment is single, and cross platform and cross end application access cannot be realized. Aiming at the above problems, an intelligent management and control software for gas drainage in the whole mine based on cross platform architecture is designed. The software consists of two parts which contains company side and mine side. Those technologies such as extraction multi-source data collection, extraction borehole auxiliary design, extraction data analysis, operation and maintenance management of extraction equipment, extraction GIS display, and extraction integration control are used to realize the global visualization of the extraction system. The multi-level data traceability access mechanism is established by constructing characteristic map of thematic data, which realizes the comprehensive analysis of the mathematical and physical characteristics, extraction evaluation characteristics, equipment fault characteristics, extraction anomaly characteristics, and borehole trajectory characteristics of the extraction data. In case of abnormal drainage, the software can automatically link the broadcasting system to inform the evacuation personnel in the dangerous area of gas emission, and link the ventilation monitoring system to strengthen the ventilation in the abnormal area, and automatically push the abnormal alarm message to the relevant person in charge through the message push strategy, so as to quickly and timely solve the drainage problem. We use Docker technology to realize that SQL Server database and Web terminal applications are deployed in the Docker environment. The native HTML technology combined with the responsive layout style is used to realize multi terminal access to HTML pages, mobile apps, WeChat applets, etc. The field application results show that the software can meet the needs of the two level users of the group company and the mine, effectively improve the efficiency of the mine drainage, the ability of the mine in the evaluation of gas drainage, the disposal of abnormal drainage and the use of drainage, and reduce the probability of abnormal gas accidents in the mine

articleTitle: A review of water fault diagnosis of the proton exchange membrane fuel cell
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs) are well-known as efficiency, affordability, and environmental friendliness. However, inadequate dependability and poor durability are significant concerns that limit their development. The two most frequent errors are flooding and drying. Consequently, a correct diagnosis of these two PEMFC defects is required. In this work, we outline the diagnosis approaches for PEMFC flooding and drying faults, with a focus on model-based methods, experimental methods, and data-driven methods. We summarize and examine online diagnosis methods based on data generated for flooding and drying problems, along with the diagnostic performance, benefits, and drawbacks of various diagnostic procedures. We propose relevant suggestions and prospects, such as setting up real vehicle operating conditions, developing high-power and multi-stack flooding and drying diagnosis technologies, optimizing fault location techniques in multiple stacks, and enhancing the adaptive performance of fault diagnosis techniques, given the limitations of current fault diagnosis techniques for flooding and drying in PEMFCs. These suggestions provide a reference for promoting the commercialization of PEMFCs.

articleTitle: Active Balancing Strategy for AUV Multi-Battery Packs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposed an active balancing strategy to the problem of overheating caused by an imbalance in the output of parallel battery packs in the Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) energy system. To achieve this, a loss function that includes both State of Charge (SOC) and temperature consistency is constructed. The control signals for optimal output between parallel battery packs is then optimized and calculated. This calculated signals are then used to control the switch matrix in the topology circuit, which balances the output of multiple battery packs. In addition, we also discussed the influence of SOC consistency and temperature consistency weight coefficients on the active balancing performance of battery packs. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified based on a simulation system under different propulsion powers. The experimental results show that compared to a non-balancing strategy, the proposed method reduces the maximum temperature of parallel battery packs by 18.61% while increasing temperature consistency by 92.50%, all while maintaining SOC balancing.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Quantitative Evaluation Technology for Intelligent Driving System Based on AHP Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of intelligent technology, the assembly rate of new cars with intelligent driving systems continues to rise, playing an important role in ensuring driving safety. However, it also brings a series of new safety issues caused by factors such as insufficient product performance and consumer misuse of the system. It is urgent to build a scientific and effective quantitative evaluation model for evaluation. This article systematically reviews the working mechanism of mainstream intelligent driving systems, applies improved AHP method to construct a quantitative evaluation system, and conducts evaluation experiments on four popular intelligent vehicles to verify the effectiveness of the evaluation model. Based on the evaluation results, improvement suggestions are proposed to provide technical reference for enterprises.

articleTitle: Traffic Scheduling Method for Power Low-Latency Business in TSN Based on Sending Time Scheduled
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Time-sensitive networks (TSN) can provide stable end-to-end latency and low jitter for power low-latency control business. Time-aware shaper (TAS) is a more commonly used traffic shaping mechanism in TSN, which controls the sending and receiving of traffic by using gated lists (GCL). However, TAS has a complex gating planning problem, so a cyclic queuing and forwarding mechanism (CQF) has been proposed to simplify the design of gated lists. However, there is still a lack of corresponding resource scheduling algorithms to reasonably allocate resources to multiple flows. This paper finds that the network resource utilization can be greatly improved by adjusting the sending time of traffic. Therefore, this paper considers the resource scheduling problem as an optimization problem under certain constraints, and on this basis, this paper proposes a greedy sorting algorithm (GSA) to schedule the traffic in the CQF model. The algorithm sorts the flow and adjusts the injection time of the flow by comprehensively considering the flow characteristics to increase resource utilization; meanwhile, this paper also proposes selecting the optimal offset time slot based on the flow density to further improve the success rate of network scheduling. Simulation results show that the algorithm can increase the number of successfully scheduled flows by about 19.9% compared to direct scheduling.

articleTitle: A technique of internal relative transmission delay measurement and positioning error correction for GNSS pseudo-satellite systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Internal transmission delay is one of the inherent system parameters of pseudo-satellite transmitters, and it is also one of the factors affecting the positioning service accuracy of pseudo-satellite systems. Aiming at the influence of the internal delay inconsistency deviation caused by the inconsistent components characteristics of different pseudo-satellites, a method of relative delay mensuration and compensating inside the pseudo-satellite transmitter is proposed. According to the structural characteristics of pseudo-satellite transmitter and receiver, a transmission delay measurement model is established, the total transmission delay of the pseudo-satellite transceiver system is measured by high-precision instruments, and the relative internal transmission delay between other pseudo-satellites is obtained by difference method based on one of the pseudo-satellites. Starting from the carrier phase observation equation, the positioning correction model based on single-difference carrier phase is established, and the measured value is converted into the delay compensation factor in the positioning algorithm model for positioning solution. Through the comparative analysis of the experimental results of the positioning solution before and after correction, the method can improve the positioning accuracy effectively, and the feasibility of the method is verified.

articleTitle: Deepening Research on the Comprehensive Application and Development of Railway Intelligent Detection and Monitoring System and Key Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: By analyzing the current problems in railway transportation safety and the reform status of "reform of integration of track, communication&signaling and power supply" of China State Railway Group Co., Ltd, the development trend of railway intelligent inspections and monitoring is proposed, and the integration application of new information technology is analyzed. According to the overall development goal of intelligent high-speed railway 2.0, the research content and technical route of intelligent inspections and monitoring technology are sorted out, and the railway intelligent inspections and monitoring system and management framework of "platform + application" mode is proposed. Based on the "14th Five-Year Plan" and in accordance with the idea of "specialty + technology + platform + application", the paper sorts out the professional safety suggestions and puts forward the development path of intelligent inspections and monitoring system framework. A data service platform was built to gather, store, manage and share multi-professional and multi-type inspections and monitoring data, to provide support for security assessment and maintenance decisions of high-speed railway infrastructure, and to carry out tests for typical application scenarios of perimeter intrusion. With the help of "millimeter wave radar + intelligent video" real-time monitoring of dynamic targets within the limit, comprehensive solutions are provided by space-time calibration. The real-time monitoring, efficient transmission, fusion analysis, prediction and early warning of large-scale density natural disasters and other abnormal events covering railway were realized through the test of eastern suburbs railway ring line. The deepening of railway intelligent inspections and monitoring system and the comprehensive application of technology promote the railway business to continuously strengthen the deep integration and innovative application of cloud computing, Internet of Things, big data and other technologies, comprehensively understand and master the change law of high-speed railway infrastructure, and improve the safety, reliability and economy of railway equipment.

articleTitle: Modeling Complex Systems with Weighted Multi-agent Hypergraph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The study and analysis of complex systems are confronted with significant challenges due to their inherent adaptability and uncertainty. Traditional modeling techniques focused on individual components of the system are insufficient for capturing the whole character of the system, as complex system structures constantly evolve, leading to non-repetitive outcomes. The unreliability of traditional modeling methods is exacerbated by the unpredictability of complex systems. The limitations of graph-based modeling approaches lie in their reduced capacity to analyze the complex interdependencies among nodes, as well as the low-order and high-order associations that exist between them. The hypergraph weight method, by focusing on the relationships between nodes, captures the unique complex connections of complex systems and provides support for modeling. Therefore, this paper proposes a new approach to model complex systems using hypergraph weights to facilitate multi-agent decision-making. This method enhances the accuracy of analyzing high-order relationships between nodes and improves the precision of complex results. The proposed technique presents innovative ideas and strategies for the intelligent theoretical investigation of complex systems.

articleTitle: Research on High-integrated Low-latency Superconducting Quantum Readout System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Superconducting quantum computing has gained significant attention for its ability to prepare a large number of qubits easily. However, the superconducting quantum readout systems, which serve as the foundation of superconducting quantum computing, still face several challenges including low integration, high computing delay, and reduced flexibility. In this paper, a highly integrated and low-latency superconducting readout system is introduced. This system, built on RFSoC chip, comprises multiple analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog conversion channels, as well as demodulation calculation units, to improve the degree of integration. The system employs a time-optimized single-channel matching filter demodulation algorithm to address the problem of high delay associated with readout systems, achieving a demodulation calculation delay of 19.2ns. Additionally, the system supports multiple quantum measurement and control experiments through the parameterization and modular design of functional modules. The actual test reveals that the qubit fidelity F00 and F11 obtained with this system can reach 99.5% and 98.6%, respectively, while the readout speed is significantly enhanced compared to software-based calculation. This system effectively improves the accuracy of quantum state readout.

articleTitle: The Impact of Father's Parenting Style on Preschool Children's Social Adaptation: Based on Structural Equation Model and Artificial Intelligence Algorithm Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This study explores the relationship between father's parenting style, social adaptation, and executive function of preschool children. Firstly, traditional psychological methods were used to collect questionnaires on father's parenting style, children's social adaptation, and executive function using the Parenting Styles and Dimensions Questionnaire (PSDQ), Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire (SDQ) (parent version), and Behavior Rating Inventory of Executive Function-Preschool Version (BRIEF-P) from preschool children aged 3 to 6 years. The collected data was analyzed using structural equation modeling, and the results showed that father's parenting style was related to preschool children's social adaptation, with executive function playing a partial mediating role and child gender playing a moderating role. Secondly, the study used the XGBOOST algorithm of artificial intelligence to analyze the data, with 80% of the data used as the training set to establish the algorithm model and predict the remaining 20% of the data. The results showed that the prediction accuracy could reach 95.16%. Moreover, XGBoost ranked the importance of independent variables, enabling timely and effective prevention of social maladaptation based on the most important factors.

articleTitle: Modeling and Application of Cross Scene Propagation Model for Local Wireless Communication in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Wireless propagation model is the foundation of network planning and optimization. In this paper, a cross scene ray tracing wireless propagation model is proposed to solve the problem of low prediction accuracy of existing empirical model and ray tracing propagation model in complex geographical environments of power systems. The terrain and object information provided by three-dimensional electronic maps is used in this model to divide the network coverage area into multiple scene areas with different features such as buildings, water surfaces, vegetation, and open spaces through spatial clustering method, and a cross scene ray tracing wireless propagation model is established. Different types of scenes use different parameters of direct, reflection, and diffraction. The signal propagation path is modified, and the model parameters are fitted and calibrated by using road test data and multi-objective evolutionary algorithms. The difficult problem of obtaining more accurate propagation paths and model parameters at low cost in practical applications has been solved. Using road test data for evaluation and verification, the results show that the model can provide high-precision signal intensity prediction results in densely populated urban environments.

articleTitle: A Charge Prediction Model Based on Category Frequency Division
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Charge prediction aims to charge a defendant through the case description. A fusion model to predict charges based on category frequency partitioning is proposed to address the serious imbalance of categories in charge prediction and the limited capture of text semantic features by existing models. A sample of CAIL2018(China AI and Law Challenge) was classified as low, medium-low, medium, and high frequency based on the frequency of the crime category, and a weighted stratified sampling method was adopted to construct three datasets. Dynamic vectors characterizing the semantics of the text using the pretrained RoBERTa model were used for each of the three datasets to capture the global contextual information. TextCNN, a convolutional neural network with a multi-window sliding mechanism, was used to extract the local semantic features of the text. Additionally, BiGRU, a bidirectional gated recurrent unit network, was used at the same time to capture the information of the textual sequences, combined with Attention to highlight the textual keyword information. The learning of feature representations for the three datasets was completed through multi-channel feature extraction. The outputs of the three parts were further fused by a feedforward neural network to complete the charge prediction. In experiments, the accuracy of the proposed model was 91.65%; the accuracy and Macro_F1 values were improved by 6.84% and 34.88%, respectively, compared with a BERT baseline; and the Macro_F1 value was improved by 1.49% compared with the suboptimal model. The proposed model improved the prediction accuracy of low-, medium-low-, medium-, and high-frequency offenses by 3.02%, 1.16%, 1.06%, and 0.5%, respectively, compared with the suboptimal model, effectively learning the semantic representations and improving the classification accuracy of low-frequency offenses, and providing references to achieve judicially assisted sentencing.

articleTitle: A Review of Intelligent Detection Methods for Underwater Targets in Sonar Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the research background of underwater target detection in sonar image, this paper carries out the research of underwater target intelligent detection methods in sonar image. The traditional underwater target detection methods in sonar image and the underwater target detection methods based on deep learning are introduced respectively from the aspects of principle, characteristics and research status. The traditional sonar image underwater target detection methods are divided into six methods, which are based on texture feature, geometric feature, morphology, constant false alarm rate, moving target and multi-feature fusion. The underwater target detection method of sonar image based on deep learning is divided into six types: Faster R-CNN, YOLO, SSD, DETR, combined with transfer learning, combined with generative adversary-network. Finally, combined with the application scenarios in the search and rescue field, the future development trend and research focus of sonar image underwater target detection method based on deep learning are analyzed, and the research direction in this field is pointed out, providing reference for the next application of deep learning in the search and rescue field of crash target detection.

articleTitle: A Matrix Based Reliability Evaluation and Cost Accounting Method for Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A matrix explicit reliability evaluation algorithm is proposed, and a cost accounting method for reliability optimization is proposed based on it. According to the frequency-type reliability index, an optimization model is constructed to guide the planning stage of distribution network component renewal or double-circuit line erection, which reduces the failure rate of components and load points in operation stage. According to the time-type index, an optimization model is constructed to expand the boot component and increase the standby power supply, so as to meet the capacity demand of load transfer during the running stage and reduce the outage time at the load point. The proposed matrix explicit reliability evaluation algorithm is used to calculate the time-type and frequency-type reliability indexes of load points before and after distribution network optimization, and the cost generated by reliability optimization is divided according to the variation of the two indexes, and the reliability electricity price of each load point is established. Reliability evaluation and optimization in IEEE 33-node distribution network are carried out to verify the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Power Flow Out of Limit Correction Control for Grid Branch based on Reinforcement Learning and Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, based on sensitivity and artificial intelligence methods, the prevention and correction of finite power flow violations in power grid branches are prone to the phenomenon of multiple branch cross-limit adjustments and falling into local optimum. This paper proposes a method based on reinforcement learning and sensitivity Based on the power grid branch active power flow out-of-limit correction control method, this method firstly proposes a branch power flow heavy-load/over-limit unit adjustment combination division strategy based on the sensitivity calculation method, selects the key unit groups participating in power adjustment and the adjustment properties, and A power grid branch active power flow over-limit correction control method based on a deep deterministic strategy gradient algorithm is proposed, and the dimensionality of the agent's continuous output action space is reduced through the key unit adjustment properties, which speeds up the convergence speed of the agent's training. The final simulation example shows that The effectiveness and feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Research on image matching method based on improved Salp Swarm Algorithm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low matching rate and slow speed of traditional image matching methods, an image matching method (MSSA) based on the mutual learning mechanism based on the optimization algorithm of salp swarm optimization was proposed. The traditional salp swarm algorithm has the disadvantages of low optimization accuracy and poor population diversity at the later stage of the iteration, by introducing a mutual learning mechanism, the problem of low population diversity of the salp swarm optimization at the later stage of the iteration is solved, and the convergence speed and accuracy of the algorithm are improved. the improved salp swarm algorithm is transformed into a target matching process. The histogram of oriented gradient is used to extract feature from image blocks to achieve accurate target matching. Finally, 10 classical test functions and CEC2014 test set were used to evaluate the effectiveness of the algorithm. The experimental results show that the improved salp swarm algorithm has a good application in image matching.

articleTitle: Dynamic Time Warping-based Trajectory Angles Evaluation for the Flight Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the requirement of evaluation to trajectory parameters like trajectory inclination angle and trajectory deflection angle in the flight vehicle test, a dynamic time warping (DTW) based trajectory angles evaluation method is proposed in this article. The DTW algorithm is introduced and optimized for its application to the similarity matching between the realistic and theoretical trajectory of the flight vehicle. Then, with the resulting matching and mapping relationship, the similarities between the realistic and theoretical trajectory angles series are evaluated, where the overall similarity coefficient and Theil inequality coefficient are employed by taking the two angular distance series in consideration. The trajectory data analysis is performed from multiple aspects, and the results verify the feasibility of the proposed method to trajectory angles evaluation for the flight vehicle.

articleTitle: A method for classifying commodity information with the fusion of attribute features
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a deep learning-based method for classifying commodity information to improve the problem that the model needs to understand the semantics of commodity information sufficiently, which leads to a reduced classification effect when the commodity descriptions are similar and complex. The research context is set to describe commodity information containing precious metals in the wording. The method enhances the commodity classification effect by extracting attribute entities in the commodity information, including identification attributes, commodity descriptions, and commodity specifications, and using a self-attention mechanism to fuse the attribute entity features with the overall semantic features to highlight the category features in the commodity information. The experiments show that the method improves the F1 value and accuracy rate by 2.28% and 1.81%, respectively, compared with typical classification methods, proving that fusing the attribute features of commodities can improve the semantic understanding of the model for different kinds of commodities under similar descriptions, which has some practical application value for dealing with complex semantic problems in commodity information.

articleTitle: Foreign body Intrusion detection based on YOLOv5 with self-attentional feature embedding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Foreign body intrusion detection has high value in a variety of realistic scenarios, such as foreign body intrusion in antenna field. Foreign body intrusion is one of the important security risks. In view of the low detection accuracy of existing algorithms, intelligent detection algorithm is introduced into the field of foreign body intrusion. Based on YOLOv5, an embedded CSTPNet orbital intrusion detection model with integrated self-attention features is designed. By replacing bottleneck module, segmenting feature subgraph, embedding feature coding and so on, the relationship between pixels is captured in high dimensional space. The multi-head self-attention mechanism is used to obtain the aggregation feature information of different branches from the subspace of attention branches, so as to realize the fusion of global feature information and local feature information. CIoU loss function was introduced to modify the parameters of prediction box and improve the accuracy of foreign body detection. The experimental results show that the average recognition accuracy of the proposed model is 93.7%, 3.1% higher than that of the YOLOv5 model. The frame rate can reach 40f/s, and the detection speed meets the real-time detection requirements.

articleTitle: Research on the Accuracy Detection Methord of Excimer Laser Corneal Therapeutic Machine’s Alignment System Based on Ellipse Fitting Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Accurate alignment of the optical center of the eye is the key to ensure that no eccentric cutting occurs in refractive surgery. In order to detect the accuracy of the alignment system of the excimer laser corneal ametropia cure system, a least-squares ellipse fitting detection method based on the detection plate is proposed. Firstly, a detection plate with simulated pupil pattern and scale line is designed, and then the cutting pattern and simulated pupil pattern are preprocessed by binarization, threshold segmentation technology, edge detection and other methods.Finally, the least squares ellipse fitting method is used to detect the deviation degree of the center of the cutting pattern and the simulated pupil pattern in the X-axis and Y-axis directions, so as to measure the accuracy of the alignment system. Experiments show that the detection method can be carried out in the surgical mode, and the alignment deviation of the machine can be accurately calculated compared with the manual reading.

articleTitle: Research on AC electronic load based on fuzzy PI and quasi-PR control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Energy regenerative single-phase AC electronic load is a power electronic device that simulates resistive loads and inductive and capacitive loads of arbitrary power factors, and feeds the absorbed energy back to the power grid. The traditional proportional integral control method has low accuracy, slow dynamic response, and cannot achieve static tracking of current. Therefore, a composite control strategy based on fuzzy PI and quasi-PR control is proposed. Fuzzy PI improves the speed and robustness of the controller, and quasi-PR control enables static tracking of current. The designed control method is simulated and verified by Matlab/Simulink. The experimental results show the correctness and effectiveness of the control scheme.

articleTitle: Research on random forest algorithm based on oversampling and feature selection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Compared with other classification algorithms, random forest algorithm has obvious advantages in terms of classification accuracy, generalization error and training speed, and is widely used in data mining. However, when faced with unbalanced data, the classification performance of random forest algorithm can be greatly limited. To better deal with imbalanced data, an improved random forest algorithm (oversampling &FeatureSelecctionRandomForest,OF_RF) based on oversampling and feature selection is proposed in the paper. The algorithm firstly, from the data level, uses the Borderline-SMOTE algorithm to preprocess the imbalanced data set and introduces the LOF algorithm to improve the Borderline-SMOTE algorithm in order to eliminate outliers and thus improve the processing performance for negative class samples. Secondly, from the algorithm level, the ReliefF algorithm is used to assign different weights to the balanced processed data, while excluding irrelevant and redundant features, so as to perform dimensional simplification. Finally, the classification performance of the algorithm is further improved by using the weighted voting principle. The experimental results show that the improved OF_RF algorithm exhibits higher evaluation metrics in processing unbalanced data compared with the traditional random forest algorithm, proving that the algorithm has significant advantages in classification performance of unbalanced data.

articleTitle: Research on Mining Association Rules for Classroom Concentration Based on Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper studies the correlation between students' concentration in class and learning interest, emotional state and other influencing factors. By collecting students' classroom status data, a data set suitable for data mining is constructed. Based on the idea of Apriori algorithm, the Anaconda Navigator programming tool is used to mine the association rules of students' classroom concentration. Through data mining based on Apriori algorithm, and the association rules between students' emotional state, learning interest and other factors and in-class test scores are output. The results of strong association rules show that the better students' emotional state, learning interest and other states are, the better their classroom concentration performance is. Mining the potential influencing factors of students' classroom concentration provides valuable reference theory for students to improve classroom concentration and teachers to improve classroom teaching effect, which is helpful for teachers and students to build a more efficient classroom together in the future.

articleTitle: A Weighted Evaluation Model for Fault Prediction of Medium Voltage Switchgear Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The medium voltage switchgear includes ring network cabinets and central cabinets, with many internal electrical components and relatively complex structures. There are many parameter indicators that can characterize the operating status of its internal components when predicting faults. At present, most fault prediction is based on the Analytic Hierarchy Process, which uses a hierarchical approach to describe the respective operating states of each device. However, although the independent state judgment of multiple devices is efficient and the objective function is easy to regress, it is difficult to obtain high indicator weights. In this paper, an improved entropy weight method is proposed to calculate the objective weight value. Using the nonlinear mapping of the BP neural network learning state evaluation relationship, a fault prediction evaluation model of switchgear based on the combined weight method is established. The simulation results show that the model can effectively improve the accuracy of fault prediction by utilizing BP neural network deep learning evaluation, taking into account the nonlinear correlation of faults between multiple devices.

articleTitle: Age of information for multi-user access cognitive radio system with an energy collection node
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of limited channel resources of internet of things (IoT) and improve the information timeliness of IoT system, a multi-access Cognitive Radio (CR) IoT system model is constructed. The model includes one Primary User (PU) and two Secondary User (SU) nodes. PU has spectrum access rights and two SUs can share the PU spectrum. We study the latency and age of information (AoI) for secondary users in this system, where two secondary user nodes transmit different types of data to a common destination. The difference is that the first secondary user node is connected to the power grid and the data packet arrives in a burst manner. The second secondary user node has an energy harvesting sensor and generates new status updates with a certain probability. Considering the interference of the primary user, we derive the delay of the first and secondary user nodes and the AoI of the second user as functions of different parameters in the system. The simulation results show the influence of different system parameters on the delay and AoI of two secondary user nodes under PU interference.

articleTitle: AUV Low-Speed Following Based on Model Predictive Current Control of Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Low-speed following is one of the goals of AUV. The Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) is used as the main propulsion motor of AUV. Since the PMSM drive system is a complex coupling and multivariable system, Model Predictive Current Control (MPCC) is used to simplify the equation and improve the system performance. Applied to AUV speed tracking, MPCC is compared with the SVPWM-based method, which has faster response time and smaller overshoot. Due to the algorithm uses current to build cost function to select the optimal switch combination. Therefore, the sampling accuracy of the current has a big influence on the control of AUV. However, in practical system, the current sensor is affected by ambient temperature and system noise. When the current of one phase is affected, the phase is reconstructed by other phases, which is integrated with the measured data with errors. The model based on data integration algorithm is proposed to reduce the accuracy degradation caused by current errors. MPCC based data fusion can ensure that the actual rotate speed of the propulsion system better follows the expected speed and achieves the purpose of low speed monitoring in the Simulink.

articleTitle: Magnetic Resonance Image Reconstruction Based on Multi-Scale and Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the reconstruction quality of magnetic resonance imaging under undersampling, this paper proposes improvements based on the VS-Net network, which incorporates multi-scale residual convolution and attention mechanism modules into the network to achieve the reconstruction algorithm of magnetic resonance imaging under undersampling. This paper proposes a multi-scale feature MCRB module, which extracts and merges features from different scale feature maps to enhance the reconstruction of details and improve the resolution of reconstructed images. In addition, the CBAM attention mechanism module is incorporated into the network to amplify the detailed information and remove redundant features. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach in this paper can reconstruct magnetic resonance images with higher quality and clearer texture details, indicating its high practical value.

articleTitle: A violation behavior recognition method for substation operators based on three-dimensional data and object detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Substation inspection or construction still relies on manual operation. Safety accidents caused by violation behaviors or insufficient knowledge and skills are inevitable. The existing methods for substation operation safety management use two-dimensional map and image to recognize violation behavior including fast moving, cross-border, trespass, high-altitude operation without safety tether, ladder operation without support. However, the accuracy of distance calculation based on two-dimensional map is limited to meter level, which belongs to extensive safety management. Furthermore, it’s difficult to capture accurate spatial position information in two-dimensional images, which pose challenges to violation behavior recognition of substation operators. To tackle the above limitations, this paper presents a violation behavior recognition method for substation operators based on three-dimensional data and object detection. Based on three-dimensional space model and personnel positioning spatial-temporal information, it improves the accuracy of safety distance calculation among personnel, equipment and authorized work areas to the decimeter level. The experiments demonstrate that the proposed method can improve the accuracy of fast moving, cross-border, trespass, high-altitude operation without safety tether, ladder operation without support recognition.

articleTitle: Real-Time Simulation for Dynamics of Multi-body Robot Based on a Modified Rosenbrock Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Modelling the dynamics of a multi-body robot in detail and simulating it in real-time are significant for hardware design and validation. For such a complex non-linear dynamic model composed of stiff ordinary differential equations, a sufficient effective solver must be needed for real-time simulation. We divide a major fixed step into some minor steps that a modified Rosenbrock method is adopted on. As the implicit numerical method needs the solution of the Jacobian matrix, which usually costs lots of computing resources, two parallel threads are set to run simultaneously to solve the model and the Jacobian. The test result shows the dynamic model is elaborate and the numerical method is effective for real-time simulation. The simulating methods afford a reference for other simulation applications.

articleTitle: Anti-interference Backtracking Alignment Method for Positioning and Orientation System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to satisfy the requirements of rapidity and high accuracy in the initial alignment of a laser strapdown inertial navigation system, this paper proposes an anti-interference backtracking method. The method introduces a backtracking scheme for initial alignment, where the attitude matrix at the initial moment is obtained through a coarse alignment of the inertial system, and essential data are extracted and stored. Subsequently, the initial attitude matrix obtained from the coarse alignment and the stored data are utilized for backtracking Kalman filtering fine alignment. Experimental verification of the method demonstrates that the anti-interference backtracking method achieves higher accuracy in initial alignment compared to the conventional method within the same time frame. These results confirm the practicality and feasibility of the proposed alignment method

articleTitle: Network Security Situation Awareness Framework based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The mainstream technology of network security protection has gradually transited from the past "rule base" to dynamic perception based on network big data. The development of knowledge atlas has injected new vitality into network security research. Based on the limited Boltzmann machine, this paper realizes the deep learning of network security features, maps them from high dimensional space to low dimensional space layer by layer, and builds a network space security knowledge map. Then, this paper proposes a network security situational awareness framework, which integrates a series of technologies and automation tools, It can automatically and efficiently answer some basic questions that security analysts may put forward in the field of network security situational awareness. At the same time, the attack scenario discovery scheme given by the framework can play a certain role in judging attack behavior in cyberspace and building attack scenarios.

articleTitle: DLCUNet: A Densely Local Calibrate U-shape Net for Change Detection in Optical Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The task of change detection in remote sensing images aims to capture difference information from time-phase sequence images and provide references for human activities. Because change detection tasks have similar goals to image segmentation tasks, researchers often use semantic segmentation techniques to implement change detection tasks. This approach has greatly improved the robustness and efficiency of change detection compared to the past, but there are still three difficulties: the segmentation map is not continuous, the multi-scale target is not salient, and the attention mechanism is too complicated. In order to deal with these three difficulties, this paper designs a new encoder unit using the idea of local information embedding, improves the decoder unit with a non-training feature fusion method, and combines the topological structure of UNet++ to propose a new change Detect network. The new network has strong anti-noise ability and multi-scale target acquisition ability, and is more concise. The method in this paper has been verified on the CDD dataset and LEVIR-CD dataset.

articleTitle: Simulation of Parallel Hybrid Active Power Filter based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to its excellent harmonic suppression ability, hybrid active power filters have become a research hotspot. The article proposes a topology structure with simple structure and strong practicality, analyzes the method of selecting device parameters for various parts of hybrid active power filter (HAPF), and introduces a generalized integration algorithm. Establish a parallel hybrid active power filter system based on DSP control, and analyze the hardware circuit and software system of the device in detail. Finally, conduct experimental research and analyze the results. The simulation results show that the system capacity is reduced, and the reactive current and harmonic current compensation effect is good.

articleTitle: Association Rules Algorithm Based on Dual Support and Compression Matrix
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of "more frequent and more ordinary" of traditional Chinese medicine materials, this paper proposes an association rule algorithm based on double support degree and compression matrix to improve the execution efficiency of drug search. Specifically, by introducing the principle of compression matrix, adding arrays to improve the matrix storage mode, and compressing the matrix according to the correlation theorem of the association rule, so as to reduce the number of scans of the matrix and the number of candidate sets generated. By setting the maximum and minimum support threshold, the generation of infrequent itemsets and overfrequent itemsets is limited to ensure the validity of the rules, thereby improving the practicability of the obtained rules. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm has obvious advantages in the data set with high support degree and high number of transactions.

articleTitle: Global Anomaly Detection-based Distributed Estimation for Constrained Systems over Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The problem of distributed estimation for constrained systems over sensor networks is addressed, in which global anomaly detection strategy is developed in distributed fusion process. The prior constraint model and innovation vector are introduced to construct a feature vector in abnormal detection. Then a distributed power method is used to perform anomaly detection based on the global information of each sensor node. Distributed fusion scheme is proposed based on the detection report and the constraint information in which the fused estimate is proved to satisfy the priori constraint. Finally, two example of random anomaly measurement and time-varying anomaly measurement are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed distributed estimator.

articleTitle: IRS-assisted MISO system energy-saving communication scheme under security constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the high security and high energy consumption risks of downlink multiple input single output (MISO) systems assisted by intelligent reflecting surface (IRS), the transmission beamforming of the base station(BS), and the phase shift matrix of IRS are jointly considered for the transmission of the system. A system transmission power minimization problem under the constraint of a legal user secrecy rate was constructed. Then a second-order cone programming algorithm based on successive convex approximation(SCA) is proposed to solve the problem. The proposed algorithm simultaneously updates all optimization variables in each iteration and obtains a suboptimal solution to the original problem. The simulation results show that compared with the proposed baseline scheme, the algorithm in this paper achieves lower transmit power while ensuring the confidentiality quality of legitimate users.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Reconfiguration Based On Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that traditional algorithms are easy to fall into local optimum and slow calculation speed. In this paper, an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed, and based on the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, the distribution network reconfiguration with distributed generation is solved. A mathematical model with active power loss and voltage stability as objective functions is established. The broken circle method is introduced to reduce the invalid topology and speed up the algorithm. Combined with natural selection, the global convergence ability of the algorithm is enhanced. The improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to verify the IEEE33 node system. The results show that the algorithm can significantly reduce the distribution network loss and improve the voltage quality.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Node Selection Strategy for Multi-Target TDOA Localization in UAV Swarm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The time difference of arrival (TDOA) multi-target localization based on unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm faces challenges such as limited localization accuracy and complex coordination due to uncertainty biases such as node position errors and perceptual performance differences (NPEAPD) for nodes. The localization error is directly related to the spatial geometric configuration formed by the nodes and target. Therefore, node selection for localization becomes a key factor in improving the accuracy and efficiency of localization. In this paper, aiming at the difference in node perceptual performance, we use prior observation information of the targets to derive the lower bound of TDOA perceptual performance and analyze the key influencing factors of localization performance. To address the problem of limited performance of node selection in traditional TDOA localization under the aforementioned uncertain biases, we introduce a node selection strategy based on localization basics and contribution. We measure the localization basics and contribution using the received signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the nodes and the expected information about target parameters provided by the localization group, and construct an optimization model to solve it with DMSSA algorithm. Simulation show that the proposed node selection strategy has significant performance advantages compared to three benchmark strategies and improved localization accuracy.

articleTitle: The fusion of pod and marine radar detection results based on Grey Relation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Unmanned Surface Vessel (USV) can be equipped with photoelectric pods and marine radars to detect the ship targets of sea surface to obtain the type and location of the ships. Aiming at the characteristics of data attributes and dimensions in the fusion of two sensors, the data fusion algorithm based on the Grey Relation Analysis (GRA) is proposed. This method first carried out sensors registration for the radar and photoelectric pod, and then extracted the characteristics of the horned trace characteristics of the target in different sensors. The similarity of the changing trend of the angle trace curve through GRA was judged. Finally, the information such as the target category, the track, the latitude and longitude, and the distance from the USV were obtained. The results show that the data fusion algorithm based on GRA can complete the target attribute correlation, and can meet the needs of the environmental sensing task for USV.

articleTitle: A Global Path Planning Method for USV Based on Improved A_Star Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: USVs(Unmanned Surface Vehicles) have developed rapidly and are widely used in various fields recently. However, the control system of USVs is underactuated, and conventional global path planning algorithms are not suitable for USVs. The existing A* algorithm has the following shortcomings in global path planning for USVs: the search neighborhood is not adjustable or the steering direction is unconstrained, and the path smoothness is poor and the search time for high-resolution grid map is too long. This paper proposes a global path planning method for USVs based on an improved A* algorithm. This method adds unmanned boat steering costs to the objective function, and dynamically adjusts the search step size during search, thereby achieving improved path smoothness while reducing path planning time.

articleTitle: Research on optimization model of container live migration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Container virtualization technology is emerging in cloud computing due to its lightweight nature. Container live migration is the basis of many cloud management capabilities, which allow a running container to be completely moved to another physical node to continue running with minimal downtime. The performance of container live migration is the focus of the research. However, through the detailed analysis of the existing container live migration system, this paper finds that there are still some problems affecting the performance, including low parallelism of dump, non-convergence of pre-copy policy and low parallelism of root file system and running state migration. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes and designs optimization strategies and algorithms, such as resource-aware parallel dumping mechanism, post-copy policy-based running state migration and multi-priority transfer scheduling parallel algorithm, and implements a high-performance container hot migration system Dmigrate based on Docker.

articleTitle: Research on the Complexity Evaluation Method for Autonomous Driving Test Scenarios Based on Improved-Delphi Method and AHP-Entropy Weighting Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of automotive driving automation, scenario-based automated driving test evaluation methods have become an industry consensus. However, in terms of scenarios, the industry still relies on the subjective experience of experts to formulate evaluation plans, lacking scientific and quantitative evaluation methods, resulting in the problems of limited scenario coverage and low testing efficiency, which affect the mass production process of products. Therefore, this paper proposes a scene complexity evaluation method based on analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and information entropy theory, which realizes the automatic quantitative evaluation of test scene complexity and makes up for the lack of theoretical research on industry test scene. Finally, the method proposed in this paper quantitatively analyzes the complexity of typical scenarios in the Autonomous Driving Evaluation Project of CATARC, summarizes the key factors affecting the complexity of the scenario, and verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Logistics sharing mode selection and pricing strategies in platform supply chain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The development of e-commerce brings development opportunities to the manufacturer, prompting them to use logistics services to improve market competitiveness in a competitive marketplace. The high-quality service of self-operated logistics undoubtedly brings great benefits to the manufacturer, so it is crucial that e-commerce platforms are willing to share their self-operated logistics systems under what circumstances. In this paper, a platform supply chain system consisting of a manufacturer, an e-commerce platform, and a third-party logistic provider is considered, and a Stackelberg game model is developed to study the optimal decision of supply chain members under the logistics non-sharing mode and the logistics sharing mode.
