The study finds that the increase in the research logistics service fee leads to a corresponding increase in the logistics service level, as well as an increase in the sales price and a decrease in the wholesale price. And an increase in the commission rate only leads to an increase in the self-operated logistics service level. But the impact of these two parameters on the profitability of the members of the platform supply chain is non-monotonically variable. When the logistics service sensitivity coefficient is small, and when the logistics service sensitivity coefficient is large and the commission rate is high, the platform and the manufacturer achieve a win-win situation under the logistics sharing mode.

articleTitle: An FFT-based Algorithm for I/Q Imbalance Correction of Radar Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A certain degree of I and Q imbalance in intermediate frequency signals is common in current integrated radar front-end chips. In the frequency domain processing of radar baseband signals, the complex signals composed of I and Q signals will appear as mirror signals, which will make the radar sensors detect false targets. In this paper, we propose an FFT-based I and Q imbalance correction algorithm, and the simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively complete the correction with high correction accuracy and high signal image rejection ratio by using fewer intermediate frequency signal sampling points. The correction algorithm proposed in this paper has some practical application value.

articleTitle: Research on equipment planning and system construction of intelligent ship painting workshop
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the problems of China's shipbuilding enterprises, such as lack of digital accumulation, insufficient application of intelligent equipment, and poor integrity of design information, this paper sorts out the basic situation of foreign shipbuilding powers, introduces the digital and intelligent achievements of various shipyards, and expounds the importance of developing intelligent coating workshops. Comprehensive use of the new generation of information technology, databased, equipment-based planning of intelligent coating workshop. Specifically, the top-level design, production and manufacturing execution system, intelligent equipment oriented to the whole process, and the establishment of the ship coating process knowledge acquisition and integration application platform. The planning results effectively promote the digital transformation of a shipyard coating, improve the efficiency, economy and long-term of ship coating, and realize the scale and rapidity of the coating process.

Author Keywords: Process knowledge acquisition and integration platform

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Recommendation System Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The recommendation system mines the user's interest preferences based on the user's interaction history on the network to complete the user's personalized recommendation. Collaborative filtering, as a typical algorithm in personalized recommendation, is also often used in recommendation systems. But collaborative filtering still has sparse and cold start problems. In this regard, researchers usually provide recommended performance by obtaining auxiliary information such as the project's own attributes. In order to solve these problems, this paper expands the user's potential interest by using the knowledge graph to combine the user's historical interaction information. Taking the user's interaction history as a starting point, iteratively form multiple entity sets in the knowledge graph, and finally form the user's potential interest distribution by superposition, which is used to predict the click probability. Through experiments on different data sets (movies, books), the algorithm confirmed its effectiveness on these issues.

articleTitle: Research of the Cyber Attack and Defense Behavior Modeling Method Based on Object-oriented
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to describe the cyber attack and defense countermeasure behaviors effectively, an object-oriented modeling method is proposed, a hierarchical and classified cyber attack and defense behavior modeling framework is designed. The modeling process is divided into three stages: object-oriented behavior requirement analysis, behavior model design and the model implementation. In the model design process, the model is abstractly described in three aspects: conceptual modeling, logical modeling and procedural modeling. Finally, based on the object-oriented modeling method, constructed a DDOS attack behavior model simply, and it is initially verified that the method can be effectively used for the modeling of cyber attack and defense behavior.

Author Keywords: cyber attack and defense behavior modeling

articleTitle: Analysis and Judgment Method for Metering Faults under Capacitive Load Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Three phase and three wire smart watt hour meters are widely used in neutral point non Earthing system. They are usually used in internal assessment port metering points, power customer trade settlement metering points and other occasions, and are widely used in 10kV high voltage power supply metering users' energy metering. During the operation of a three-phase three-wire intelligent energy meter, malfunctions can cause metering errors, posing risks such as power loss, user complaints, and metering disputes. Combined with 10kV high voltage supply meter users who use V/V-12 connection Voltage transformer, during the operation process, the reverse polarity of phase c current of intelligent electric energy meter causes abnormal electricity quantity, analyzes the change law of system curve data before and after the reverse polarity of phase c current of intelligent electric energy meter, calculates the return and supplement electricity quantity during the fault period under capacitive load condition, and proposes detailed preventive measures to ensure the accurate, safe, reliable and stable operation of electric energy metering device, Thus effectively preventing various risks.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and Improvement Suggestions of Assisted Driving Performance Based on Evaluation Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of intelligent technology, driving assistance products have become a new demand for vehicle selection. As an objective and professional third-party evaluation project, C-ICAP driving assistance evaluation is playing a decisive role. Based on the C-ICAP assisted driving evaluation practice, this paper systematically analyzes the evaluation data of 10 popular intelligent vehicles, comprehensively evaluates the technical level of intelligent vehicles in the industry, diagnoses and finds common problems, and puts forward technical improvement plans to provide reference for enterprise R & D and design.

articleTitle: Monitoring Design of Unmanned Ship Power Distribution System Based on RS485 Bus Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, unmanned ship technology has developed rapidly. It is a multidisciplinary comprehensive technology carrier that integrates intelligent control, wireless communication, autonomous collision avoidance, and fusion algorithms. Currently, unmanned ships have played an important role in the military and civilian fields. At present, the main power source of unmanned ships is to use diesel generator sets for power generation, and equipped with composite distribution boards for centralized control and monitoring of power distribution equipment. In the past, power distribution equipment was manually managed and regularly inspected, which resulted in long inspection time and insufficient real-time information, making it difficult to make real-time and effective judgments on recorded data. In order to detect problems and faults in power distribution equipment in a timely manner, monitor and remotely control equipment parameters, and ensure the reliability and safety of unmanned ship power distribution, To ensure the smooth completion of tasks by unmanned ships, we have designed a monitoring method for unmanned ship power distribution based on RS485 bus communication form.

articleTitle: Intelligent Simulated Electromagnetic Gun System Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The electromagnetic gun fired by electromagnetic energy as an entirely novel category of armor-piercing weapon is a path of future expansion of military science and technology in the globe, since the fuel formula of current artillery has posed an impasse of technical progress. This system investigates a simulated electromagnetic gun system with an STM32F103 processor as its main processing component, employing the OpenMV camera for image recognition of the red marking target, outfitted with a two-dimensional PTZ so that the electromagnetic gun can be moved freely within a certain range, and establishing an oblique throwing motion model to simulate the running trajectory of the projectile in the air, which enables the calculation of the launching angle of elevation and declination. The electromagnetic gun’s automatic target shooting function is carried out by the laser sensor, which measures the distance between the projectile’s barrel and the target. The electromagnetic force generates when the capacitor discharges to launch the projectile. In addition to the automated firing mode, the Bluetooth module allows for data transfer between the microcontroller and the cell phone, as well as direct modification and modification of the electromagnetic gun system’s modes and situations from the cell phone side. Testing of the system has demonstrated that the system is capable of carrying out the operations of automatic target identifying and projectile launch to shoot projectile to the target with the electromagnetic gun.

articleTitle: A Proposed Method of Information Mining for Cyber Black Market Oriented to Tor Anonymous Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the network black industry continues to expand, and cybercrime is becoming increasingly rampant. As a hotbed of crime, the darknet, with its anonymity, has also become a new front for online black market, bringing huge challenges to investigation and digital forensics. This article designs an automated darknet data crawling program that can achieve protocol conversion between darknet and surface networks, as well as data crawling of target sites on darknet. At the same time, the developed visualization program and data analysis program can achieve the display of target data in multiple dimensions. Combined with the periphery investigation technology to the website and social engineering, it can realize the mining of the criminal intelligence of the hidden network and provide reference for the investigation department.

articleTitle: Research on Calligraphy Style Recognition Based on Adaptive Image Enhancement and Improved DenseNet Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems that ancient calligraphy fonts are missing due to the influence of historical factors, there are many kinds of fonts, but the amount of data is small, and the deep learning technology is not used to realize better recognition, an adaptive image enhancement and DenseNet calligraphy font style recognition algorithm is proposed, and better font recognition effect is achieved through optimization model. Through image processing and other technologies, more than forty thousand pictures of six types of calligraphy were collected, each type of calligraphy font contains at least three thousand common words, and the current popular neural network models: AlexNet, GoogleNet, SimpleNet, ResNet, DenseNet models were compared by training self-built data set. Finally, DenseNet network was selected for optimization, and Lion optimizer was used to optimize the network model. The training accuracy reached 97.24%, and the training effect was better than the popular neural network.

articleTitle: Fast identification neural network combining on YOLOv5 and ViT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Dynamic tiny object recognition with noise is a challenging task for YOLO networks, and the accuracy and recall of detection are partially affected due to the changes in target feature scale caused by noise during dynamic tiny object detection. To address these issues that may arise in industrial scenarios, an improved YOLOv5-V network based on YOLO network and Transformer network is proposed. Firstly, a new method called Random Search Data Augmentation (RSDA) is applied to enhance the robustness of the model on a limited dataset. Secondly, Tokens-To-Tokens(T2T) module is used to improve the original CSPDarknet53 structure, and a detection head (TPH) specialized in detecting small objects is added. Finally, the AF-FPN structure consisting of Adaptive Attention Modules (AAM) and Feature Enhancement Module (FEM) is used to replace the original Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) and enhance feature resolution. Model ablation experiments on datasets such as UR Fall Detection Dataset (URFD) and Fall Detection Dataset (FDD), as well as actual model training results, show that compared with the original YOLOv5l network, the parameter size of the YOLOv5-V network increased by 14.7MB, and the MAP and MAP@0.5~0.95 values improved by 7.3% and 16.8%, respectively. Experimental results show that the YOLOv5-V network can effectively improve anti-interference and noise resistance while enhancing the detection capability of dynamic tiny targets.

articleTitle: Quantitative Evaluation Method for Wind Turbines Participating in Power System Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The reduction of power system inertia significantly affects the support ability of system frequency, which weakens the anti-disturbance ability. In this paper, the maximum frequency change rate and the constraint of the system equivalent inertia time constant are considered with large-scale wind turbines access in the power system when the system disturbance occurs. The minimum equivalent inertia required by the system is obtained. Next, the method for calculating the capacity of the wind turbines participating in power system frequency regulation under the constraint of inertia time constant is proposed. When the wind turbines participate in system frequency response, virtual inertia, and droop control are considered. Then, the equivalent inertia time constant supporting index, steady-state frequency supporting index, and transient frequency supporting index are put forward to evaluate the frequency regulation ability of the wind turbines quantitatively. Finally, the IEEE-30 bus system is used to verify the effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Improved Swimming Pool Drowning Detection Method Based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To better cope with the increasing number of drowning accidents every year, an improved drowning detection method based on YOLOv8 is proposed in this paper. In this approach, the main network structure of YOLOv8 is retained, and the coordinate attention(CA) mechanism and FReLU activation function are added to the model to improve the detection effect. By adding the coordinate attention mechanism, the model obtains a better perception of direction and position on each channel compared to the conventional spatial attention or channel attention mechanisms, and FReLU achieves better spatial perception of the activation function with negligible spatial overhead compared to SiLU in the feature-enhanced network of YOLOv8. Tested on the constructed swimmer dataset, the method in this paper performs better and achieves a mean average precision (MAP) of 91.78%, which is a 1.63% improvement compared to the original YOLOv8.

articleTitle: Development of a data analysis system based on the long-cycle stability of silicon resonant pressure sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Long-cycle stability is one of the most important indicators of the performance of silicon resonant pressure sensors. Long-cycle testing of this sensor within the industry currently relies on real-time comparison of pressure standard sources and has not yet been automated to measure calibration comparisons. With the development of technology, digital virtual instruments are gradually replacing traditional test equipment. In this paper, a data analysis system for the long-cycle stability of silicon resonant pressure sensors is designed by studying the long-cycle stability of silicon resonant pressure sensors and their testing methods. The system is implemented as an ASP.NET-based client, which reads the test data during the time period through a client-side front-end request and uses a multi-sensor fusion algorithm instead of a pressure standard source to calculate the reference value and uses time aggregation to find its error, enabling a real-time view of the test data in a local area network report and an alarm for the error point. After a long period of testing and comparison, the system can effectively achieve the reference value and error without the pressure standard source, and effectively achieve the user to view the test data and alarm information anytime and anywhere.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of the Effect of Load Current on the Winding Temperature in 110kV Oil-immersed Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to analyze the temperature change of winding hot spot in oil-immersed transformers under different load currents, a three-dimensional model of 110kV oil-immersed transformers is established in this paper. The losses of the transformer winding and core are simulated in the electromagnetic field, and the resulting losses are used as a heat source for fluid-temperature field coupling simulation. Based on the finite element analysis, the winding temperature distribution characteristics and the hottest spot are calculated under different conditions. With the variation of load current, the data samples of the hottest spot of the winding under different conditions were extracted for analysis. The results show that the transformer temperature distribution is not uniform, the hottest spot is near 82% of the axial height of the low-voltage winding side, and the hot spot temperature increases nonlinearly with the increase of the load current. When the transformer is overloaded, the hot spot temperature increases significantly with the load current. This research can provide theoretical and data support for locating the hottest spot of oil-immersed transformers and predicting the temperature of different load currents.

articleTitle: A Segmentation and Stitching Method on Infrared Images of Porcelain Post Insulator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The infrared thermography has currently played an increasingly important role in nondestructive online testing of porcelain post insulators in power substations. The thermal information in infrared images become essential as the abnormal temperature rise can be utilized for fault diagnosis. A segmentation and stitching method is put forward to form a full-view infrared diagram out of multiple infrared images shot on same post insulator from different angles, which contains all the necessary thermal information for fault diagnosis, with advantages of reduced storage resources, enhanced storage efficiency and runtime performance when dealing with massive infrared images of porcelain post insulators.

articleTitle: A authentication method of near field Ad hoc network for electrical mobile safety inspection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, the application of wireless Ad hoc network in the field of mobile security inspection is in its infancy, and the network security protection means for the power industry are still insufficient, which is highlighted by the lack of efficient security authentication means for Ad hoc network, and it is difficult to completely eliminate security risks such as illegal terminal intrusion, data counterfeiting and tampering. A decentralized security authentication scheme suitable for Ad hoc network is designed, which can solve the security trust transfer problem on the variable network topology. Under any network route, the security trust is transferred to the proxy node step by step through multiple peer authentication, and the authentication chain is eUEblished between the digital intelligence edge proxy device, the proxy node and the node to be accessed. On the one hand, it can effectively solve the counterfeit problem of A-nodes and proxy nodes; on the other hand, it can greatly reduce the problem of reduced security authentication efficiency caused by deepening network hierarchy.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Up-grid Gathering Station Demands Assessment Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: When the renewable energy output power is large, but the load is small, renewable energy power cannot be consumed locally. It is necessary to be sent out to the upper voltage level power grid through the gathering station. In this paper, the characteristics of regional renewable energy output power and the distribution of regional renewable projects that have not yet been put into production are analyzed. The maximum power demand of renewable energy that is sent out to the upper voltage level power grid in the region is obtained. Then, the valley-load period in the evening, the maximum power of renewable energy at noon, and the renewable energy access capacity of 110kV and below are analyzed. Based on the difference between the scale of the renewable energy construction scheme and the scale of access capacity, the demand scenario of the gathering station is proposed. Considering the security margin of the transformer load rate and the power control margin of the main renewable energy transmission channel, the construction demands of renewable energy gathering stations are obtained. Finally, a regional power grid with large-scale renewable energy is used to verify the effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Instantaneous attitude solving algorithm based on reversible linear transformation in star sensor*
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aimed at decreasing the time cost of instantaneous attitude solving in star sensors and enhancing the data updating rate of autonomous attitude determination in aero crafts which utilize star sensor, an algorithm based on reversible linear transformation is proposed. The proposed algorithm transforms the nonlinear equation group which takes the attitude quaternion as unknown values into standard quadratic form according to the characteristics of attitude quaternion, which results in the number of assignment calculation decreasing in the course of solving the equation group of attitude quaternion. The simulation result indicates that the solving time cost of instantaneous attitude is decreased obviously through this algorithm.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Object Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Traditional pedestrian object detection techniques, represented by YOLOv5, are limited in real-world applications due to their large parameter volumes and high computational complexity. In response to this problem, we propose an improved YOLOv5s pedestrian object detection algorithm. Firstly, we introduce the lightweight network GhostNet into the structure of YOLOv5s to achieve lightweight detection networks. On this basis, a CBAM based on the attention mechanism is proposed to enhance feature extraction and improve the performance of the model while reducing the model parameters. Secondly, we replace the CIoU loss function in the original network with the EIoU loss function, which enables the network training process to converge faster. Finally, we construct a pedestrian object detection dataset to verify the accuracy and real-time performance of the model. The experimental results show that while maintaining high accuracy, the parameter volume of the improved YOLOv5s algorithm is reduced by 45.8% compared to the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Classification of Traffic Signs Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the intelligent transportation system, traffic signs are hindered by external and internal factors such as light, weather and shelter, which is easy to lead to identification errors. In view of this problem, this paper selects the identification of traffic signs based on LeNet-5 network model. In order to reduce the burden of convolutional neural network and improve the resolution, this paper collects traffic sign images from the actual environment, and first performs a series of preprocessing operations for GTSRB data set, including image gray, size normalization and image enhancement. The preprocessed GTSRB data set helps identify subsequent convolutional neural network with LeNet-5 classical model. The experimental results show that the algorithm has high recognition rate and great advantages in traffic sign recognition.

articleTitle: Smoking Detection Algorithm Based On Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low detection accuracy of small and medium-sized targets in complex scenes, a smoking detection method in public places based on improved YOLOv5 was proposed.Firstly, Mosaic-9 was used to replace the traditional Mosaic data enhancement algorithm to increase the amount of image mixing and improve the learning ability of the algorithm model for small targets. Secondly, the dual channel attention mechanism (CBAM) is introduced to pay more attention to the location of the target in the image and improve the recognition ability of the algorithm model. Then, the upsampling method is changed to transpose convolution, so that the model can better recognize the semantic information in the image and improve the recognition ability of the target region. Then, the SPD-Conv module is introduced to improve the recognition ability of low resolution image and small target image.

articleTitle: A Design of Multi-channel Digital Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to implement multi-channel real-time acquisition of hydroacoustic data, the design of a multi-channel digital geophone based on the MAX10M08 processor, which can perform multi-channel synchronous filtering processing of the signal received from the acoustic transducer, and the signal will be full-wave rectification output to achieve the signal geophone function. The design uses a highly integrated multi-channel data acquisition design approach to achieve the main functions, and after testing and verification, the results show that its detector function is normal, low power consumption, can be used for data multi-channel real-time acquisition.

articleTitle: Research on Text Classification Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Nowadays, with the development of media technology, people receive more and more information. Among them, the most important is the text classification technology. This paper aims to improve text classification methods using Convolutional Neural Networks(CNNs) and natural language processing techniques. The technical requirements and application scenarios of text classification are combined with Machine Learning to optimize classification, and for the application of Natural Language Processing in text classification, and a text classification algorithm is proposed, and the accuracy rate of TPM algorithm in different data sets is above 95%.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: Power image segmentation method based on two-branch fusion attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an improved algorithm that integrates two - branch feature extraction and attention mechanism. By using the extracted feature map as the input feature of the attention mechanism, the problem of network degradation and gradient disappearance can be solved, and the neglected image details can be captured. A two-branch feature extraction mechanism was designed to expand the feature extraction capability and refine the edge information of the image to optimize the network's uneven attention to features at different scales. At the same time, two loss functions, cross entropy loss and class unbalance function, are combined as loss functions to reduce the influence of background by focusing on the foreground samples and improve the segmentation accuracy of the algorithm. Experimental results show that the accuracy of feature extraction is improved and the segmentation effect is better.

articleTitle: Design of Gas Pressure Control System With the Silicon Resonant Pressure Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A gas pressure control system with the silicon resonant pressure sensor is designed in this paper to realize the precise control of gas pressure, which takes an STM32F407 microcontroller as the main controller adopts a high-precision silicon resonant pressure sensor to collect the current air pressure value in real-time, and takes the structure of two high-speed solenoid valves to control the gas container as the research object. A closed-loop control system with real-time acquisition and real-time control is established. According to the difference between the target barometric pressure value and the actual barometric pressure value, the microcontroller controls the high-speed solenoid valves to make corresponding actions to regulate the pressure. The experimental results show that the pressure controller has good pressure control performance, with a range of 2kPa-350kPa and an accuracy of 0.02%FS, which can meet industrial production needs.

articleTitle: Research on Surface Defect Detection System for Brake Disc based on Machine vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The article takes automobile brake discs as the detection object, and based on image processing, a machine vision-based system for detecting surface defects of automotive brake discs is designed. The machine vision method is used to substitute for manual detection of brake disc surface defects. It can improve the accuracy and reliability of detection, as well as reduce the impact and error caused by external factors. Firstly, an industrial camera is used to capture high-definition images of the brake disc. Then, the brake disc image is binarized, segmented, morphology operation, convolved, and regions of interest extracted, ultimately achieving surface defect detection of the brake disc. According to the image processing results, the proposed algorithm has a certain degree of reliability in detecting surface defects of brake discs. It can also provide a certain reference value for machine vision detection technology.

articleTitle: Rumor Detection Based on Knowledge Graph and Graph Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid growth of the Internet, people are exposed to a significant increase in the amount of information. However, the dissemination of false news has become rampant, causing adverse effects on society. Rumor detection has emerged as an important and challenging research direction aimed at accurately determining the authenticity of messages. This paper proposes a novel rumor detection method based on a knowledge graph and graph attention networks. The method leverages the attention mechanism of graph attention networks to learn topic-enhanced news representations and extract features related to rumor propagation. It then compares the extracted entity features with the entity features in a knowledge base using an entity comparison network. The proposed method is validated on the publicly available SLN dataset, and experimental results demonstrate a 2% improvement in micro F1 and macro F1 performance metrics compared to state-of-the-art baseline models.

articleTitle: Application of Micro Front-end Technology in Network Public Opinion System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Network public opinion system is a system that tracks, collects and manages public opinion. The system enables the collection, management, feedback and visual display of public opinion information. The network public opinion system adopts the combination of traditional front-end technology and micro-front-end technology. The traditional front-end technology adopts AdminLTE open-source framework based on Bootstrap and jQuery technology, and the micro-front-end technology adopts Qiankun technology framework. Nestjs framework is adopted in the back end. Micro front-end technology is a modular approach to splitting system functions, which can significantly reduce the size of the program and provide a significant increase in program speed.

articleTitle: Fault detection of Integrated navigation systems based on one-class support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The fault of integrated navigation system will affect the precision of navigation result and even the whole system, so the fault detection of integrated navigation is very important. However, the data of the integrated navigation system is typical skew data, that is, the amount of correct data is much more than the amount of faulty data, resulting in a low fault detection rate. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a fault detection method based on one-class support vector machine(OCSVM). This method fully learns and utilizes the data feature information of correct data and constructs a classifier to distinguish data types. Simulation results show that OCSVM has improved detection rate and false alarm rate compared with standard SVM.

articleTitle: Similarity Measurement Method of Near Infrared Spectrum Based on Adaptive Geodesic Local Tangent Space Alignment Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Traditional approaches for recipe development, raw material understanding, and quality assessment face significant challenges. Experts in recipe design find it difficult to rely solely on sensory judgments such as visual observation, tactile perception, and olfactory assessment to discriminate raw material quality. Therefore, it becomes crucial to study similarity measurement methods for raw materials and assist experts in quickly identifying suitable ingredients. Commonly used methods based on distance, cosine angle, or correlation are not well-suited for judging similarity among high-dimensional and nonlinear data. Hence, this paper proposes a similarity measurement method of near-infrared spectrum based on adaptive geodesic local tangent space alignment algorithm (AGLTSA). By utilizing geodesic distance, this algorithm can better measure the similarity between near-infrared spectral data. Additionally, the use of an adaptive neighborhood selection strategy improves the fitting of the local space for high-dimensional data, thus enhancing the effectiveness of similarity measurement for near-infrared spectral data. This study designs experiments to validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in dimensionality reduction, similarity detection, and classification tasks related to real-world raw materials such as beer malt in industrial production. The experimental results demonstrate that this algorithm are superior to those obtained by PCA, ISOMAP, LLE, LTSA, and UMAP algorithms. It can effectively handle the classification and substitution tasks of recipe ingredients in industrial production, thus assisting in maintaining product quality in enterprise.

articleTitle: Research on point position balance control of VIENNA rectifier
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of midpoint potential fluctuation in three-phase three level VIENNA rectifier, this paper is proposed the strategy of 14 pulse carrier phase shift modulation and midpoint potential balance control on the basis of traditional carrier phase shift modulation (CPS-PWM). Firstly, the principle of VIENNA rectifier is analyzed based on the equivalent circuit. Secondly, according to the analysis of the carrier phase shift modulation process based on the principle of space vector modulation, the cause of the neutral point potential unbalance is determined. Finally, the redundant and non-redundant vector components are decomposed by the high frequency PWM xor control pulse based on pulse area equal principle, and the compensation coefficient D is setting to regulate the decomposition ratio to achieve the balance of the neutral point potential. The feasibility and effectiveness of the improved modulation technology and the balance control strategy are verified by simulation and experiments. The simulation and experimental results show that the proposed control algorithm not only reduces the fluctuation of the midpoint potential, stabilizes the output voltage of the DC side, but also reduces the distortion of the current side of the network and it is easy to be implemented.

articleTitle: Feature Perception Customer-Side Load Flexible Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To guarantee a consistent and reliable power supply continues to escalate, there is an increasingly urgent and imperative need to establish robust mechanisms for controlling load capacity, while also ensuring the timely dissemination of notifications and warnings. Starting from the demand for electrical load, this article introduces the recognition technology of operating load characteristics of typical important electrical equipment such as security, medical and basic life equipment, and designs new voltage and current sensors. Through the study of load flexible control technology based on constant power control (PQ control), it realizes the control of non-essential electricity consumption of specific customers according to their electricity consumption characteristics.

articleTitle: GM-HRNet: Human Pose Estimation Based on Global Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks have been widely used for human pose estimation tasks, but with some issues. It is limited to local receptive fields and it is difficult to capture global information. To address this problem, we propose the GM-HRNet network. The network aggregates the multi-stage feature information of HRNet, and makes full use of the criss-cross attention and channel attention to obtain the context information in the space and channel dimensions, and realizes the modeling of the global relationship, so as to effectively locate the keypoints of the human body. In this paper, HRNet is used as a benchmark to conduct experiments on MPII dataset. Experimental results show that the accuracy of GM-HRNet is 1.3 percent higher than that of HRNet under the same experimental conditions, which validates the effectiveness of the GM-HRNet model.

articleTitle: Full Cycle Data Protection Scheme of Power Parameters in Smart Grid Based on Integer Fully Homomorphic Encryption
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Power parameter data protection is an important guarantee for the smooth operation of smart grid. In order to realize the full life cycle data protection of power parameters based on lattice cipher and DALCM model, this paper proposes a full life cycle data protection scheme for power parameters generated by smart terminals in power grids. The scheme in electricity parameter data phase, the electricity parameter for data encryption, the encrypted cryptograph no longer decrypt data in data processing stage, ciphertext survival to data disposal, scheme proposed can provide data security support for the operation of the smart grid, from the perspective of data security to ensure the smooth operation of the smart grid.

articleTitle: Research on OPGW optical cable failure positioning based on distributed sensing technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As the main physical transmission carrier of the power communication network, the power communication optical cable carries various power grid management and production business. If the optical cable fails, it will affect the production and enterprise operation of the power grid. Therefore, the rapid and accurate positioning of OPGW optical cables is of great significance for the security and stability operation of the power communication network. At this stage, OPGW optical cable failure positioning is usually a signal of the distance and attenuation of the OTDR detection failure point and attenuation in the optical time domain reflex. In this article, due to the working principle of distributed sensors, using the comparison core of the optical cable failure and the frequency shift characteristics on the normal core of the norms, the accurate positioning of the optical cable failure is completed, and the accuracy of the optical cable failure positioning accuracy has been reduced from a kilometer level to to the karma level to Rice level.

Author Keywords: Optical fiber composite overhead Ground Wires

articleTitle: Photometric Characteristic Thermogram of Satellites on GEO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In case of no approaches to the satellite’s images, photometric data will be the essential information for Space Domain Awareness (SDA). However, limited by the single data form, the traditional photometric data cannot be fully used to recognize the satellite’s characteristics, despite many intelligent recognition algorithms developed. In this letter, we propose a new data form for the photometric data, which is shown as a two-dimensional image. This image, shown as the thermogram, is built on the observation geometry of the sun, satellite, and detector, which can reflect the specular components' orientation, amount, size, and shape. This new data form can have a great value in SDA combined with the image classification algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation and Grading of Information Security Classification Protection Based on Robot Navigation and 3D Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a grading method for the evaluation of information security level protection based on robot navigation and 3D reconstruction, study and propose a grading evaluation scheme for robot positioning and understanding of the surrounding environment, quickly reconstruct the 3D system of the site environment through the auxiliary evaluation of industrial robots based on ID code positioning, and finally transplant the algorithm to the robot operating system to achieve mobile cruise function in combination with ROS function package and path planning, Multiple threshold adjustments are made to control the evaluation error within a reasonable range. By analyzing the grading of level protection evaluation, the obtained data is calculated to obtain the grading level of relevant institutions' level protection evaluation, which greatly increases the accuracy and execution efficiency of the evaluation.

articleTitle: Satellite Communication Model of Meteorological Messages
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the model of meteorological messages transmission through satellite communication equipment. The principles of maximizing the messages transmission capacity of the device and transmitting the valid information are followed to improve the efficiency of messages transmission when the performance of device is determined. Based on the two principles above, a mathematical model of messages transmission with the fastest messages transmission speed is proposed. The specific steps of messages transmission are listed. The numerical relationships of information amount that needs to be transmitted and number of transmission rounds in different cases are given. Specific examples are included to illustrate the validity of the proposed mathematical model.

articleTitle: Simulation and Verification of Anti-interference Performance of OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing is a multi carrier digital modulation technology that can maximize the utilization of spectrum resources. Starting from the principle of OFDM, this article uses MATLAB simulation to add noise to the signal and verify the difference between the emitted signal and the received signal, simulating the anti-interference performance of the OFDM system, thereby verifying the advantageous performance of the OFDM system.

articleTitle: Innovation Research and Application of Service Chain Model Based on Traffic Security Pool
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the strategic goal of becoming a globally leading energy internet enterprise with Chinese characteristics, the company has deployed an increasing number of security devices on its network exit links in order to monitor and reduce network security risks to the greatest extent possible in the complex and ever-changing network threats and intrusions environment of the new power system. In response to these requirements, the company's research and network security team has developed a new parallel protection mode for the company's network exit security protection equipment, which has transitioned from a series mode to a "firewall + intrusion detection + application protection" parallel mode, while also possessing diverse primary and backup capabilities, as well as sideline monitoring and analysis capabilities and expansion capabilities. This new protection mode has largely addressed most of the network threats and intrusions. This study aims to provide users with high-performance, simple-to-maintain, open, and programmable exit networks. By researching a traffic diversion method and developing a traffic security pool, a service chain model of "physical series and traffic parallel" is formed to solve the pain points of communication interruptions caused by single-point failures, difficulty in conducting communication business due to performance bottlenecks, low utilization rate of security equipment, high security risks and costs, and difficulty in identifying multiple fault points. Thus, the goal of improving the reliability of network security equipment operation and enhancing network performance can be achieved.

articleTitle: FD-Net: A Model Based on Deep Learning for Deep-Sea Fish Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The species and abundance of deep-sea fish play a crucial role in environmental monitoring. In this paper, a new single-stage object detection model FD-Net is proposed, which aims to solve the problem of low accuracy of existing object detection algorithms for deep-sea fish with obscured objects and small objects in complex underwater environments. First, a new multi-scale residual cross-stage partial network (MRCP) is designed to more efficiently capture global information and rich background details. Second, a newly designed pooling module (DmPooling) and a lightweight dual-channel attention convolution module (DACM) are introduced into the feature fusion network to increase the range of receptive fields in the deep and shallow network layers, enhancing the network's attention to important features. The results demonstrate that FD-Net achieves a mean average precision (mAP) of 65.3% in the task of deep-sea fish detection. Moreover, the detection accuracy of FD-Net surpasses that of the mainstream YOLO series object detection model. These findings provide a valuable reference for the detection of deep-sea fish.

articleTitle: Container monitoring method for Kubernetes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Container monitoring is one of the core elements to ensure the normal operation of container infrastructure. However, the current container monitoring Angle is relatively simple, and there is still a lack of intuitive and effective methods to assist operation and maintenance personnel to quickly locate the cause of service container anomalies. In this paper, a container three-dimensional monitoring system for Kubernetes is designed and implemented. Through the correlation analysis of monitoring indicators, the indicators with strong correlation are provided to operation and maintenance personnel as the core indicators of three-dimensional monitoring, so as to realize the overall monitoring of containers better.

articleTitle: Secure communication in cognitive wireless systems for UAV based on NOMA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the scarce frequency spectrum in wireless communication systems, a Cognitive Radio-Non-orthogonal Multiple Access (CR-NOMA) network is proposed in this paper. Without affecting the primary user system and considering the existence of eavesdroppers, we research the secure transmission rate from the second system. Among them, we use Unmanned Aerial vehicle (UAV) serves as a mobile relay and a jammer. Based on the joint optimization of UAV flight path and transmission power, a power distribution factor is proposed to allocate the transmission power of UAV. Since the problem we proposed is non-convex, it is difficult to obtain the optimal solution. In order to solve this problem, we transform it into convex constraints by constructing a function, and use an iterative algorithm of successive convex approximation to solve it. The simulation results indicate that this scheme can obtain a local optimal solution and effectively improve the security performance of the system.

articleTitle: Min BCI algorithm for PRF Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In pulsed Doppler radar, the use of a single pulse repetition frequency will cause a blind zone on the distance-velocity map detected by the radar, and the use of a set of pulse repetition frequencies can effectively reduce the blind zone. The design of pulse repetition frequencies combination will directly affect the effect of reducing the blind zone, but due to the large number of different combinations, the problem of selecting the most ideal pulse repetition frequencies set is NP hard. you can only search for the desired solution in a certain way within the feasible domain through constraints and optimization objectives. Evolutionary algorithms are widely used in the selection of pulse repetition rate combinations, but due to the non-convexity of the problem, this method is blind and computational complexity. In this regard, this paper proposes a minimum blind zone center spacing (Min-BCI) algorithm, based on the principle of blind zone formation, it is believed that the entire blind zone is composed of several strip-like blind zones in the time domain and frequency domain, each strip blind zone has a center, and in the time domain and frequency domain these centers are periodically appearing, by setting the minimum value of the tolerable blind zone center interval, the blind zone of different pulse repetition frequencies is staggered as much as possible, and the appropriate pulse repetition frequencies combination is found in order from large to small according. The search range of the desired solution is reduced by the constraints of the minimum dead zone center interval and the order determination of the pulse repetition frequency within the set. Simulation results show that the minimum blind zone center interval method finds a feasible solution faster and more accurately, and has significant advantages over the evolutionary algorithm in terms of convergence speed and pulse repetition rate combination.

articleTitle: Robot Grasp Detection Based on Oriented Reppoints With Angle Refinement Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In contemporary robotics applications, the detection and operation of visual targets are crucial research topics, and robot grasp detection serves as a prerequisite. However, existing research on this subject encounter significant issues concerning large angular errors in detection outcomes. To address this challenge, we propose an oriented reppoints-based robot grasp detection approach, integrating an angle refinement strategy. The proposed method employs an oriented reppoints network to obtain rough grasping rectangles, followed by an angle regression network to refine the angular error of the grasping frame. We evaluate the proposed method on the Jacquard public dataset, and the experimental outcomes demonstrate its excellent detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Mass Transfer through the Interface between Catalyst Layer and Separator in PEMFCs under flooding/drying conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The stability of proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) is significantly influenced by the structure, water content, and interfacial component transport of the cathode catalytic layer. Therefore, it is crucial to pay attention to and control these factors during the design and optimization process. However, there has been a lack of comprehensive research on the component transport and structural evolution at the interface between the cathode catalytic layer and separator under conditions of flooding/drying. Thus, the molecular dynamics model of the interface between the separator and cathode catalytic layer has been established to reflect the flooding/drying state of PEMFC by varying water content. The transport characteristics of water, hydrogen hydrate ions, and oxygen are analyzed at room temperature (303K), while also examining the structural evolution of the interface between the separator and catalytic layer. The results indicate that the diffusion coefficients of water molecules, hydronium ions, and sulfonic acid groups increase with increasing model water content due to competition between substances and dilution of high water content. However, oxygen diffusion coefficients gradually decrease due to reduced space and oxygen dissolution. Meanwhile, the radial distribution function of various substances is analyzed to verify the accuracy of the diffusion coefficient.

articleTitle: Repeated Proof of Single Work Consensus Algorithm Based on Behavior Values
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The proof-of-work consensus algorithm (PoW) ensures security by exhaustive search for difficulty values that meet the requirements, but there are problems such as waste of resources and slow block output speed. To address the above problems, the repeated proof of single work consensus algorithm (RPoSW) based on behavior values is proposed. Specifically, in the mining phase, the behavioral value is introduced based on the mechanism of dynamically adjusting the difficulty of mining, and the work of single mining determines the attribution of two rounds of bookkeeping rights. Reusing computing power in the mining process can reduce the consumption of resources, and introducing behavioral values can avoid relying solely on node computing power when selecting bookkeeping nodes. In the verification phase, the authoritative nodes with the top ranking in the behavior value list are selected to participate, which ensures the credibility of the verification environment and reduces the verification time. In addition, the reward and punishment mechanism of economy and reputation(RPoER) is proposed, which can increase the cost of nodes committing malicious behaviors. Through theoretical and experimental analysis, RPoSW can resist nodes from committing malicious behaviors and ensure system security while greatly saving arithmetic power.

articleTitle: Preliminary exploration of auditory cognitive processes based on EEG
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: During the treatment of deaf-mums, it has been found that patients with prelinguistic deafness still cannot recognize what they hear after cochlear implants. That’s because the neural circuitry between the auditory cortex and the cognitive cortex is not activated effectively as they develop. The current treatment to improve hearing cognition is to force patients to adapt a large number of different tones of word stimulation and music listening training. However, these methods still have the problem of low efficiency and low activation of neural circuits. To solve this problem, we need to identify the areas of the cortex that are activated effectively in the process of perceiving sound, processing sound. In this study, we analyzed the EEG data collected during hearing test, we calculated the correlation of brain regions and analyzed activation in normal human auditory tests based on ICA after noise removal using time-frequency analysis and pearson correlation. We observed the activation process of brain regions in the process of auditory processing, and found the effective activation region of the brain. In the future, we will further investigate the relationship between the activated regions of the brain.

articleTitle: Research on passive anti islanding protection method for distributed photovoltaic power generation based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Distributed photovoltaics are mainly connected to low-voltage distribution networks of 35kV and below. When the power grid malfunctions, conventional distributed photovoltaics island protection methods have issues of island discrimination failure and unreliability, posing serious challenges to the safe and stable operation of the power grid. This paper proposes a new passive island recognition method based on deep learning to address the problem of complex and redundant feature selection and large blind spots in distributed photovoltaic island events. And compared with traditional anti islanding protection methods, simulation results show that this method can improve the accuracy of distributed power islanding detection and reduce detection blind spots.

articleTitle: An intelligent 5G interference identification scheme based on multi-source data fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: 5G has the advantages of large bandwidth, low delay, and wide connection, providing strong support for sensing acquisition and interactive control equipment access, data transmission, and online interaction in all aspects of the power grid. The open transmission environment of wireless communication leads to the interference of space electromagnetic waves. Timely detection and diagnosis of interference types and effective measures are the key to ensure the reliable operation of power 5G services. In this paper, an improved SNN neural network is designed to diagnose interference types in 5G bearer power applications. By integrating network topology, terminal position information and air port signal quality data collection, the diagnosis accuracy is effectively improved.

articleTitle: Design of missile longitudinal controller based on deep deterministic policy gradient learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the longitudinal control problem of missiles under highly nonlinear conditions, traditional controllers designed by fixed points have good static characteristics, but in the face of highly nonlinear systems, the control parameters designed at a certain characteristic point will not be able to satisfy the entire control system. In this paper, a combination of reinforcement learning and deep neural network architecture is used to propose an intelligent adaptive controller design scheme based on a deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm. Firstly, the control problem is reconstructed in the framework of deep reinforcement learning. The environment is composed of a two-degree-of-freedom nonlinear model of missile longitudinal dynamics. Secondly, the design of the reward function not only considers the stability of the longitudinal dynamics, but also uses the ITAE index as the reward function. The penalty item is to comprehensively consider the balance of error and execution output. Finally, simulation results are shown to check the ability of the proposed data-driven method to achieve the specified closed-loop response in a fully model-free manner under a complete flight condition, and the method is verified by model parameter-pull Monte Carlo simulations. Feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Intelligent Indoor Brightness Control System using ESP-8266 Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper presents an intelligent control system for indoor brightness, designed based on the ESP8266 development board. The system combines conventional control methods with automatic adjustment of indoor brightness based on environmental detection, and features the function of remote control based on the MQTT communication protocol. Experimental results demonstrate that the system can effectively adjust brightness in response to instructions, whether issued remotely or locally. In automatic mode, the system can adapt to various indoor conditions and adjust brightness accordingly. The system is sensitive to environmental factors and shows promising practicality for indoor brightness control in the future. Overall, the proposed system provides a robust and intelligent solution for indoor brightness control, leveraging the capabilities of the ESP8266 development board and MQTT communication protocol.

articleTitle: Comparison of Three Machine Learning Algorithms for Cardiovascular Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore the application of machine learning algorithms in cardiovascular disease prediction and provide ideas for clinicians to provide scientific aids for decision making. The gender, age, heart rate and other indicators of 13434 physical examination patients from May 1, 2021 to April 30, 2023 in a tertiary hospital in Tianjin were statistically analyzed, and a retrospective study method was used to establish Logistic, SVM and XGBoost models to model and predict whether the physical examination patients had disease, and a grid search algorithm was used to find the optimal parameters for the relevant models. The accuracy and AUC of the Logistic algorithm were optimal for the case of 8 input features, and the prediction of Logistic was also optimal for the case of 6 features, followed by XGBoost, which outperformed the other two algorithms for 4 feature variables, and the overall performance of the model after tuning was slightly better than that before tuning. Machine learning algorithms can provide a certain degree of decision support in disease prediction and can improve the efficiency of physicians.

articleTitle: Metal Surface Defect Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of model misdetection and missed detection caused by the small defect and unclear features of industrial metal surfaces, this paper studies a large number of metal surface defects, and proposes a metal surface micro defect detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv5. First, this paper uses the FenceMask data enhancement method for regularization to solve the problem of few sample images. Then an enhanced multi-scale feature fusion pyramid network DS-FPN is proposed by introducing depthwise separable convolution, dilated convolution and spatial attention mechanism, so that the model can improve the ability to extract key information of images without adding additional parameters and calculations. An adaptive channel spatial attention mechanism SCBAM is also proposed, which adds non-local information to the original interaction with only local information, improving the feature expression ability of the model. Finally, through experimental verification, the detection accuracy of the model in this paper on the public data set GC10-DET has reached 74.9%, which is 4.7% higher than the original YOLOv5 model.

articleTitle: Radar Faint Target Detection Based on Keystone Transform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of new high-tech research, new challenges are posed to radar detection technology, especially for faint targets such as unmanned aircraft, which are widely used in recent years and are the key problems and hot issues in the field of radar detection. In view of the characteristics of faint targets such as unmanned aircraft, firstly, the echo sequence of faint targets is filtered out of stationary clutter by Moving Target, Indication (MTI), and then the phase reference is accumulated by correcting the distance walk based on the keystone transform method to complete the detection of targets.

articleTitle: Human Action Recognition Based on Residual Networks with Improved Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the current deep learning methods in human movement recognition, there are problems of high number of parameters and insufficient feature extraction., this paper proposes a residual network incorporating improved attention mechanism for human behavior, which introduces an attention mechanism into the residual network and the multilayer vector machine for the channel attention module was replaced using a one-dimensional convolutional, which reduces the feature loss and the parameter number at the same time, and replaces the convolution for the spatial attention module with a dilated convolution, which expands the sensory field. The recognition accuracies of this paper are 66.7% and 96.5% on the public datasets HMDB51 and UCF101, respectively, and the recognition accuracies are improved by 7.3% and 8.5%, respectively, compared with the traditional deep behavior recognition method TwoStream.

articleTitle: DeepSORT Pedestrian Tracking Algorithm based on Azimuth Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that pedestrian tracking accuracy is not high and identity exchange is frequent in complex road environments, this paper proposes an improved DeepSORT target tracking algorithm combining azimuth estimation and feature moving average (FMA) feature association strategy. The algorithm uses Kalman filter algorithm to predict and update the detection results in real-time, so as to realize the classification and tracking of the same category in the video. To solve the problem of feature extraction in the tracking process, this paper adopts the FMA to extract the features of the current frame detection frame and calculate the average value of the previous frame features, so as to improve the correlation degree of features between video frames. At the same time, in order to better locate the position information of the detection frame and the prediction frame in the process of cascade matching, this paper puts forward the azimuth estimation and applies it to the cost matrix to make the detection frame match the optimal prediction. The experimental results show that MOTA, MOTP and other indexes of the proposed algorithm are greatly improved, and the frequency of identity exchange is also reduced to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Traffic Recognition and Reconstruction Technology Based on SDN Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of technologies such as the Internet of Things, cloud computing, and big data, network traffic will continue to show explosive growth trends. SDN technology can help network administrators better manage and optimize networks. In the future, SDN technology will be widely used in fields such as data center networks, enterprise networks, and operator networks, and will become one of the important directions for the development of network technology. By centralizing the network controller in a central position, SDN technology realizes centralized control of network traffic, thereby improving network flexibility and manageability. SDN technology can dynamically optimize and manage network traffic to achieve efficient utilization of network resources and reduce network operation costs. By using cloud platform switch intelligence to arrange collected traffic, the outbound traffic at the network boundary can form a secure traffic resource pool, providing users with high-performance, easy-to-manage, open and programmable egress networks, which can perfectly solve all the difficulties faced by the serial deployment of outbound security devices.

articleTitle: A path to implementing a fresh produce e-commerce customer segmentation method based on clustering algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The rise of e-commerce has revolutionized the way consumers purchase goods, including fresh produce. With the increasing demand for fresh produce online, it is important for businesses to understand their customers and tailor their offerings to meet their needs. One way to achieve this is through customer segmentation, which involves dividing a customer base into groups of individuals that share similar characteristics. In this paper, we propose a method for implementing a fresh produce e-commerce customer segmentation method based on clustering algorithms. Which is k-means, can be used to partition customers into distinct groups based on their purchasing behavior and preferences. By analyzing these groups, businesses can gain insights into the needs and wants of their customers and develop targeted marketing strategies to increase customer satisfaction and loyalty. Our proposed method involves several steps. First, data on customer purchasing behavior and preferences is collected and pre-processed. Next, a clustering algorithm is applied to partition the data into distinct groups. The resulting clusters are then analyzed to identify common characteristics and patterns among customers in each group. Finally, targeted marketing strategies are developed based on the insights gained from the analysis. The potential benefits of implementing this method are numerous. By understanding the needs and wants of their customers, businesses can tailor their offerings to meet those needs and increase customer satisfaction. Additionally, targeted marketing strategies can help businesses attract and retain customers, leading to increased loyalty and repeat business.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Automatic Operation and Maintenance Management Tool for Power Firewall
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer network technology, the application range of firewalls has become increasingly widespread, and it has penetrated into various fields.With the construction of the company's ubiquitous power Internet of Things, various types of ubiquitous businesses are rapidly deployed and launched, and the number of boundary access control devices firewalls is rapidly increasing. Firewall operation and maintenance work also faces problems such as multiple types of firewalls, tens of thousands of policies, complex deployment structures, and cumbersome application and opening processes. The efficient operation and maintenance of firewall equipment has become a key factor affecting the efficiency of network security operation and maintenance work.This article develops a set of firewall automation operation and maintenance tools to improve the efficiency of firewall fault handling and policy configuration, greatly shorten the opening time of firewall policies, and greatly enhance the company's network security protection capabilities.

articleTitle: MANet: End-to-end MIMO wireless communication network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: MIMO technology has emerged as a critical foundational technology for 5G and 6G communication systems due to the fast growth of mobile communication technology. However, for assuring optimal performance, precise channel estimate and efficient channel status information feedback are crucial. In this paper, we use deep neural networks to enhance the performance of MIMO channel estimation in OFDM systems. To build an end-to-end MIMO wireless communication system, we suggest a channel estimator based on MLP-mixer, with CSI feedback employing multi-head attention as the backbone network. In the channel estimation stage, Smooth_L1 serves as the loss function, cosine similarity serves as the loss function in the feedback stage, and NAdam serves as the training optimization method. Using simulation data from high-density and low-density pilot signals, performance analyses and comparisons with conventional estimators like LS and MMSE, as well as neural network techniques like CNNNet, were carried out. According to the results, the suggested MANet works well on OFDM MIMO communication systems when it comes to dense and sparse pilot estimate and CSI feedback.

articleTitle: Analysis and Preventive Measures of Power Increase Caused by Voltage Transformer Loss Fault
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: V/V-12 wire voltage transformer is widely used in ungrounded neutral and high impedance grounded systems, and is usually used for 10kV high supply and high meter users. When the voltage transformer has a voltage loss fault, it will cause measurement errors, and there are risks such as measurement misalignment and power supply service complaints. This paper analyzes the change of the curve data of the acquisition system after the failure of voltage transformer, which causes the power increase in the user of 10kV high supply and high meter using V/V-12 connection voltage transformer. Combined with the nature of the load to calculate the power supply, the paper put forward detailed preventive measures to effectively prevent various risks.

articleTitle: Research on Client Transformation and Upgrade Technology for 3D GIS Modeling Based on Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to promote the optimization and improvement of the basic information platform of Fujian Electric Power, further enhance the construction ability of the GIS platform for a single map, solve the problem of online abnormal editing of low voltage distribution networks in Fujian, promote the construction of low voltage automation, and improve the efficiency of collaborative command in operation, distribution, and dispatch. Fujian Electric Power conducts in-depth research and analysis on the problems existing in GIS platform in map application, system performance, and functional application. It is aimed at improving the basic map application capabilities, reduce the threshold for grid equipment graphic modeling, innovate thematic map storage and application modes, optimize the efficiency of abnormal release, and improve system usability. GIS lightweight web modeling tools address the problems of low efficiency in client graphics editing and heavy manual adjustment workload, in order to comprehensively reduce the workload of grassroots employees, improve work efficiency, and achieve a win-win situation of reducing burden and increasing efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Speech Enhancement Algorithm based on Objective Evaluation
