publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Different speech enhancement algorithms perform differently in different noise environments, and have their own advantages and disadvantages. By reasonably evaluating the performance of speech enhancement algorithm in different noise environments, it is helpful to improve the algorithm and select suitable application scenarios. In this paper, speech enhancement algorithms based on different principles are considered. For white noise, factory noise and coffee shop noise, three representative speech enhancement algorithms are selected, including frequency domain wiener filtering and improved subspace method. PESQ objective evaluation method is used to evaluate the performance indicators of different speech enhancement algorithms in terms of signal to noise ratio improvement and objective evaluation.

articleTitle: Application of cloud edge collaborative architecture in power information system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the acceleration of the digital transformation and upgrading of power, more and more edge terminal devices are connected to the power system, and the cloud data center of the power system is faced with a series of challenges such as network overload, service delay, and low resource utilization. Aiming at the above problems, this paper expounds the cloud edge collaboration structure based on SDN, analyzes its key technologies and applies it to the power system, designs the application scenarios of cloud edge collaboration in the power system, verifies the feasibility of the method through experiments, and provides references for the system construction and application of cloud edge collaboration technology in the power system.

articleTitle: Sensitive Detection of Chinese Traditional Medicine Analytes by Combining THz with Metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Terahertz metamaterial have the characteristics of non-ionizing radiation, and are sensitive to weak resonance, so they have excellent performance in biosensor applications. A planar array Ω-shaped ring lies on the surface of a high-resistivity silicon substrate is proposed to address the current need for improving the sensitivity of terahertz band biosensors. This sensor is highly sensitive to the biological samples to be tested attached to its surface. The simulation results show that the sensitivity of the flexible metamaterial biosensor can reach 670 GHz/RIU, and the quality factor can reach 3.6. It can detect artemisinin, the active ingredient of the Chinese herb Artemisia annua and has important application value in the design of terahertz ultra-sensitive biomedical sensors.

articleTitle: SLAM algorithm for indoor scene vision based on RGB-D cameras
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor map construction and low localization accuracy of visual SLAM in complex scenes, this paper introduces a SLAM algorithm for indoor scenes based on RGB-D cameras, which utilizes sensor depth information and colour image information to achieve the construction and real-time localization of 3D maps of indoor scenes. In feature point extraction and information matching, the ORB feature point detection and matching algorithm is used to optimize the localization accuracy. It is demonstrated through experiments that a higher accuracy indoor scene building task is achieved with limited computational resources and provides support for path planning and autonomous navigation of mobile robots.

articleTitle: Self-Cure facial expression recognition based on Coordinate attention and Lsland loss
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Facial expression recognition (FER) is a challenging task. The following two significant problems often exist in real-life FER tasks: first, facial expression images in the wild are uncertain, i.e., occlusion or blurred images; and second, there is little intra-class similarity and high inter-class similarity. In this paper, we propose a Self-Curing network based on Coordinate attention and Island loss(CoIsland-SCN) to address the above two problems. Firstly, the coordinate attention module aggregates the input features in vertical and horizontal directions into two independent direction-aware feature mappings, and the encoded attention contains channel, directional and positional information at the same time, which well solves the facial expression uncertainty problem; secondly, the Self-Cure module performs ranking regularization and relabeling according to the image importance and calculates the cross-entropy loss and the ranking regularization loss; and finally, combines the island loss to adjust the model to solve the problem of poor intra-class tightness and poor inter-class separability. The method proposed in this paper achieves an accuracy of 86.41% on the public dataset RAF-DB, which is very superior compared with recent experiments and proves the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on fault diagnosis of geothermal heat pump based on EEMD and kmeans++
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of technology and sustainable concept, ground source heat pump has gradually emerged in the heating industry, which is a new heating technology with the advantages of clean and high efficiency. However, with the continuous operation of the heat pump system, various faults may occur in the internal equipment of the system, such as evaporator fouling, compressor leakage, refrigerant line blockage, etc. It is of great practical significance to identify the fault types accurately and effectively. In this paper, the signal processing method adopts the ensemble empirical mode decomposition, which decomposes the collected ground source heat pump system signals, retains the relevant modal parameters and removes the residual terms, then evaluates each modal component using the approximate entropy as the feature evaluation index, and clusters the entropy values into feature vectors to determine the fault types. The experimental results show that the algorithm based on the combination of ensemble empirical mode decomposition and clustering can be applied to the fault diagnosis accuracy of ground source heat pump systems.

articleTitle: Bat-like Sonar Target Distance Estimation Based on Fractional Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To address the distance estimation problem in bat-like target localization, the paper investigates and adopts the fractional-order Fourier transform method to estimate the target object distance based on the linear frequency modulation characteristics of the transmitting wave. Firstly, a data acquisition platform is built based on the long-eared bat ear model and a mobile robot to collect the reflected acoustic waves of the target in multiple spatial orientations, then the transmitting wave of each acoustic signal and the audio signal containing the echo are intercepted as the input, and finally the fractional-order Fourier transform method is used to achieve the target distance estimation. The experimental results show that the error of the test set is less than 30cm, The RMSE is 17.22cm, and the distance estimation accuracy is related to the distance of the target and the size of the pitch angle, the former influence is more significant.

articleTitle: AI Decision on Submarine Operation Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Artificial intelligence technology will become the technology that the submarine attack and defense assistant decision-making depends on in the future. This paper defines submarine attack and defense by several assumptions. The attack and defense decisions are made manually according to the situation, and these artificial experiences are sent to the neural network for training. Then the decision effect of AI is tested. Experiments show that in most cases, AI can provide reasonable decision-making schemes instead of human beings.

articleTitle: A Survey of Ex-ante Market Power Analysis Methods in Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The power industry has natural monopoly. In the process of electricity market reform in the electricity market, the market will not and cannot be completely deregulated. Electricity market-oriented reform is an inevitable trend in the development of the electric power industry in all countries in the world. Its purpose is to break the vertical monopoly operation mode of the electric power industry, establish a electricity market on the sale side, and realize the mechanism of bidding for grid connection. The market power analysis in the electricity market is divided into pre-analysis and ex-post analysis, among which the pre-market power analysis is more helpful for market regulators to intervene in the market. This paper summarizes the existing market power analysis methods in the electricity market and analyzes their advantages and disadvantages, and explore the lacking in ex-ante market power analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Remote Update Method of DSP28335 Program Based on CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of DSP program update and reduce the maintenance cost of equipment, this paper takes TMS320F28335 as an example to propose a method for updating remotely the application program based on CAN bus. Firstly, the process of DSP startup is clearly introduced in section II. Then, the principle for updating the application program remotely has been elaborated in section III, including the application program, the bootloader program and relationship between them. Finally, we have clarified the specific steps of this method in section IV. This paper provides a convenient and reliable method of updating program remotely for DSP developers and maintainers.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Algorithm With Adaptive Truncated Concentrated Differential Privacy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence technology, particularly driven by machine learning, has substantially impacted different industries and daily life. Regrettably, as the machine learning parameters are obtained from the mathematical expressions of datasets, Attackers can use these parameters to deduce sensitive information that the data owner with no intention to disclose reveal. Therefore, this paper proposes a novel approach that utilizes differential privacy technology to safeguard model parameters. It introduces an adaptive algorithm that provides differential privacy protection to machine learning. More specifically, this paper utilizes truncated concentrated differential privacy (tCDP) to perturb gradients in the local model training process of participants. Additionally, the algorithm incorporates adaptive step sizes and dynamic privacy budget adjustment techniques to enable the flexible distribution of privacy budgets. Based on the experimental and privacy analyses, the algorithm presented in this paper outperforms DP-AGD, thereby ensuring model effectiveness while preventing privacy leakage in the local models of the participating parties.

articleTitle: Research on a new model of data-driven intelligent law enforcement for transportation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the continuous development and innovation in the field of transportation, the traditional law enforcement model has been unable to meet the comprehensive supervision and enforcement of Moving violation. Therefore, applying data-driven intelligent technology to traffic law enforcement has become a new trend and challenge. By combing the current situation for our country and abroad, analyzing the difficulties and main needs of law enforcement, this paper proposes a new mode of intelligent law enforcement based on data driven transportation, research the overall framework and specific design, and carries out in-depth research and application. With the development of artificial intelligence and big data technology, the new mode of traffic law enforcement will be more intelligent by deeply integrating traffic law enforcement with other related fields.

articleTitle: Distributed PV Consumption Scenario Analysis and Suggestions in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Distributed photovoltaic (PV) shows an explosive growth trend, which brings great challenges to the regulation and management ability of the power system. In this paper, the effects of distributed PV on reactive power, power quality, and short circuit current of a distribution network are analyzed. Then, according to the typical scenario of distributed PV access to the distribution network, the voltage quality solution for the voltage problem is proposed. Finally, the absorption capacity of the distribution transformer, transmission line, and substation are analyzed based on the typical consumption scenarios of different distributed PV. The corresponding solutions proposed for the distributed PV cannot be consumed according to the typical scenarios.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Capacity Configuration Method Based on Substation Load Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Energy storage has been widely used in power systems due to its flexible storage and release of electric energy, mainly for improving power supply reliability, peak load shifting, frequency regulation, smooth renewable energy generation fluctuations, and demand side response. Based on the load characteristics of the substation during the peak load period, the energy storage configuration strategy is divided into two scenarios: maintaining a stable substation load rate during the peak load period and peak-shaving of the substation load curve in this paper. Considering the constraints of energy storage charging and discharging efficiency, energy storage charging and discharging capacity, substation load, and energy storage power, the energy storage capacity configuration, and application method is proposed. Then the system peak shaving and valley filling, and power balance adjustment is achieved, and the load characteristics of the substation are optimized. Finally, the practicability and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by analyzing substation operation data of a real power network.

articleTitle: Research on radar clutter suppression methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to cope with the complex radar operating environment, signal processing in various clutter backgrounds has been started at home and abroad since a long time. Radar clutter suppression methods are a key part of radar signal processing, of which Moving Target Indication (MTI) and Moving Target Detection (MTD) techniques are effective methods in clutter suppression. This paper verifies the implementability of clutter suppression methods by performing clutter processing on measured radar datasets. The effect of the MTI technique on target amplitude suppression is also addressed in conjunction with relevant information. The use of the phase-mean phase cancellation technique weakens the background noise while also greatly preserving the high signal-to-noise ratio of the target, allowing better detection of target velocity using MTD.

articleTitle: Application of WOA-P&O Mixed Algorithm Photovoltaic Maximum Power Tracing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The traditional whale optimization algorithm (WOA) has deficiencies of the high degree of oscillation and low precision of convergence in terms of maximum power point tracing of the photovoltaic array in the partially shaded condition. This paper proposes a kind of algorithm of mixed control (WOA-P&O) that integrates the improved whale optimization algorithm and the perturbation and observation method (P&O) to balance the abilities of global exploration and local development. The Tent chaotic mapping is adopted to initialize the place of WOA population, and the strategy of elite opposition-based learning is used to optimize the population to ensure the diversity of the population during the process of global exploration. Through optimizing the output sequence of the duty ratio and the mechanism of the survival of the fittest of the population, the study accelerates the speed of global exploration and reduces the power oscillation. The result of the simulation test shows that the precision of WOA-P&O tracing can reach 99.9%, and the maximum speed of convergence is 1.042 seconds, with a faster speed of convergence and smaller range of power oscillation.

articleTitle: A Early Warning Model of Electrochemical Energy Storage based on BP-SNN Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the large -scale application of electrochemical lithium battery energy storage storage storage stations and mobile energy storage vehicles, the safety of lithium batteries has attracted increasing attention. Because the lithium battery is very short from thermal abuse to the fire explosion time, how to perform real -time monitoring of the thermal state of the battery in such a short period of time and the early warning related to the energy storage station. In order to strengthen the safety of the lithium battery energy storage system, this article proposes an early early warning technology of lithium battery-based lithium battery-based types of lithium battery models based on BP-SNN fusion neural network models, that is, through multi-sensor fusion technology such as sound waves, using the edge to deploy BP-SNN-based neural network models to shorten the communication delay of sensor data to the computing center, improve data processing speed and efficiency, thereby greatly The early warning accuracy of lithium batteries was improved, and the time of early warning provided valuable time for subsequent fire protection. The results of the simulation results and the actual design of the device show that the method proposed in this article can shorten the warning time by 1.5 seconds, and the accuracy of the early warning to 99.2%can be increased to 99.2%.

articleTitle: Image Inpainting via Edge Information Guided GANs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Deep learning has shown impressive capabilities in image inpainting. Although deep learning-based methods can produce semantically sound and visually realistic results, they often suffer from blurring and artifacts, particularly in regions with significant semantic deficits. To address this challenge, we propose a new three-stage generation model, EIG-GANs, which consists of an edge generation model, a local binary pattern (LBP) generation model, and an image generation model. The edge generation model, which employs U-Net architecture, accurately predicts the edge structure information of the missing region. This information is then utilized by the LBP generation model to obtain better LBP feature information. Finally, the edge and LBP feature information are combined and used as auxiliary information for the image generation model. We test our model on the public datasets CelebA and Paris Street View, and EIG-GANs has demonstrated superior performance compared with other state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Temperature and Aging Compensated Kalman Filter Algorithm for High-Precision Timing System of Microsatellites
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: High-precision system time is crucial for applications in microsatellites, such as satellite-ground and multi-satellite cooperative missions. In practical on-orbit working condition, the frequency of the crystal oscillator in microsatellites varies with its temperature and aging. Traditional solution of timing system using Global Position System Receiver (GPSR) cannot compensate for this frequency offset. Thus, it is necessary to track the varying clock dynamically. In this work, we establish the clock skew model of crystal oscillator, and propose a temperature and aging compensated Kalman filter algorithm (TACK) for high-precision timing system of microsatellites. When the clock source of timing system changes from a constant-temperature crystal oscillator (OCXO) with ±0.01 parts per million (ppm) frequency stability to a temperature compensated crystal oscillator (TCXO) with ±3 parts per million (ppm) frequency stability, experimental and simulation results show that the time accuracy is better than 0.8 ms/d and the calibration time is less than 780s, which is better than the previous method.

articleTitle: Research on the simulation of emergency evacuation of rail transit stations based on Anylogic
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As the epidemic passed and rail operations continued to expand, rail passenger traffic flow also recovered. Due to the complex layout of rail transit station facilities and conflicting passenger lines, passenger evacuation has become a major challenge. The current mainstream simulation analysis mainly focuses on the layout of station facilities and pays less attention to passenger lines. This paper takes a subway station as an example, uses Anylogic simulation software to simulate the evacuation process under emergency situation in the station, finds the evacuation bottleneck by analyzing the simulation process, and finally reduces the intersection and convergence of passenger flow lines by interfering with the flow lines, making full use of the station resources, and reasonably guiding the diversion of pedestrians, and controls the safe evacuation time within 6 minutes. The research results show that: evacuation under the original model conditions, evacuation time cannot meet the requirements; in the optimized model, passenger evacuation time is shortened from 444.6 seconds to 354.8 seconds, with an optimization rate of 25.34%. The research results have some reference value for the design of emergency evacuation of stations with the same structure.

articleTitle: The Fast Super Block Partitioning Algorithm Based on Depth Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The superblock partitioning process based on rate distortion optimization in VP9 is analyzed in depth, and a fast algorithm for superblock partitioning based on deep residual network is proposed. Firstly, we perform statistical analysis on the division depth distribution of superblocks, and conclude that superblock partitioning has a high correlation with image content. Then, the superblock partitioning process is modeled as a classification problem, and a hierarchical deep residual network is designed to predict superblock partitioning. An effective neural network model is obtained through offline training. Experimental results show that under the premise of quality loss within an acceptable range, the method in this chapter can effectively reduce the complexity of VP9 coding.

articleTitle: Design and Research of an Intelligent Pesticide Spraying Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In today's world, agriculture plays an important role in global production. According to the data released by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, about 3.78 billion people in the world are engaged in agriculture or agriculture related work, which accounts for 48.4% of the global population by 2020. In terms of controlling agricultural diseases and pests and weeding, artificial pesticide spraying still occupies a dominant position. Artificial pesticide spraying is not only inefficient, but also affects health and causes environmental pollution. In this paper, a novel pesticide spraying robot is designed, which is equipped with Beidou Global Positioning System and sensor system to realize automatic spraying operation. Compared with the traditional manual spraying, the robot can greatly increase the efficiency of agricultural operations, reduce the amount of agricultural chemicals, reduce the labor intensity of farmers, and reduce the environmental pollution of pesticides. The research and development of the robot has promoted the intelligent development of agriculture.

articleTitle: Structural Design and Simulation Analysis of a Certain Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the use demand of a certain type of equipment, a transmitter equipment with compact structure layout and high heat generation is designed, and structural mechanical simulation and thermal simulation are carried out for this structure. Modal analysis, random vibration analysis and impact vibration analysis all meet the mechanical performance requirements. Thermal simulation shows that the maximum surface temperature of the cold plate is about 72 °C, meeting the usage requirements of less than 85 °C . The transmitter functions normally after various tests, indicating that the simulation results can serve as a design guide.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv3 algorithm for small object detection in remote sensing images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the low detection performance of YOLOv3 algorithm in remote sensing image small target detection, an improved YOLOv3 remote sensing image small target detection algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the problem of insufficient feature extraction of small targets is solved by reconstructing the residual block of darket-53. Secondly, a shallow feature enhancement module is proposed, which expands the receptive field of the shallow feature map and enriches the small target feature information of the shallow network by using the multi-branch cavity convolution structure and attention mechanism. Finally, the EIOU loss function is used to replace the target location loss function in the original algorithm, which makes the model converge quickly and reduces the rate of missing detection. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm has a good detection effect on VisDrone dataset. mAP@0.5 saw a 3.3 percent increase compared to YOLOv3. This shows that the improved algorithm can detect small targets in remote sensing images more effectively.

articleTitle: Research on the air traffic control radar power diagram based on measured data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The radar power diagram is an important indicator proposed for radar, which directly affects combat performance. This article introduces the overall design process and development tools for drawing power diagram based on measured data, and briefly describes the drawing method of power diagram. Using MATLAB and Excel tools, combined with the measured data reported by a certain type of air traffic control radar, the measured radar diagram is plotted using this method, making a beneficial attempt for the application of radar power diagram in practical performance testing.

articleTitle: A Study on Supplier Evaluation and Selection in Iron and Steel Industry Based on TOPSIS and Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This article aims to construct a supplier selection model for JG Company, a large steel head enterprise, based on a random forest algorithm. The model uses a supplier evaluation indicator system that covers four aspects: quality, price, service, and reputation. The model parameters are determined by experiments on the Tempo big data platform, and the optimal number of trees is set to 20. The model is applied to classify 31 suppliers that have not established cooperative relations with JG Company, and the results show that the model has strong comprehensiveness and high accuracy. The model can be used in two scenarios: one is to dynamically evaluate the existing suppliers and adjust the cooperation strategy according to their levels; the other is to identify potential suppliers in the supply market and provide data support for the next cooperation posture and business negotiation.

Author Keywords: Random forest algorithm Steel head enterprise

articleTitle: Burst-Aware Mixed Flow Scheduling in Time-Sensitive Networks for Power Business
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As power grid become more intelligent, it is critical to ensure efficient scheduling of all types of traffic to maintain system security and stability. Unexpected traffic generated by unforeseen events can also impact the normal operation of the network. Time-sensitive networks (TSN), which are deterministic network technologies, provide various traffic scheduling mechanisms that ensure the safe transmission of critical traffic. To address the challenges posed by bursty flows, we propose a hybrid traffic delivery mechanism that efficiently schedules bursty flows. This mechanism allocates a portion of bandwidth to the ATS mechanism, while scheduling time-sensitive flows and common bandwidth flows separately using the gated list of the TAS mechanism and the mapped time slot adjustment of the CQF mechanism. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed BASM mechanism can schedule more flows with the same parameter settings than other mechanisms discussed in this paper, and can efficiently schedule burst flows with a success rate of over 94%. As a result, our mechanism enables efficient scheduling of mixed flows that include bursty flows.

articleTitle: Sim-YOLO: A Real-time Chinese Scene Text Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This article proposes an Sim-YOLO based Chinese scene text detection method to address the issues of large model size, poor real-time performance, and low robustness in the existing text detection networks in Chinese scenes. Firstly, a general attention mechanism called SimAM is added to the feature enhancement network (Neck) layer to enhance the feature fusion capability in practical problems. Then, the original CIoU Loss is improved by using EIoU Loss to solve the problems of slow convergence and unsatisfactory convergence results. Focal Loss is also incorporated to address the issue of imbalanced difficult and easy samples. Through practical tests, the results show that on the public dataset ICDAR RCTW-17, the accuracy is improved by 4.6%, recall is improved by 2.1%, and FPS (frames per second) has decreased by 2.1, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed improvements. The improved model has a smaller size, stronger real-time performance, and can meet practical needs.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Optimal Control Method for DC/DC Converters in DC Microgrid Based on the Differential Geometry Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The DC/DC converter in the DC microgrid is the core device that supports the efficient grid connection of power electronic drive devices such as new energy generation units and energy storage devices. In view of this, this paper proposes a nonlinear optimal control method for DC/DC converters based on differential geometry theory, aiming at the nonlinear characteristics of the mathematical model of the converter. First, the topology structure of the DC microgrid is analyzed, and the mathematical model of the DC/DC converter is established; Secondly, the basic principle of power system nonlinear control based on differential geometry theory is discussed, and the nonlinear optimal controller for DC/DC converter is designed based on the accurate linearization method in differential geometry theory to quickly suppress power disturbance and realize the efficient grid connection application of power electronic drive equipment. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed nonlinear optimal method were verified based on MATLAB/simulink.

articleTitle: Abnormal Behavior Recognition Based on Skeleton Key Points
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Being aimed at the problem that most of the graph convolutions do not make full use of the context information of the skeleton data, resulting in the low accuracy of similar abnormal line recognition, this paper proposes an improved adaptive graph convolution algorithm for abnormal behavior recognition, which introduces multi-head attention on the basis of adaptive graph convolution. In addition, in order to extract multi-scale features in the network more effectively, multi-scale features in time series are extracted with the help of hole convolution with different expansion coefficients, and multi-scale features are adaptively fused through the attention mechanism. Experimental results show that the multi-head attention adaptive graph convolutional network achieves 76.0% accuracy in abnormal behavior recognition.

articleTitle: Branching Time Series Prediction Method based on CNN and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Time series data, an increasingly common form of data in real-world applications, is typically time-dependent. Time series forecasting seeks to extract potential information from time series data to forecast future trends. The complexity and nonlinearity of current time series data make it difficult for traditional forecasting algorithms to handle them, hence this paper suggests a branching time series forecasting method based on convolutional neural network (CNN) and long short-term memory network (LSTM). The method initially uses CNN to extract features from time series data, then uses CNN and LSTM to map these features to future prediction values, and lastly inputs to the fully connected layer to obtain the prediction results. According to the experimental findings, the branching prediction method based on CNN and LSTM has superior time series prediction accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Network Topology Identification Algorithm Based on Distribution Variable Measurement Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The distribution network is located at the end of the power system and is an important link connecting the transmission system and users. The observability and controllability of the distribution system are the foundation for its safe and stable operation, and also the guarantee for providing good services to users. During the actual operation of the distribution network, the switch state of the network and the physical parameters of the circuit will dynamically change due to network reconstruction, fault isolation, and other reasons. Nowadays, most of these dynamic topology parameters are obtained through manual calculation and verification, which is costly. This paper takes the medium voltage distribution network as the research object, relying on the distribution network operation measurement data provided by smart meter, constructs the dynamic verification of distribution network line transformer topology based on the topology identification model of deep neural network, and it is verified that the accuracy of the calculated line transformer verification is more than 99.85%.

articleTitle: Application of Image Processing in Piston-connecting Rod Group Surface Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In traditional industry, the detection of the automobile components quality is mainly completed by human eyes. Low detection accuracy, high labor consumption, and slow detection speed are important reasons for the slow development of manufacturing industry. With the continuous upgrading of optical hardware equipment such as industrial lenses and cameras, and the development of image processing technology, machine vision technology has developed rapidly in the field of image detection. Machine vision technology collects images through the imaging system, converts them into digital images by the image acquisition card, and finally detects defects through image processing software. A machine vision approach is proposed to replace traditional manual inspection methods for the detection of piston-connecting rod groups in automobile engines. The surface defects of the piston-connecting rod groups are the research object, with image processing technology as the core. Through image gray-scale transformation, de-noising, median filtering, threshold segmentation, and region of interesting extraction methods, the surface defect detection of piston-connecting rod group was ultimately achieved. It provides a research approach for similar research.

articleTitle: Influencing Factor Analysis on Quality Improvement of Small and Micro Enterprises Based on Regional Economy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Strengthening the quality certification system construction can enable small and micro enterprises to achieve high-quality and sustainable development. During the 14th Five-Year Plan period, some policies solve national economic problems from the perspective of regional economy, actively reduce regional economic differences, and realize regional coordinated development. This paper obtains 6 specific indicators of small and micro enterprise quality improvement from 5639 questionnaires collected from 31 provinces in China (excluding Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan), and divides 31 provinces into eight comprehensive economic zones. Then, we use the Criteria Importance Though Intercrieria Correlation (CRITIC) method to obtain the actual quality improvement effects in eight regions. Considering the differences in industrial structure among provinces, we found that the optimized industrial structure has a certain positive regulatory effect on the quality improvement effect of small and micro enterprises. Finally, based on the above conclusions, we give policy suggestions for improving the quality of small and micro enterprises.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Lighting Control System Based on Vivado Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Intelligent lighting control system is designed based on Vivado-environment. The system can be applied to corridor lighting inside and outside, which includes lighting module, fire alarm module, wind-light complementary power supply module and wireless control module. The control core of FPGA can deal with different environmental data in real time, which realizes the intelligent control and achieves the purpose of saving energy. The design can achieve centralized data acquisition, which has faster response speed and higher stability with a broad application prospect.

articleTitle: Research on Solar F10.7 Index Prediction Based on Feature Extraction and Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The solar F10.7 index represents the level of solar activity and is one of the important input driving parameters for the MSIS model in the thermosphere. Accurately predicting the F10.7 index is beneficial for improving the prediction accuracy of atmospheric density, and is crucial for space missions such as spacecraft orbital forecasting. The F10.7 index prediction method mainly includes physical model based prediction, statistical prediction, and machine learning based prediction. Due to the complex physical mechanism of atmospheric density changes, physical model based F10.7 index prediction methods often make many assumptions and simplifications, and their prediction accuracy is currently difficult to meet practical requirements. Statistics based predictions often only discover the low-order correlation between the F10.7 index and a limited number of impact factors. Machine learning can discover higher-order features and nonlinear correlations from data. In this paper, an F10.7 index machine learning prediction method based on feature extraction and fusion is studied. The feature vector templates are used to extract nonlinear features from the historical F10.7 index observations of the last three solar rotations, and then the features are fused to obtain the predicted F10.7 index values for the next three days. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively perform short-term forecasting of the F10.7 index, with an average percentage error of 6.7% for a 3-day advance forecast.

articleTitle: Segment Matching Localization Method with Semi-Dynamic Object Removal based on Prior Map
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As one of the key technologies in autonomous driving, global localization holds crucial research significance and value. Most laser SLAM methods typically focus on mapping static environments, practical applications often involve encountering semi-dynamic objects such as parked cars or pedestrians along the roadside. During subsequent localization, these semidynamic objects may have departed or new vehicles and pedestrians that were not originally present in the map could appear. These semi-dynamic objects can introduce disparities between the map and the real-time point cloud, resulting in significant errors in subsequent localization. In response to this problem, this paper proposes a method for segment matching with semi-dynamic object removal.The method consists of two steps: Firstly, manually control the vehicle to navigate the environment and save RTK- GPS, LiDAR, and IMU data to create a high-precision prior map offline. Secondly, based on the prior map, we utilize the map and real-time point clouds after removing semi-dynamic objects as input point clouds for the NDT (Normal Distribution Transform) algorithm to perform matching. The aim is to enhance the matching accuracy of real-time point clouds per frame using NDT, thus improving localization precision and robustness.

articleTitle: Characteristics of IGBT Devices Considering Various Parasitic Parameters and Construction of Refined Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Under the background of the carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals , we will vigorously develop the new energy power generation industry. The wind and solar power stations need to interact with the power grid through converters, and the HVDC and VSC-HVDC technologies are becoming more mature, and it is bound to introduce a large number of converter equipment dominated by power electronic devices. The power grid is developing towards a new power system with high proportion of new energy and high proportion of power electronics. In order to further improve the performance of the converter, semiconductor switch tubes, as an important part of the converter, have become the focus of attention. In practical projects, the more widely used switching device is still IGBT (Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor). At present, modeling and simulation are common methods for studying and analyzing IGBT switching devices. Using accurate models can accurately predict the characteristics of the switching devices, providing strong guidance for topology design of inverter and parameter tuning of control system. Therefore, based on Saber simulation platform, the mathematical model of static characteristics of IGBT is derived through the first equivalent circuit of IGBT. For the nonlinear parasitic capacitance existing in IGBT, the mathematical description is carried out respectively through hyperbolic tangent function, piecewise nonlinear fitting and other methods to build a more accurate simulation mathematical model and improve the reliability of IGBT analysis model.

articleTitle: Two Methods for Analyzing Material Uniformity in the Process of Feeding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The online medication dosing methods in large-scale pig farms are diverse. Ensuring the uniformity of solid material dosing based on specific ratios can be a challenging task. This paper examines two approaches to assess the uniformity of such equipment: weighing and image processing. The traditional weighing method employed for material quantification analysis can lead to significant time spans and is susceptible to erroneous data due to material accumulation and collapse. In contrast, the image analysis strategy based on the Canny algorithm offers a non-contact approach, effectively reducing analysis time and remaining unaffected by material accumulation, thereby providing a novel perspective on equipment dosing uniformity.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Effectiveness of Quality Management System Certification of Small and Micro Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The high-quality development of small and micro enterprises is inseparable from the improvement of quality management system. Therefore, this paper conducts a questionnaire survey on the quality management system certification level of small and micro enterprises in 2022, and takes it as the data, CRITIC-TOPSIS model is used to identify high-weight indicators. On this basis, the improvement effect of the industry in each indicator is evaluated. The research results show that the improvement effect is remarkable in four aspects : product quality level, customer satisfaction, technological process and working environment. From the perspective of the industries participating in the questionnaire survey, there are great differences, and the participation of the manufacturing industry is relatively high. Finally, based on the research results, we put forward some suggestions on how to further realize the comprehensive development of quality management system from two aspects of government and enterprise.

articleTitle: Research on mixing efficiency model of static mixer based on machine learning and flow field simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To address the low efficiency associated with traditional optimization design methods, machine learning was introduced into the research on structural optimization of static mixers in this paper. Flow field data of the static mixer was acquired using the Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) method. A quantitative evaluation mechanism was developed, taking into account the physical properties of mixing efficiency. Subsequently, the mixing efficiency was accurately assessed using the simulation results of the flow field. Correlation data samples between mixing efficiency and structural parameters were collected. A neural network was employed to establish a correlation between the key structural parameters of the mixer and the overall mixing efficiency.

articleTitle: Key Parameters Design of Emergency Duty Tugboat in the Yangtze River
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: During the main flood season of the Yangtze River, the water flow conditions in the navigation section between the Three Gorges and Gezhouba will rise, resulting in an increase in the risk of ship deviating from voyage route or ship crash. These risk events affect the safe operation of Gezhouba. To ensure the safe operation of Gezhouba Dam, it is necessary to set up emergency tugboats to deal with the risk of ship deviation from voyage route or ship collision with the dam. Based on the analysis of the characteristics of Gezhouba lock passing ship, the risk classification of ship emergency is carried out, and the key water areas of medium and high-risk events are determined. Based on the characteristics of lock passing ships, types of risk events and the timeliness requirements of rescue in key waters, the functional configuration suggestions of the emergency duty tugboat in the upstream of Gezhouba are put forward which include ship speed, power, and salvation function.

articleTitle: Design of a Crop Disease Identification System Based on LabVIEW Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A crop disease detection method suitable for modern agricultural greenhouses is proposed in this paper. Based on the principle of machine vision detection technology and LabVIEW software program, the disease recognition and detection on the surface of potted crops can be quickly achieved. The system first preprocesses the image, and through processes such as system calibration and image correction, grayscale histogram analysis, threshold segmentation, particle analysis and processing, feature analysis, and pattern matching, it achieves rapid recognition of crop diseases. When performing threshold segmentation on images, this system introduces a background correction algorithm to preprocess the images. The image recognition method for crop leaf diseases studied in this article makes monitoring and formulating pest control measures more effective.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Boiler Combustion System Based on Intelligent Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This article proposes a combustion system model for power plant boilers based on the BP neural network algorithm, and the feasibility of this model is demonstrated through verification of the combustion system model. On this basis, a combustion system optimization model based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm was proposed, which optimizes the NOx emissions and boiler efficiency of the boiler, while also balancing the NOx emissions and boiler efficiency. The results show that the optimization model can achieve good optimization results.

articleTitle: TeleNG-CNOS: A Service-Based System that Combines Self-Adaptive and Multi-center Disaster Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For SBS systems, adaptive ability is becoming increasingly important. In order to better study and evaluate adaptive strategies, predecessors have proposed some prototype systems, but none of them are suitable for SBS systems deployed in multiple centers. We propose TeleNG-CNOS based on the background of the operator's business support system, which considers both adaptive capabilities and deployment of disaster recovery strategies. Pave the way for future research on adaptive strategies, and also hope to provide a solution for similar SBS adaptive systems.

articleTitle: Immersing in A Film: A Colorization Method Based on Chinese Film Aesthetics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Colorization is the process of transforming grayscale images into vibrant and realistic ones by adding color. To enhance the aesthetics of colorization methods, this paper proposes an improved image colorization model based on the GAN generative prior, which considers the colorization task from the perspective of Chinese film style for the first time. The model follows an "encoder-generator-discriminator" architecture and incorporates a style injection block, which conditions the generation process on film styles from different classes. By using a pretrained generation model, our method can manipulate latent code for both prior generation and colorization purposes. Moreover, we have introduced a weighted layered feature loss, which is particularly effective in coloring portraits. We have collected and constructed a high-resolution image dataset called " ChineseFilm " , specifically designed to capture the unique characters of Chinese films. This dataset serves for training and testing. Experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method, especially in conveying the distinctive style of Chinese films to faded images. We believe that our work contributes to the promotion and preservation of Chinese culture.

articleTitle: LSTM-based Process Noise Covariance Prediction for AUV Navigation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The significance of process noise covariance cannot be overstated when conducting Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs). Regrettably, there currently exists no direct methods to accurately determine the values of process noise covariance in a specific AUV motion model. As a consequence, the selection of process noise covariance values is often reliant on experiential knowledge or specific experiments, leading to sub-optimal outcomes. Consequently, the implementation of EKF typically falls short of achieving optimal results. In this study, a novel approach for predicting the process noise covariance in an AUV navigation system based on a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network is presented. The LSTM network takes into account the velocity measurements obtained from the Doppler Velocity Log (DVL), as well as the combined acceleration and attitude angle data obtained from the Inertial Navigation System (INS), and provides predictions for the process noise covariance. We have verified the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm through sea trials conducted in Tuandao Bay, Qingdao, China, using the Sailfish-210 AUV. The results demonstrate that the LSTM-based method outperforms the traditional EKF approach, efficaciously reducing errors in AUV position prediction and enhancing navigation accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the Complexity Characteristics of Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to quickly realize the convolutional neural network that meets the given complexity characteristics, a generation algorithm from complex network topology to convolutional neural networks is given. By establishing a series of convolutional neural networks with different topology characteristics, CIFAR 10 and CIFAR10 dataset analysis uses analysis The effects of topological properties such as average aggregation coefficient, average path length, diagram density, and modularity affect the effectiveness of the validity of convolutional neural network recognition. Experiments show that when the number of parameters of the neural network is basically equal, the average cluster coefficient will affect the performance of the convolutional neural network. In the end, in the statistically significant conclusion, the network structure with a small concentration coefficient will have better performance, which provides a theoretical basis for further designing a better convolutional neural network.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Optimization of Active Distribution Networks Based on Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Active distribution networks refer to distribution networks that accommodate a large number of distributed energy resources (DERs) and enable bidirectional power flow. As the scale of active distribution networks expands and the penetration of DERs and electric vehicles increases, traditional reactive power optimization methods face challenges in achieving global optimality and slow computational speed. This paper proposes a novel approach for reactive power optimization in active distribution networks based on the simulated annealing algorithm, offering a new pathway to address reactive power optimization problems.

articleTitle: Investigation into the Comfort of Automotive Seating through the Integration of Affective Engineering Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Applying ergonomics theories to analyze the postures of vehicle occupants and leveraging the principles of affective engineering and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), we design the form of comfortable car seats to meet both the physiological and psychological needs of the occupants. Initially, through market research, we systematically analyze the different postures of the human body in the vehicle under various conditions, and the changes in the physical state of the occupants during vehicle operation. This analysis informs the design of safe seats that conform to ergonomic postures. Subsequently, we embark on affective engineering design for car seats. A broad collection of car seat forms is compiled, with the KJ method employed for classification evaluation. We assemble a dataset of car seat-related images and select appropriate affective vocabulary. Using the Analytic Hierarchy Process, we conduct affective evaluations of the car seats, analyzing the association between affective words and car seat design. Ultimately, combining the theories of ergonomics, we calculate the form of comfortable car seats.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Pressure Controller Display Control System based on WinCE
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the drawbacks of a domestic pressure control system module without the intelligent operation function, this paper mainly uses the high-precision sensor and the pressure control system module, designed a WINCE based modular pressure controller display control system. Firstly, the hardware part of the intelligent pressure controller display and control system is built by using ARM, the touchable display, the pressure control system module, and the high-precision pressure sensor. Secondly, with Windows CE embedded system as the control core, the initialization self-test, measurement control, data display, screen key control, remote control, menu, and other software function modules are designed. Test application results show that the system runs stably, responds quickly, functions reliably, operates simply, and can meet practical work needs.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Internet Teaching in Colleges and Universities Based on Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Internet teaching brings convenience to college students’ autonomous learning, and it brings brand-new innovation to higher education mode. Internet teaching can break through the limitation of teaching time and region. Taking the online course of big data application technology as an example, this paper uses Apriori correlation algorithm to mine students’ online learning records and learning behaviors, designs course content support, and uses correlation matrix after cluster analysis to transform Apriori algorithm, which has great reference value for the guidance of teachers’ teaching time and teaching methods and the cultivation of students’ comprehensive quality.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Charging Guidance Strategy Based on Satisfaction Matching
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The increasing adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) has led to a growing need for efficient and intelligent charging infrastructure. To address the challenges associated with the charging process, this paper proposes a novel Electric Vehicle Charging Guidance Strategy (EVCGS) based on Bilateral Satisfaction Matching (BSM). The primary objective of this research is to enhance user satisfaction by optimizing charging station allocation and scheduling, while also promoting grid stability and minimizing operational costs. By employing a bilateral approach that considers both the EV user’s requirements and the charging station capabilities, the proposed strategy ensures a mutually beneficial charging experience.

articleTitle: Employment Recommendation System Based on User Portrait
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the opening of the era of big data, using big data technology to collect and analyze data, build models and systems according to the needs, has become a research hot spot in various fields. This paper is based on big data technology and user portrait, using 2557 user data and 99997 job data. In order to analysis of the user's target industry and realize the job recommendation, the characteristic engineering is introduced to build accurate user portrait and job information portrait. Otherwise, the paper also uses decision tree, BP neural network and other machine learning model for matching prediction, introducing the distance recommended algorithm framework. This system provides users with 10 high degree of relevant job information, from the technical means to provide the possibility to promote employment.

articleTitle: Electric vehicle charging load forecasting method based on adaptive artificial fish swarm algorithm optimized Long short-term memory network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) charging load forecasting plays a crucial role in optimizing the utilization of energy resources and infrastructure planning. In this paper, we propose a novel method for EV charging load forecasting based on an adaptive artificial fish swarm (AAFS) algorithm optimized long short-term memory (LSTM) network. The AAFS algorithm is utilized to optimize the LSTM network parameters, enabling enhanced accuracy and efficiency in forecasting. The experimental results demonstrate that the AAFS-LSTM model outperforms other methods in terms of accuracy, efficiency, and robustness.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electromagnetic Flowmeter Weight Function of Elliptical Section Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Electromagnetic flowmeter is a reliable and high linearity speed type liquid flow meter. The accuracy of electromagnetic flowmeter is affected by the distribution of the measured fluid. The cross section of the usual electromagnetic flow sensor is circular, which is to ensure that the flow field distribution in the sensor is symmetrical, but in many actual working conditions, it is necessary to use the electromagnetic flowmeter of the different diameter sensor to control the flow process. In this paper, the weight function of the electromagnetic flowmeter of the elliptical section sensor is analyzed, and the intentional conclusion is given. The weight function of the special-shaped sensor and the uneven distribution characteristics of the weight function are revealed, which provides a reference for optimizing the structure of the electromagnetic flowmeter and improving the measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on JAVA Source Code Vulnerability Detection Device Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: By conducting security auditing on source code, the root cause of security issues can be identified, and the system security risk can be reduced after effective repair of vulnerabilities. The existing source code detection methods mainly include tools scanning and manual auditing, both of the above approaches have shortcomings. This article focuses on optimizing the detection method combining static tool scanning and manual auditing, and designs a JAVA source code vulnerability detection device. The device includes a high false positive vulnerability prediction module and a manual auditing auxiliary function module, aiming to reduce the false positive rate of source code vulnerability detection and improve the efficiency and accuracy of manual auditing.

articleTitle: A Novel Data Edge Mining Algorithm With Euclidean Distance Weighted Optimization for Integrated Energy Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The development of new digital traction power system is very rapid. And a large amount of heterogeneous data will be generated from the distribution network edge terminal device under the infiltration of renewable new energy. It will bring great data load pressure to the distribution network operation and maintenance platform. This problem causes data processing delay and makes user-side response unreal-time. For solving this problem, deep data mining and weight removal on the distribution side are needed to reduce. Traditional mining techniques for heterogeneous data generally use data mining methods based on dynamic time regularity. But the disadvantage of this method is that the mining efficiency is too low. It can not be weighted for multi-source heterogeneous data with low similarity. For this reason, this paper presents an edge-side processing algorithm for heterogeneous data based on Euclidean distance weighted optimization, which calculates the similarity between heterogeneous data from multiple sources to eliminate data redundancy, data mining and weighting. Finally, the effect of data mining technology in the edge computing security protection system is analyzed and verified based on the actual sample data of the distribution network comprehensive energy station.

articleTitle: Design of a Three-Loop Attitude Control Autopilot for Quasi-Attack Angle of Static Unstable Guided Rockets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a design method for a three-loop attitude control autopilot for the quasi-attack angle of statically unstable guided rockets. Based on the analytical relationship between control system gain and open-loop cutoff frequency, as well as the damping ratio and poles and zeros, the design method optimizes the desired relative stability margin of the control system. By iterating the optimization calculations with pole placement strategies, it quickly obtains the relevant gain coefficients under the constraint of the desired stability margin. Simulations under various statically unstable conditions show that the designed autopilot can ensure the performance stability of the control system and has significant engineering application value.

Author Keywords: Quasi-attack angle three-loop attitude control autopilot

articleTitle: Adaptive Spurious False Alarm Suppression Method for Airborne Pulse Doppler Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The detection performance of ground targets by airborne pulse Doppler radar is significantly impacted by the pronounced clutter resulting from ground reflections. This, in turn, leads to the presence of spurious signals surpassing the background noise level and generating false targets. To address this issue, this paper introduces an adaptive spurious suppression method suitable for airborne pulse Doppler radar. By comprehensively analyzing the spurious generation process, the proposed method leverages specific frequency and distance characteristics of spurious to dynamically suppress false alarms, with the objective of enhancing radar detection performance. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed approach is subsequently validated through processing and analysis of real data.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning in Data Mining under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the progress of society and the development of science and technology, data has become an indispensable part of human life. Nowadays, people are increasingly inseparable from electronic devices such as mobile phones and computers in their daily lives. With the increase of data, how to mine valuable data is a problem that every enterprise and organization must face. Machine learning is an important technology of data mining, which can process a large number of data and automatically discover the hidden rules and knowledge. In this context, people gradually began to try to apply machine learning technology to data analysis, which made it possible to mine valuable data and brought great benefits to enterprises and organizations. In enterprises, machine learning can be used not only for the classification and prediction of goods in the commercial field, but also for the prediction of markets and customers, helping enterprises to make scientific decisions. Machine learning is an intelligent technology, which uses algorithms and models to learn and analyze data, so as to discover the laws of things and improve work efficiency. The application of machine learning technology in data mining can help enterprises acquire more valuable information and knowledge. For enterprises, the application of machine learning technology to data analysis can not only bring huge benefits to enterprises, but also help enterprises save resources such as manpower and material resources.

articleTitle: Entity Relation Extraction for Bridge Inspection Based on Semi-Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To address the issue of poor performance of conventional methods in entity relation extraction in the field of bridge inspection, we propose a bridge inspection field entity relation extraction method called TriC-training based on semi-supervised learning. It utilizes three classification models for collaborative training to achieve better relation extraction results in the bridge inspection field. In this paper, we use three basic classification models, SVM, KNN, and RF. We trained on a bridge inspection field dataset we constructed ourselves, and the experimental results prove that the proposed method has good extraction performance in relation extraction tasks in the bridge inspection field.

articleTitle: FAM+G: A Feature Fusion Module for Defect Detection in Dunhuang Murals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The task of defect detection has always been a popular research direction in computer vision. In this paper, we implement the defect detection study on Dunhuang murals by adapting the U2-net deep learning model, which is simple and lightweight. And it is widely used in the field of image segmentation. During the research process, we propose a new feature aggregation module FAM+G (Global Feature aggregation module) for improving the detection effect of U2-net on Dunhuang mural defects. The module improves the model’s ability to locate and classify defects by fusing coarse semantic information and fine texture features, which makes the model’s detection results more accurate. The whole experiment process utilizes a self-built Dunhuang mural dataset for training and testing, and the test results have good metrics.

articleTitle: The calculation method of distribution variable measurement data based on household side measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The data of transformer distribution side can not be collected sometimes, and the topological relationship of household transformation in the distribution network is often not known, and the user power data will be missing in the acquisition, transmission and other links, resulting in the pseudo-measurement data can not be accurately calculated. In order to make the pseudo measurement calculation of the variable distribution side more accurate, this paper proposes a method to accurately complete the measurement data collected on the user side when the measurement data of the variable distribution side cannot be collected, and the method of step by step recursion is from the low voltage side to the high voltage side of the variable distribution side. In view of the loss of user-side measurements in different degrees and situations, the corresponding accurate complement method in the article is adopted.

Author Keywords: Low pressure to high pressure conversion

articleTitle: Practical Byzantine fault-tolerant consensus algorithm based on k-Nearest Neighbor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In response to the traditional Byzantine fault-tolerant consensus algorithm, which suffers from performance bottleneck and improper selection of master nodes when the number of nodes increases, this paper proposes a k-Nearest Neighbor based PBFT consensus algorithm, which is called K-PBFT consensus algorithm in this paper. By introducing the k-Nearest Neighbor algorithm, the idea of discarding the master node is adopted to evaluate the behaviour of nodes in consensus, dynamically update the credit value of nodes, classify the node hierarchy and find neighboring nodes for all nodes to communicate so as to complete consensus. Through comparative simulation experimental analysis, the improved algorithm can reduce the time delay and improve the consensus efficiency.

articleTitle: Dynamic Meteorological Model and Diagnosis Method of Wheat Diseases and Pests Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This study focuses on the dynamic monitoring of wheat diseases and pests, and preliminarily constructs a dynamic meteorological model and diagnostic method for wheat diseases and pests.Taking the wheat stripe rust disease in the Huanghuai winter wheat area as an example, based on the occurrence and epidemic characteristics of wheat stripe rust disease and the response characteristics of stripe rust pathogens to climate conditions, a warning model for the possibility of stripe rust disease occurrence and epidemic degree is established using two main meteorological data: air temperature and air humidity. Using real-time data obtained from IoT field monitoring stations, combined with parameters such as wheat varieties and remote pest and disease diagnosis results, can effectively reflect the basic situation of the field, achieve good warning effects, and achieve real-time dynamic monitoring and warning of wheat stripe rust. At the same time, image recognition technology is used to remotely obtain field wheat image information through the Internet of Things platform, achieving classification and recognition of wheat stripe rust, aphids, and healthy wheat leaf images, thus achieving remote diagnosis of wheat diseases and pests. Through experimental comparison, the recognition rate has reached over 95%. It has certain practicality and scalability.

articleTitle: A SoC architecture compatible with Cortex-M4
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: ARM Cortex-M4 is a powerful and widely used processor core in the market today and is favored by many chip companies. This paper designs a SoC chip compatible with the ARM Cortex-M4 core, which is functionally rich and versatile with the core as the centrepiece, connecting multiple general-purpose peripherals and using the AHB and APB buses. This paper analyses the key points of the design process around the overall design architecture of the SoC chip, and introduces the Cortex-M4-based on-chip network structure, on-chip memory mapping method, interrupt system and interrupt priority division, clock network structure, and peripheral and bus connection methods. The SoC chip designed in this paper has been successfully flowed, and the functional tests on the flowed chip have all passed, verifying that the SoC chip is correctly designed and can be used in many fields such as industrial and automotive applications.

articleTitle: Full Cycle Data Protection Scheme of Power Parameters in Smart Grid Based on Lattice Encryption
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Power parameter data protection is an important guarantee for the smooth operation of smart grid. In order to realize the full life cycle data protection of power parameters, based on lattice cipher and DALCM model, this paper proposes a full life cycle data protection scheme for power parameters generated by smart terminals in power grids. The scheme in electricity parameter data phase, the electricity parameter for data encryption, the encrypted cryptograph no longer decrypt data in data processing stage, ciphertext survival to data disposal, scheme proposed can provide data security support for the operation of the smart grid, from the perspective of data security to ensure the smooth operation of the smart grid.

articleTitle: Adjacent Vertex Reducible Total Coloring Algorithm for Several Joint Graphs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For a simple graph G(V, E), if there exists a positive integer k (1 ≤ k ≤ |E| + |G|) and a mapping f: V(G) U E(G) → {1, 2, …, k} such that the color sets of adjacent vertices with the same degree are identical, then f represents the Adjacent Vertex Reducible Total Coloring(AVRTC) of the graph G. Building upon the existing research on reducible edge coloring and Adjacent Vertices Reducible Edge Labeling, a new algorithm for Adjacent Vertex Reducible Total Coloring is designed based on practical problems. This algorithm conducts research on several joint graphs through iterative optimization. Analyzing the experimental results obtains the adjacent vertex reducible total chromatic number of some joint graphs, summarizes several theorems, and provides proof.
