Author Keywords: adjacent vertex reducible total chromatic number

articleTitle: Enterprise Intranet Threat Intelligence Processing Framework Based on Open Source Community
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Network attack tactics, techniques, procedures, and IOC are being updated more and more rapidly. Defenders need to obtain such threat intelligence in a timely manner, to identify whether the enterprise intranet is under attack, and take corresponding protective measures. Before the official disclosure of the details of the attack, the open source community often already has users in the discussion of the attack, if we can extract threat intelligence that strong related to the enterprise from the open source community in a timely manner. It will be a great help in monitoring the enterprise intranet. However, new posts are published every day in the open source community, and some of the posts may have nothing to do with network security, and the threat intelligence disclosed in the posts may not be useful to the enterprise intranet. To bridge the gap, we propose EITIP, a framework for automated enterprise intranet threat intelligence processing. EITIP automatically collects new posts from open source community, classifies posts related to cyber security, obtains effective threat intelligence, and keep it updated. To address multiple challenges, EITIP provides: (1) effective threat entities, which can help obtain richer threat intelligence. (2) a method for obtaining strongly correlated threat intelligence on an enterprise intranet. (3) a complete threat intelligence processing framework.

articleTitle: Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based On Flock Optimization Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Support vector machine (SVM) is a machine learning algorithm based on statistics theory. It has advantages in solving problems of high dimension, local extreme value and structure selection, and is widely used in data mining. However, the choice of kernel width and penalty factor is directly related to the classification result of SVM. To solve the above problems, the optimization algorithm can be adopted to optimize the parameters, so as to improve the classification accuracy of support vector machine. Chicken flock optimization algorithm is a new global optimization algorithm proposed in recent years. It has the advantages of clear structure and excellent global search ability, and has been widely used in optimization problems. Based on this, a fault diagnosis method based on the support vector machine model of chicken flock optimization was proposed and applied in the field of bearing fault diagnosis. The results show that the accuracy of bearing health status assessment based on CSO-SVM reaches 97.5%, which is obviously better than that based on traditional machine learning model, and has better fault diagnosis and recognition effect.

articleTitle: The Motion Adaptive Intra Refresh Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Low-latency video coding is a key technology for real-time video communication applications, which can effectively reduce the communication delay of the system. Aiming at the problem of low encoding quality in the low-latency intra-frame refresh coding mode, this paper proposes a motion-adaptive intra-frame refresh encoding algorithm. Compared with the traditional algorithm, which only relies on the fixed-direction refresh strategy for encoding, the proposed algorithm introduces the motion vector information in video encoding, and the most suitable refresh strategy can be freely selected in different areas of the video. This paper describes the algorithm steps and implementation details of the algorithm, proves the effectiveness of the algorithm through experiments, and analyzes the time complexity of coding.

articleTitle: Improved Cervical Cell Segmentation Algorithm Based on Cascade Mask RCNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Cervical cell early detection can timely discover abnormal cells and take treatment to avoid cervical cancer. With the development of deep learning technology, cervical cell smear detection technology has made rapid progress. However, current deep learning segmentation algorithms still have problems with inaccurate segmentation and low segmentation accuracy when dealing with high overlap of cervical cells. Therefore, we propose the cell overlap degree to measure the degree of cell overlap, in order to compare the segmentation algorithm more targetedly. At the same time, to address the misclassification problem of the traditional Cascade Mask RCNN algorithm, we propose an improved algorithm based on Cascade Mask RCNN. This algorithm uses a more advanced backbone network to improve the segmentation accuracy of the algorithm, introduces a cross-scale feature fusion structure to improve the network’s ability to extract cell cytoplasm edge feature information, and improves the ROI pooling method to further enhance the algorithm’s feature extraction ability. The improved algorithm is compared in experiments on the dataset, and the results show that our algorithm has certain effectiveness and progressiveness.

articleTitle: Multi-index evaluation of new rural energy supply system based on AHM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the deepening of rural modernization, modern rural diversified industries such as rural planting, animal husbandry and agricultural product processing industry are booming. The rural energy supply and utilization system is in a period of change, and multiple design schemes need to be comprehensively evaluated. Firstly, aiming at the multi-index evaluation of the new rural energy supply and consumption system, 15 indexes are put forward from three aspects of energy, environment and economy, and the evaluation index system of the new rural energy supply and consumption system is established. Then, on this basis, the weight of each level index is determined by the attribute hierarchy model, and the system comprehensive evaluation method considering energy, environment and economy is proposed by introducing the matter-element extension theory. Finally, the proposed method is used to evaluate the rural energy supply and consumption system based on animal husbandry and planting, and the best scheme of the system is obtained. Through comparative analysis, the effectiveness and superiority of the method are verified.

articleTitle: Analysis of Mode Switching Metrics for Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Adaptive Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of random fading and strong noise caused by the multipath effect of the underwater acoustic channel, this paper proposes an improved adaptive underwater acoustic communication scheme. The scheme uses signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and correlation coefficient(ρ) as the two-dimensional channel quality evaluation criteria in this paper, and uses the dual-channel-based quality evaluation method and deep Q-network learning (DDQN) algorithm for adaptive selection of modulation methods. Simulation experiments verify that the proposed method can improve system throughput while maintaining bit error rate constraints. Compared with traditional schemes, the new algorithm has the ability to extract channel state information, learn parameter expressions, and complex underwater acoustic communication environments. The experimental results prove that the scheme significantly improves the system performance in the complex underwater acoustic communication environment, and provides an innovative solution for realizing high-reliability and high-throughput underwater acoustic communication. The algorithm proposed in this paper has faster convergence speed and lower outage probability.

articleTitle: An Improved Bi-RRT* Trajectory Planning Algorithm for UAVs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to enable the UAV(Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) to plan an economical, feasible, and precise obstacle avoidance trajectory for the current environment during the cruise, a bidirectional expansion approach is adopted to increase iteration speed on the basis of the RRT* algorithm. At the same time, flight dynamics models are considered in the planning process, and a trajectory optimization algorithm is designed to optimized and smoothed the rough trajectory obtained initially. Finally, simulation was conducted to compare the new algorithm with traditional RRT* algorithm, and the results showed that the new algorithm has significant advantages in trajectory quality and stability. At the same time, it was verified that the new algorithm can meet the needs of online planning.

articleTitle: Research on the Communication Implementation Plan for the Shenzhen-Zhongshan Link Project
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The Shenzhen-Zhongshan link project is an important hub in the national strategic goal of developing the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. In the future, it will play a huge role in promoting the balanced development of various towns in Guangdong Province, with more frequent communication between counties and cities. This article takes the design of internal communication scheme in the construction of the Shenzhen-Zhongshan link as an example, introduces the basic situation and construction conditions of the project, analyzes the communication requirements of the project, proposes a specific communication implementation plan, and provides an introduction to the final implementation process, hoping to provide guidance for the subsequent engineering time.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Planning of Distributed Generation in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the face of energy crises and ecological challenges, connecting distributed power sources in the grid is an effective solution. Therefore, this paper establishes a multi-objective mathematical model for accessing distributed power sources to distribution grids with the objectives of distributed power generation cost, network loss cost, and environmental cost. And the constraints such as branch currents distributed power access capacity, and node voltage in the planning are given. Considering the shortcomings of traditional genetic algorithms in practical application, the genetic algorithm based on vector evaluation is used to solve the planning problem of distributed power supply in distribution networks. Finally, the feasibility of the method proposed in this paper is verified by the IEEE33 node arithmetic example.

articleTitle: Research on W-band Synthetic Aperture Radar imaging technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imaging technology utilizes a small antenna moving at a constant speed along a long linear array to radiate coherent signals. It coherently processes the received echoes from different positions to obtain high-resolution imaging. In the case of high-frequency bands, SAR has smaller radar size requirements, higher resolution, stronger anti-interference capabilities, and better penetration. This paper focuses on the research of precise ranging and radar imaging using W-band SAR. A typical W-band SAR imaging system is constructed, and functions such as pulse compression-matched filtering-based ranging algorithm and wave number domain-based radar imaging algorithm are applied to achieve RF control, distance measurement, and radar imaging validation.

articleTitle: Research on an optical system based on multi-camera imaging for TFT-LCD module defect detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to detect the defects of TFT LCD screens automatically, an optical system based on multi-camera imaging was established. The structure of TFT-LCD module and the causes of defects were analyzed, and different optical modules were designed to detect different types of defects. Then, according to the inspection requirements, the optical analysis and design selection were carried out. Finally, the trend chart of detection curve of TFT-LCD module defect detection system in actual production line was given. The experimental results show that for TFT-LCD screens of mobile phone with 3-8 inches and HD, FHD or 2K resolution, the comprehensive misdetection rate of the proposed detection system is 0.88% and the inspection rate is 7.89%, which can meet the defect detection requirements of TFT-LCD modules on the current production line.

articleTitle: Fusion enhancement : UAV target detection based on multi-modal GAN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: UAV target detection has important application value in the fields of modern military, security and emergency rescue. In order to improve the accuracy and robustness of UAV target detection, this paper uses image fusion technology to enhance the information of input images, and combines YOLOv5 target detection model to introduce attention mechanism for improvement. In the experiment, the generative adversarial network (GAN) is used as the image fusion technology, and the fusion image is generated by changing the structure of the generator and the discriminator. At the same time, the attention mechanism is introduced into the YOLOv5 model to enhance the focus of target detection. The experimental results show that the proposed improved algorithm has achieved significant performance improvement in the UAV target detection task.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Method for Dynamic Background Compensation Based on SIFT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To address the issue of poor object detection and tracking performance in dynamic scenes, a low-complexity adaptive dynamic background compensation algorithm is proposed to improve the real-time and accuracy of object detection and tracking. The algorithm uses the SIFT feature point matching algorithm to assist in calculating the background motion parameters and introduces an adaptive coefficient with feedback mechanism to reduce the matching calculation range of background motion parameters, thereby achieving dynamic background compensation. While improving the accuracy of background compensation, the algorithm also speeds up the computation to some extent. Experimental results show that this algorithm can improve the accuracy of detecting and tracking moving objects in video sequences with complex dynamic backgrounds while occupying only a small amount of system resources.

articleTitle: Analysis and research of an adaptive side-lobe cancellation performance improvement method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, we first introduce the conventional adaptive side-lobe cancellation algorithm,for the factors affecting the performance of side-lobe cancellation, the method of adding delay nodes to the auxiliary is proposed. Then, we simplify the algorithm on this basis, and finally, the effects of improvement are compared and verified. The results show that simplified method has high practical value in improving the side-lobe cancellation performance without increasing the amount of calculation.

articleTitle: GPMN: Human Pose Explicit Modeling Network based on Graph Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The human pose estimation task requires the use of visual cues and anatomical relationships between joints to locate key points. Due to the structural dependencies between human joints, it is difficult to model the dependencies between joints with a convolutional neural network-based approach. In this paper, we propose a graph pose modeling network (GPMN) based on a graph model, which constructs a structural graph model between joints and then uses a convolutional neural network to explicitly model the dependencies between joints. Specifically, this method extracts features through a backbone network and uses a graph model to obtain proximity joint dependencies. At the same time, a cross-cross-attention mechanism is used to obtain the distant joint dependencies for reinforcing challenging key points. To solve the problem that the challenging key points of the network are weakened during the training process, this paper uses a focal loss function to make the network focus more on the challenging key points, such as knees and ankles. Under the same experimental conditions, HRNet, the highest accuracy feature extraction network, and ResNet, the classical feature extraction network, are used as the backbone network. The accuracy of the algorithm with HRNet network as the backbone is improved by 2.6% compared with the original network.

articleTitle: Recognition of Drilling State of Large Auger Based on Self-Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the safety and stability of the current large auger rig operation, this study introduced deep learning into the task of identifying the drilling state of the large auger rig. This paper combines the advantages of convolutional neural network and self-attention mechanism, proposes a CNN-Attention model for the drilling state of the rig, and uses the pre-training-fine-tuning training paradigm to train the model to make it have strong features Extraction capabilities and more precise pattern recognition capabilities. After experimental verification, the comparison results with the k-proximity algorithm and the bp neural network show that the algorithm combining wavelet analysis and SVM proposed in this study has a high recognition accuracy of the drilling state, reaching 97%, which proves the effectiveness of the algorithm. The results can provide technical support for the safe and stable operation of large auger rigs.

articleTitle: Input-output assessment methodology of power grid technological transformation projects
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Technological transformation projects are an important means to improve the operation of equipment and prevent risks of power system. Compared with infrastructure projects, there are many problems in the input-output evaluation of technical transformation projects, such as complex project types and difficult to define the benefits. At present, there is no comprehensive, objective and accurate evaluation system available for practice in power grid. Based on the technical characteristics of different types of technological transformation projects, this paper uses monetary quantification as a means to construct an input-output assessment system suitable for 14 types of projects in three professional categories: transmission, substation and distribution, which realizes the quantitative evaluation of input-output throughout the life cycle of the project.

Author Keywords: dynamic capacity increase of transmission lines

articleTitle: Multi-scale module-based algorithm for skin cancer image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the problems of intra-class variability, inter-class similarity, and unbalanced dataset of skin cancer images, this paper proposes a segmentation method based on attention fusion network. The segmentation network is based on U-Net network as a segmentation network, and the segmentation accuracy is enhanced by multi-scale modules that fuse features at different levels during feature extraction and give certain weights to important target features, thus strengthening the importance of channel and spatial pixel features in the decoder. The proposed model was trained and tested on the ISIC2018 dataset, and the experimental results achieved an overall excellent result with Precision reaching 0.9, Recall reaching 0.9, and F1 reaching 92.1%.

articleTitle: Design of Electronic Blood Pressure Monitor Based on AT89S51 MCU
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The disadvantages of traditional design of MCU lie in high cost, as well as the poor accuracy. Based on the mechanism of measurement of blood pressure, this paper designs an electronic blood pressure monitor, which uses AT89S51MCU,air press sensor US9111, serial A/D transfer chip ADC0832, LCD module and analogy circuit as the hardware, and the software is written in C language. The designed blood pressure monitor is low in cost and more accurate. We hope that it will have a potential application in the near future.

articleTitle: Transformer Winding Looseness Fault Diagnosis Based on CEEMDAN-MPE and ISSA-KELM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Transformer winding vibration can easily cause winding looseness and deformation, thereby affecting the safe and stable operation of equipment and even the power system. To accurately diagnose the mechanical state changes of transformer windings, this study proposes a transformer winding looseness fault diagnosis method based on complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise multi-scale permutation entropy (CEEMDAN-MPE) and improved sparrow search algorithm optimized kernel extreme learning machine (ISSA-KELM). Firstly, the transformer vibration signal is adaptively decomposed into multiple intrinsic mode components (IMF) using CEEMDAN. Secondly, the correlation coefficient is used as an evaluation indicator to select IMF components with rich fault feature information. Then, calculate the multi-scale permutation entropy (MPE) of the selected IMFs and extract the nonlinear dynamic features of the signal. Finally, based on the MPE value, a winding mechanical fault diagnosis model with SSA optimized KELM is established. The experimental results show that CEEMDAN-MPE can successfully characterize the nonlinear dynamic characteristics of the operating state of transformer windings, and the SSA-KLEM model established can effectively identify the types of transformer winding looseness and deformation faults, with a diagnostic accuracy of 98.75%.

Author Keywords: complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise

articleTitle: Research on User Information Security based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As an important support for social information, cloud computing technology not only brings convenience to people's lives, but also brings challenges. In the cloud computing service mode, users can transmit and obtain information at anytime and anywhere through different terminals, can store information by purchasing and leasing servers. However, in the process of cloud computing service mode, there are risks that threaten user information security. Through the analysis of the cloud computing service model, this paper analyzes the two main problems of user information security more deeply and puts forward four feasible suggestions which based on cloud computing technology.

articleTitle: Research on Ammunition Logistics System Based on RFID
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The future information-based war has the characteristics of short time and high efficiency, which needs to optimize the ammunition logistics system, timely and accurately to ensure the needs of military operations and training. This paper proposes to apply RFID technology to ammunition logistics transportation to implement real-time monitoring and seamless management of ammunition status. The paper initially explored ways to integrate blockchain technology into the ammunition logistics information platform to realize ammunition information traceability, visual transportation and remote allocation.

articleTitle: Waste cigarette butts recycling device based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to collect cigarette butts that can be used as raw materials for re production, this study designed a waste cigarette butts recycling device. Using STm32 microcontroller as the control system of the device to control its operation; Infrared induction recognition device is a device that recognizes cigarette butts and transmits signals to a microcontroller. Considering various situations where cigarette butts are discarded, a extinguishing device, cigarette butts filter, and tobacco separation and screening filter were designed at the device's feeding port. Finally, the cigarette butts are physically separated through a device to obtain acetate fiber filaments and waste paper scraps from the cigarette butts, which are then screened and stored in different collection devices. To contribute to the research on cigarette butts recycling devices.

articleTitle: A Multi-constraint Hybrid Network for Ultrasound Image Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Simulating ultrasound (US) through US image synthesis is crucial for preoperative training and learning ultrasound techniques for doctors. Due to the significant modality differences between magnetic resonance (MR) images and US images, the structure of the synthesized US images tends to be blurry and of lower quality. In this paper, we propose a hybrid network combining CNN and Transformer that enhances the synthesis performance by integrating their respective abilities in local and global feature extraction. We also introduce multiple constraints to improve the quality of the synthesized images. Firstly, we introduce a multi-scale perceptor (MSP) to enhance the structural content information of the synthesized images, thereby improving their authenticity. Additionally, we address the blurriness issue of synthesized images by incorporating a gradient difference loss in the loss function, which enhances the structural edge information and further improves the quality of synthesized images. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method achieves a PSNR of 14.7251 and an SSIM of 0.8556, outperforming other advanced methods currently available.

articleTitle: A Channel Estimation Scheme for OTFS System Based on Sparse Characteristics of Delay-Doppler Domain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: High-speed mobile scenario is one of the key scenarios of the next generation wireless communication. How to ensure the communication performance in high-speed mobile scenario is also a current research hotspot. In high-speed moving scenarios, the channel will produce multipath effect and Doppler shift, but the traditional orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) technology is sensitive to Doppler shift, and the performance is poor in high-speed scenarios. Based on OTFS system, the Detouring Matching Pursuit - Threshold Decision (DMP-TD) channel estimation method is proposed in this paper. Simulation result shows that the channel estimation method proposed in this paper has a greater performance than the traditional orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) scheme, and can effectively improve the channel estimation accuracy of OTFS system.

articleTitle: A video description model integrating feature reinforcement and knowledge supplement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a codec model based on feature reinforcement and text knowledge supplement. In the coding stage, the model extracts fine-grained features of static objects in the video through local and global feature intensification, improves the resolution of similar semantics of objects, and integrates visual semantics and video features into long short-term memory (LSTM). In the decoding stage, in order to mine the hidden information in the video that is not easy to be found by the machine, part of the frame of the video is intercepted and the visual target is detected. The obtained visual target is used to extract knowledge from the external knowledge language database to supplement the generation of description text, so as to produce a more novel and natural text description. The experimental results show that the proposed method has good performance, and the generated content information can show novel implicit information to a certain extent.

articleTitle: G3RHW: A Unified Model for the Generation and Removal of Real Rain and Haze Weather
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Supervised deep learning is widely used in the field of rain and haze weather removal currently and has achieved excellent results. However, it is challenging to learn the potential relationship between rain and haze image input and clean image output in learning based network training because it is extremely difficult to obtain the matched Noising-Clean image data pairs in the real world for supervised learning model train. To overcome this obstacle, in this paper, we propose a high-order rain and haze degradation process to generate a large number of more realistic and complex rain haze image training pairs, and build an end-to-end unified model G3RHW for rain haze generation and removal based on generative adversarial networks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves more superior image detail recovery and the removal of the effect of rain and haze results on both synthetic and realistic dataset than state-of-the-art methods fine-tuned for adverse weather removal.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power Optimization of Distribution Network Based on Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of excessive network loss and low voltage amplitude caused by insufficient reactive power or uneven distribution of distribution network, a reactive power optimization scheme of distribution network based on quantum particle swarm optimization is proposed. The minimum network loss of distribution network is selected as the objective function, and the power flow calculation is carried out by Newton-Raphson method with the constraint conditions of node voltage amplitude and switching capacitor capacity. Based on the sensitivity of node network loss-reactive power, the sensitivity analysis of distribution network nodes is sorted, and the best reactive power compensation node is selected. The quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the compensation capacity of the selected reactive power compensation nodes. Taking the IEEE33 node distribution network as an example, the reactive power optimization of the distribution network is discussed and verified when there is distributed power access. The results show that the proposed reactive power optimization scheme is feasible and can improve the node voltage amplitude while reducing the network loss of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Evaluation Model of Prefabricated Buildings Based on Graph Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The evaluation method of graph convolutional neural network has been developed and perfected after a long time of development. The advantage of graph convolutional neural network is that its highly simulated neural operation function can effectively correct errors after repeated learning, so as to avoid the influence of subjective factors on the results to a certain extent. At the same time, the graph convolutional neural network is based on nonlinear operation, which is different from the traditional calculation method which mainly relies on carding regression. It can better grasp the relationship between variables, and the results of hidden variables in the calculation can be directly fed back to the calculation results.

articleTitle: Building a knowledge graph for dietary services targeting specific groups of people
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Currently, most research focuses on users' behavioral preferences while ignoring the impact of food properties on human health. This article extracts a large amount of knowledge about the relationship between food properties and human health from multiple heterogeneous data sources. Based on this, a knowledge graph in the field of food is constructed for special populations to help them plan their diet more reasonably and reduce the risk of common diseases. Using background data sources such as Baidu Baike and Wikipedia, the BERT-BiLSTM-MHA-CRF method is proposed to extract food-related attributes from more than 14,731 descriptions of food properties. Combined with the differentiated features of special populations, a knowledge graph in the field of food is constructed. The knowledge graph mainly includes six entity types: food nutrition, efficacy and function, food name, population, dish name, and seasoning, with a total of 11,218 entities and 96,186 relationships. The experiment shows that compared with traditional static word vector models, BERT can generate dynamic word vectors based on context in large-scale corpus, making semantic encoding more accurate. The multi-head self-attention mechanism weights various entities in the food domain to reduce the interference of invalid information, making the model more accurate in capturing entity features. The BERT-BiLSTM-MHA-CRF method proposed in this article achieves P, R, and F1 greater than 90%.

articleTitle: Control Method of Cooling Winnowing Machine after Drying
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To enhance the control level of the cooling winnowing machine after drying and ensure the consistency of the processing strength of leaf wire, a wind speed measurement system was constructed by transforming the manual damper. A digital PID control method based on process control was established and implemented using Siemens PLC. The final results indicate that this control method significantly improved the control level as evidenced by a reduction in standard deviation SD of wind speed from 1.687 to 0.0389 and average moving range from 1.903 to 0.0439.

articleTitle: Python-based for Big Data Analytics in Tourism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Currently, though the existing research has solved some of the tourism data analysis‘ problems based on some versions of Python and functions of the library, but subject to the development of technology, the research on python-based for big data analytics in Tourism has got massive need. Based on python 3.11 and pycharm 2023, this study obtained real tourism data by crawler collection method, parsed the crawled data by BeautifulSoup, Xpath and other data parsing methods, stored the data by csv, xlsx and other data storage methods, cleaned the data by pandas, analysed the data by Tf-Idf algorithm and K-means clustering algorithm, and visualised the data analysis results by matplotlib and wordcloud.

articleTitle: Vertex Reducible Total Coloring Algorithm for Random Graphs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For any undirected connected graph G(V, E), if there exists a surjection f: V(G) ∪ E(G) → {1, 2, ⋯ , k}, where k is a positive integer and the maximum is the number of points plus the number of edges such that the set of colors of all vertices of the same degree in the graph is the same, then the mapping relation f is called Vertex Reducible Total Coloring (VRTC) of the graph G, and the vertex reducible total chromatic number of the graph G is the maximum value k obtained. Aiming at the realistic problems that can be solved by the vertex reducible total coloring model, a new VRTC algorithm is designed with the traditional intelligent algorithm idea. The algorithm searches for the vertex reducible total chromatic number of random graphs within a finite number of points by means of continuous function, balance function, and adjustment function in an iterative, merit-seeking manner. By analyzing the result set and summarizing the coloring laws, several theorems are obtained.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Transformer Core Looseness Based on VMD-MFE and GOA-LSSVM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A transformer core looseness fault diagnosis method based on variational modal decomposition multiscale fuzzy entropy (VMD-MFE) and grasshopper optimization algorithm optimized least squares support vector machine (GOA-LSSVM) is proposed to address the issue of difficulty in accurately and effectively identifying transformer core looseness faults. Firstly, the VMD is used to decompose the collected transformer vibration signals to obtain different order intrinsic mode function (IMF). Secondly, we employ correlation coefficients to determine the correlation between different modal components of IMF and the original vibration signal, and select the IMF component with the strongest correlation. Then, we calculate the MFE value of the IMF with the strongest correlation and construct a feature dataset. Finally, the GOA algorithm is used to optimize the regularization parameters and kernel functions of LSSVM, and a GOA-LSSVM diagnostic model is constructed. The experimental results indicate that the proposed method can effectively identify mechanical faults with varying degrees of transformer core looseness, with a recognition accuracy of 98.57%, achieving high accuracy diagnosis and providing new ideas for on-site maintenance workers.

articleTitle: Research on detection and location of tomato axillary bud growth point via lightweight YOLOv3 model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The removal of tomato axillary buds is of great significance for improving fruit yield and quality. In response to the current lack of effective identification and localization of tomato axillary bud growth points, a growth point detection and localization method based on lightweight YOLOv3 is proposed. Improve the traditional YOLOv3 model architecture and introduce the lightweight recognition model MobileNet to replace the YOLOv3 feature extraction network, ensuring detection accuracy while improving detection speed. Replacing some standard convolutions with deep separable convolutions reduces model parameters without compromising network performance. The comparative experimental results show that the average recognition accuracy of the improved YOLOv3 model has been effectively improved, reducing the detection time of each image, and reducing the number of parameters and weight files compared to the original model. This will help to achieve detection and localization of tomato axillary bud growth points on airborne low-performance terminals in the future.

articleTitle: A Blind Estimation Algorithm for Frequency Hopping Signal Parameters Based on Time-Frequency Optimization STFT-CA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of blind parameter estimation of frequency hopping signals is studied. The existing estimation algorithms have an impractical computational burden, and in response to this situation, the paper proposes a blind estimation algorithm STFT-CA algorithm based on time-frequency optimization and short-time Fourier transform of the hopping signal parameters. The algorithm preprocesses the frequency hopping signal by short-time Fourier transform (STFT), and then estimates the energy centers of the signal in the time and frequency components respectively, reassigns the components to achieve the correction and refinement of the spectral map, and subsequently obtains the parameter estimates by STFT correlation analysis and frequency splitting of the signal. The proposed method in the paper reduces the complexity of the traditional algorithm, and it is verified by experimental simulation that the method still has high accuracy of estimation at lower signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Calculation Method of 220kV Capacity-load Ratio of Regional Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The capacity-load ratio of 220kV regional power grid is an important index of power network planning. It is the basis for the macro-control of total substation capacity, power balance analysis, grid construction scale, and investment control. The value of the capacity-load ratio has a guiding significance for substation layout and capacity planning. In this paper, the sum of the annual on-grid electricity of the substation, the ratio of up-grid electricity to down-grid electricity, and the probability that the substation sends renewable energy or conventional power to the power grid are calculated. Then, the sum of up-grid and down-grid electricity of each 220kV substation in July and August in summer and January and December in winter are calculated and analyzed. At the same time, the ratio of the maximum up-grid power to the maximum down-grid power in the month is also calculated to judge whether it is larger or smaller than 1. The annual up-grid substation is obtained based on the power constraint, the ratio constraint of the maximum up-grid and down-grid power, and the probability constraint of the up-grid situation. Finally, the effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed method are verified by the operation data of a regional power grid.

articleTitle: Research on urban rail line planning methods for smart cities based on big data and forbidden search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, traditional transportation route planning mainly relies on geographical drawings for rough planning and determines the final plan based on field visits, which leads to poor planning results due to the lack of effective identification of traffic demand points. For this reason, an urban rail transit route planning method based on big data and a forbidden search algorithm is proposed. Firstly, we analyze the factors affecting the arrangement of urban rail transit feeder bus stops, determine the bus demand points by calculating the passenger flow demand, construct a two-level dynamic planning model by combining the taboo search algorithm, and establish neighborhood transformation rules to solve the model. Finally, experiments are conducted to verify the planning performance of the proposed method. The results show that the routing scheme planned by the method has fewer inflection points and the planning performance is more satisfactory.

articleTitle: Design of aquaculture intelligent system based on fuzzy theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Prenant’s schizothoracin is a type of unique valuable economic fish in China. A monitoring system that uses ZigBee network, 32-digit embedded microcontroller, and 5G network as the core is developed for a prenant’s schizothoracin culture facility fishpond to improve the yield and quality of artificial culture of this fish type. This system can achieve intelligent adjustment of water-quality parameters such as micro-flow, temperature, dissolved oxygen, and pH value. The power supply of the sensor circuit under control of the ZigBee nodes operates at an appropriate time to save energy. A gateway node of the PDA form is designed on the basis of the 32-bit embedded microcontroller and WinCE6.0-embedded OS. Such a node is transplanted into the embedded SQlite database to achieve onsite management of the ZigBee network. A fuzzy intelligent algorithm is designed and achieved by transplanting it to the 32-bit embedded microcontroller. Test results show that the flow-rate error of the micro-flow is controlled within ± 1.7 cm/s, the temperature error is controlled within ± 0.4 °C, the dissolved oxygen error is controlled within ± 0.4 mg/L, and the pH value is controlled within ± 0.3. Thus, the proposed system fully satisfies the practical culture demands of prenant’s schizothoracin.

articleTitle: Low-Light Image Enhancement Network based on Gamma Correction and Multi-scale Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A low-light image enhancement method based on Gamma correction and a multi-scale attention mechanism is proposed for the problem of detail loss due to low image brightness and contrast under low-light conditions. First, we extract the image luminance and color feature maps through an attention network, construct Gamma values using each pixel of the feature maps, and perform Gamma correction on the input low-light images to enhance the brightness and contrast of the images. A multi-scale attention network is designed to extract the noise distribution features of the low-light image, and a U-Net network is used to achieve image noise suppression. Experiments show that compared with other existing algorithms, the method in this paper has some improvement in the objective indicators of low-light image enhancement, PSNR, SSIM and NIQE.

articleTitle: The PID Control Algorithm based on Whale Optimization Algorithm Optimized BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the non-linear and time-varying problems existing in the traditional PID control system, a new PID control method based on the whale algorithm to optimize the BP neural network is proposed. The algorithm utilizes the characteristics of the whale optimization algorithm, such as simple operation, few parameters to adjust, and strong ability to jump out of local optimum, continuously adjusts and optimizes the weights of the BP neural network, and adjusts the parameters of the PID control algorithm in real time, avoiding the problem of easily falling into local minimum values during the learning process of the PID control algorithm of the BP neural network, and improving system performance. The simulation shows that compared with the control algorithm based on particle swarm BP neural network PID and other control algorithms, the algorithm in this paper has fast response speed, good stability, small overshoot, higher control precision and control stability.

articleTitle: Satellite Dynamic Channel Prediction Based on LSTM Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Satellite communication channel information are crucial for effective information transmission from ground stations to satellites. Current methods generally rely on the downlink to get the estimated channel conditions of satellites, however they are inapplicable in the event of an abrupt satellite downlink disconnect. Therefore, we propose a method for predicting the long-time carrier-to-noise ratio (CNR) of satellite communication channels. This method is based on the long and short term memory (LSTM) network model. By introducing the predicted position of the satellite, the accuracy of the CNR prediction is promoted. The simulation results show that the residuals of the predicted CNR within 1000 seconds are less than 4 dBHz, and the root mean square error(RMSE) is 2.7372 dBHz.

articleTitle: Based on Improved YOLOV7 Recognition of Distribution Room Instrument Panel Information
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of enterprise intelligence and automation, the reading of instrument panel information in distribution rooms is no longer limited to manual work. This paper proposes an object detection method based on an improved YOLOv7-Tiny network model. By inspecting the image information of pointer instruments collected by robots, YOLOV7-Tiny is used to achieve three key steps: instrument panel positioning, instrument panel pointer and scale positioning, and instrument panel number recognition. By introducing the ShuffleAttention attention module into the existing network structure, combining spatial attention mechanism and channel attention mechanism, we focus on the feature information of small targets, suppress unimportant features, and achieve more accurate detection and recognition. The experimental results show that the improved object detection algorithm outperforms the YOLOV7-Tiny original model in terms of mAP@0.5 improved by 0.5%, significantly improving the detection accuracy of small targets, achieving more real-time and accurate dashboard information detection.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of embedded PCB defect detection system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the convolutional neural network commonly used in PCB defect detection is difficult to deploy in embedded devices with limited resources, an FPGA embedded system is designed to realize the hardware deployment of YOLOv3 neural network for PCB defect detection. The system is mainly designed from two aspects. The deep learning processing unit DPU is designed on the hardware side to quickly process the convolution calculation part of the neural network and configure the system software for it. At the algorithm side, the model is compressed by using a quantization method to reduce the computational complexity of the model and generate a DPU deployable model. The experimental results show that the designed system can still maintain the accuracy of 0.789 in PCB defect detection. At the same time, the convolution calculation throughput of 2.44TOPS and the detection speed of 97.59ms per frame delay are realized under low power consumption, which is suitable for industrial PCB defect detection.

articleTitle: Research on Facial Expression Recognition Method Based on Improved VGG16 Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the insufficient extraction of facial expression features by convolutional neural network VGG16, an improved VGG16-NFB network model is proposed to extract facial expression features more fully, so as to improve the accuracy of facial expression recognition. Firstly, VGG16 is used to optimize the network structure, and the part before the classifier is used as the feature extractor to extract the features of facial expressions initially, and the redundant two full connection layers in the classifier are deleted. Then, a feature enhancement module FEM is designed, in which the representative batch normalization method can calibrate the feature information effectively, make the feature distribution more stable, and further enhance the network's ability to extract features from facial expressions. Finally, the global average pooling is used to extract the features of each level in the feature enhancement module, and the bridge attention module BAM is introduced to fuse the features of each level, which is used to generate attention weights to further enhance the facial expression features with high discrimination. The experimental results show that the improved VGG16-NFB network achieves 86.8% and 87.5% recognition accuracy on the RAF-DB and FERPlus facial expression datasets, respectively, which is 2.22% and 1.61% higher than the original network.

articleTitle: Active Power Filter Design Based on SiC Power Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In modern power grids, active power filters (APF) are widely used in improving power quality. With the development of science and technology, in some special applications, higher requirements are put forward for APF compensation performance and power density. For this reason, a high-frequency APF system design scheme based on (SiC) power devices is proposed. Due to the high withstand voltage, low loss, and high switching frequency characteristics of SiC devices, the APF system can achieve higher switching frequencies, which is helpful It is used to improve APF compensation performance and power density and reduce the volume and weight of active power filter (APF).

articleTitle: Research on Line Voltage Stabilization Technology for Rural Photovoltaic Substation Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a solution to overvoltage on the user side, and conducts research on key technologies for line voltage stabilization based on high-frequency power electronic chopper topology circuits. This can solve the problems of high voltage and fluctuation, avoid the situation where household electrical equipment on the user side is easily damaged due to high voltage, improve the quality of user electricity, and bring practical value to user production and life. The traditional voltage regulator adopts the method of adjusting the transformer winding. This paper adopts the power electronic topology circuit to achieve the voltage regulation function, while eliminating the transformer. The volume is relatively small, and the weight is light. The research results have advantages over traditional voltage regulators, such as fast dynamic response, high voltage regulation accuracy, wide compensation range, high conversion efficiency, small volume, low cost, and light weight.

articleTitle: A Novel Cluster Division Method of Resource Aggregates in Active Distribution Networks Based on Adaptive Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the context of modern power distribution systems, Active Distribution Networks (ADNs) play a pivotal role in integrating renewable energy sources, enabling demand response, and improving overall system efficiency. Efficient resource aggregation in ADNs is crucial for optimal load balancing and enhanced system performance. This paper presents a new cluster division method for resource aggregates in ADNs, leveraging an Adaptive Firefly Algorithm (AFA) to achieve superior results. The AFA is employed to optimize the clustering of resources, effectively addressing the challenges posed by traditional firefly algorithms. By formulating an objective function and incorporating a parameter adaptation mechanism, the proposed method ensures the convergence of fireflies towards better solutions. Extensive simulations and case studies validate the method’s effectiveness.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of ultrasonic impact on the release of welding residual stress
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The thermal elastoplastic finite element method was used to numerically calculate the residual stress in the butt welding of AH36 high-strength marine steel, and the longitudinal and transverse residual stress distributions in the two path directions of the weld area were obtained. The analysis of the release of residual stress in welding along two paths under ultrasonic impact shows that the release ratio of residual stress in transverse welding along the two paths is in the range of 40-70%, and the release ratio of residual stress in longitudinal welding is in the range of 30-60%.

articleTitle: A Computational Study of Cholinergic Depression on the Persistent Inward Currents
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Persistent inward currents (PICs) play important roles in regulating neural excitability. Results from our previous studies showed that serotonergic (5-HT) neurons of the brainstem expressed PICs. However, little is known about cholinergic (ACh) modulation of PICs in the 5-HT neurons. The 5-HT neuron was simulated in the present paper to investigate the ionic mechanism of the cholinergic depression on the PICs. PICs in 5-HT neurons of the brainstem and this depression was mediated by changing the conductance and the gating property of the Ca-PIC and the Na-PIC.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology for Odometer Calibration of Vehicular Laser Inertial Measurement Unit Integrated Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to enhance the accuracy of vehicular laser inertial measurement unit (LIMU) integrated navigation system, and to lessen the impact of the odometer (OD) error and the installation error of inertial navigation system (INS). Analysis of the installation error of INS, the OD scale factor error, and the requirement for odometer calibration for the dead reckoning (DR) integrated navigation system. It is suggested to propose an online calibration algorithm that is based on the differences between the GPS position and DR position and the GPS position and strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS) solution position. The installation error of INS and the OD scale factor error can both be accurately estimated using this method. The simulation test and vehicle test results used to validate the algorithm's efficacy demonstrate that it can accurately calibrate the installation error of INS and the OD scale factor error while achieving a high level of accuracy, making it useful for engineering applications.

articleTitle: Compressed Sensing using Collaborative-Aware Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To effectively reduce the instability and uncertainty caused by the reconstruction of a single image block due to the large solution space, a collaborative-aware generative adversarial network for image compressed sensing (CACS-Net) is proposed. According to the non-local self-similarity prior, the collaborative reconstruction group is constructed to provide more reconstruction information. The reconstruction model consists of a generator and a discriminator. The generator takes the collaborative reconstruction group as input and obtains the initial reconstructed image group by sub-pixel up-sampling. A differential Gaussian module is constructed to extract and enhance the multi-component features of the initial reconstructed images. The final reconstructed image is obtained by merging each enhanced component. The discriminator is a binary classifier that judges the authenticity of the reconstructed image output by the generator. To improve the stability of network training, a collaborative perception loss function is proposed, in which the collaborative constraint can reduce the solution space of the reconstruction problem, and the perception constraint helps to recover more texture details feature of the image. Experimental results on the SET5 and SET14 testing datasets demonstrate that the proposed method can reconstruct more texture details of the image under low sampling rates.

articleTitle: Research on frequency hopping network separation based on ML and MUSIC algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the separation of network problem of frequency-hopping network, this paper proposes a new method based on machine learning and MUSIC algorithm. This method uses machine learning to complete the individual radio identification, uses MUSIC algorithm to estimate direction of arrival signal, and then makes use of time-frequency analysis and other technologies to complete the time domain and frequency domain signal analysis, so as to obtain important technical parameters of the frequency hopping network, such as frequency table, hopping rate, geographical location and network station relationship.

articleTitle: Research and Design of the Safety Control Platform for the Railway Signaling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the functions and safety requirements of railway signal, a railway signal safety control platform is designed and studied from three aspects: design principle, hardware structure and software structure. In terms of design principles, the safety control platform not only meets the reliability requirements of various signal safety control systems, but also has the versatility and scalability of the platform; In the view of hardware structure, the double two out of two redundant structure is adopted as the overall core architecture of the safety platform, which consists of power layer, logic layer, communication layer and IO execution layer. In terms of software architecture, it is divided into two parts: user application software and platform software. Finally, taking the computer interlocking system as an example, it is necessary to introduce the multi-node communication problem of the CAN bus of the signal safety control platform, and the related problems caused by it, such as real-time communication and data transmission reliability.

articleTitle: Mobile phone anti-theft Trojan triggering Circuit Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The researches of Hardware Trojans (HT) have become an emerging research hotspot in the field of IC over the last decades. However, the techniques for the injection, detection, and application of HT remain to be developed. Most HT aims to destroy normal works when it comes to applications. To explore the reliability, stealth, and more positive applications of HT trigger, considering the privacy of the internal data of smartphones and the security of the phones themselves, this paper designs a combinational HT trigger and a logical HT trigger as well as a subsequent attack behavior at a software level for both triggers. The above designs can achieve an HT-triggered smartphone anti-theft function and an ability to send location information to a designated phone number when the phone is lost. After several tests in real scenarios, the function is reliable and the results are accurate.

articleTitle: Coarse-to-fine Extraction of Power Pylons and Power Lines in LiDAR Point Clouds
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of LiDAR point clouds in transmission line maintenance, automatic extraction of power pylons and power lines becomes a key function for perceiving and monitoring the status of the transmission line project. However, the point clouds obtained by the 3D laser scanner are noisy. In addition to the elements that need to be extracted, they also contain ground plane data, vegetation data, and other outliers. In this paper, we propose a coarse-to-fine method for power pylon and power line extraction in LiDAR point clouds. In particular, the method first coarsely separates transmission pylons and lines, and then accurately fits the power lines using line or curve models. The effectiveness of the model proposed in this paper is validated through a case study in a point cloud captured in a power transmission line project, in which the results show that the proposed method is accurate in the segmentation of power pylons and power lines.

articleTitle: Improved Network Anomaly Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development and updating of the Internet, network security issues have become diverse, and network attacks have greatly affected our lives. Network anomaly detection plays a pivotal role. Based on the existing network anomaly detection method of China Telecom network management platform, this paper proposes an improved network anomaly detection model, and improves the accuracy of network anomaly detection through the analysis of data traffic. Finally, combined with the pilot situation of a branch of China Telecom, a new generation of intelligent analysis model was trained, which verified the effectiveness of the system and provided new insights for optimizing other application systems.

articleTitle: Design and Research of The New Intelligent Drying Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the problems of insufficient drying caused by the narrow drying space and unreasonable spacing of clothes in the family, this paper independently designs an adjustable drying device. The whole device adopts a drawer-type structure, and first through the bevel gear structure, the overall up and down movement is realized; Secondly, adjust the spacing of clothes through the hinge structure to make the clothes fully dry; Finally, two staggered crossbars are used to realize the flipping and drying of a large area of fabric, thus meeting the comprehensive needs of family life. It adopts GPRS_ Air202 control, with wired mode and wireless mode for intelligent control. Based on the finite element method, the static and dynamic analysis of the main components of the device was carried out to verify the feasibility of the design, and the stress results obtained were less than the allowable stress, which met the design requirements.

articleTitle: Three-level Vertical Cyber Security Protection Architecture Based on Power Grid Node Grading
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As the interconnectivity of the power grid increases, various risks associated with the overall defense system, including network boundary protection, entity security protection, and core application protection, pose a threat to network security. Existing solutions mainly include deploying boundary protection devices, identifying entity vulnerabilities, and detecting abnormal application activities, but these solutions lack sufficient differentiated security protection measures and blocking capabilities. Therefore, the paper proposes a power node division method, which involves dividing nodes into levels based on their importance and implementing differentiated defense measures accordingly. This results in the construction of a three-level vertical defense system based on differential defense proposals, namely "boundary defense, self protection, application monitoring". The solution implements fine-grained differential defense measures based on node grading, formulates general defense strategies for low-level nodes, and executes customized defense measures for high-level nodes, making the allocation of defense resources more reasonable, ensuring the security of power nodes, and improving the security defense capabilities of the power supervision and control system.

articleTitle: Research and application of negative current in fault identification of three-phase three-wire smart energy meters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Three-phase three-wire smart meters may generate negative currents .In this paper, we analyze in detail the causes of negative current of the three-phase three-wire smart energy meter caused by load characteristics or wrong wiring, study the characteristics of smart energy meter metering parameters in the wrong wiring state, and put forward strict preventive measures in terms of technical measures and management mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on Crowd Evacuation Path Planning in Subway Based on Improved Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To address the problem of guide evacuations in dynamic environments, we propose to improve the traditional reinforcement learning path planning algorithm by adding a table of taboos to the algorithm to mark the achieved local optimums, and by reinforcing the local optimums to obtain a kind of global optimal solution, thus reducing the frequent trial and error process of reinforcement learning., Then, to verify that the path searched by the improved algorithm is the best evacuation path, simulation experiments are performed under different evacuation scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on USB Storage Occupancy Traceability in Windows Environment Based on Log Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the widespread use of USB storage devices, their stable and reliable operation has become key to ensuring user data security. In Windows systems, USB storage devices may sometimes be in use by a process or resource, making it unsafe to eject them. Forcing an eject can result in data loss on the USB storage device. In light of this background, this paper investigates the techniques and methods for tracing USB storage utilization in Windows environments based on log analysis. By screening and matching system logs and process information, we can automatically locate and identify USB storage device utilization and generate user prompts. This effectively ensures the data security of USB storage devices and improves the user experience when using USB storage devices.

articleTitle: Design of Mechanical and Hardware solutions for Quadruped robot chassis based on Substation inspection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper designs a quadruped inspection robot chassis based on substation inspection, and conducts strength verification on the leg pull rod transmission. We have studied the overall hardware structure and architecture of the chassis. Based on the selected motor and other hardware, we have studied the power management system for the entire machine. We have carried out hardware design for the power management board, and constructed a mechanical and hardware platform for the quadruped chassis. The application of the quadruped chassis will greatly improve the coverage of substation equipment inspection, achieve on-site all terrain inspection of substations, and have broad market application prospects.

articleTitle: Dynamic regulatory evaluation model of shield tunneling engineering driven by engineering data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of tunnels and urban rail transit in China, the construction of shield tunnels is enormous, and it also faces the management and decision-making challenges brought by different levels of construction teams, complex geological conditions, surrounding environment and various emergencies. In order to supervise the project more effectively, this paper starts from five dimensions: progress, quality, safety, equipment and management. Based on the principle of fuzzy transformation and the principle of maximum membership degree, the data-driven method is used to carry out multi-level comprehensive evaluation of tunnel construction status, forming a scientific and reasonable supervision and evaluation model of shield tunnel construction, and making dynamic evaluation for tunnel construction in all aspects.

articleTitle: Series arc fault detection and identification based on improved residual network by PSO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of industrialization, the requirements for power safety are getting higher and higher. Low voltage series arc fault is the main cause of electrical fire, and it has high concealment because it is directly connected to the circuit and the current is lower than the loop current. Aiming at the problems of difficult feature extraction and poor recognition accuracy in low voltage series arc fault detection and recognition method, this paper proposes a low voltage series arc fault recognition method based on improved residual network. The improvement of the traditional residual network includes the following three aspects : First, the particle swarm optimization ( PSO ) algorithm is used to optimize the residual network, so as to quickly and accurately fit the fault arc characteristic quantity ; secondly, the dual attention network module ( DANET ) is added to the convolutional neural network detection algorithm model. Finally, the RELU activation function of the traditional ResNet network is replaced by the RELU-Softsign activation function to improve the convergence speed of the network and strengthen batch standardization. Through comparative experiments, the results show that the recognition accuracy of the improved residual network is 98 %, and the recognition accuracy and convergence speed are better than other models.

articleTitle: Channel wave signal classification based on Riemann MDS algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: China's coal fields are tectonically complex and difficult to mine. Traditional means of physical exploration such as three-dimensional (3D) seismic exploration, radio pit detection and geological radar are greatly affected by geology, and the detect results are not precise enough to meet the requirements of precise exploration. In recent years, channel wave exploration technology has gradually become a new means of geological exploration in coal mines by virtue of its high detection accuracy, large detection distance, strong resistance to electrical interference and easy identification of waveform characteristics, and it can be used to explore the hidden disaster-causing factors, and changes of coal seam thickness in coal mines. The conventional Euclidean space cannot effectively describe the nonlinearity of the channel wave. The Riemann MDS algorithm combined with fisher feature selection method is proposed for classification of small geological structure in coal mines. A three-dimensional (3D) medium geometry model is developed for a complicated coal seam with goaf, collapse column, wash zone, and small fault based on COMSOL Multiphysics. Then the MDS -based Riemann algorithm is employed for feature extraction. Finally, the PSO-SVM classifier is used for classification of small geological structure. In experiment, the extracted Riemannian channel wave dataset is divided into training and testing sets in a 7:3 ratio, and sent to the PSO-SVM optimization model for training. The experimental results show that the classification accuracy based on Riemann MDS and PSOSVM is as high as 98.67%, which demonstrates that the proposed algorithm improves the accuracy of classification.

articleTitle: An Infrared Small Target Tracking Method Based on Dynamic Kernels
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the superiority of the infrared imaging system, infrared small target tracking is widely used in military, security protection, criminal investigation and other fields. In recent years, deep learning has become the mainstream method in the field of target tracking, but due to the differences in tracking scenarios, directly applying these methods to infrared small target images will cause performance loss. Aiming at the problems of low recognizability, low signal-to-noise ratio, and complex background of infrared images, we propose an infrared small target tracking method based on dynamic kernels, named DykT. We design a dynamic convolution module to improve object and background discriminability. Experimental results on public infrared small target datasets show that the method achieves good performance.

articleTitle: Adaptive Finite-time Trajectory Tracking Control of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In regard to the UAV trajectory tracking that simultaneously satisfies the time and space constraints, an adaptive finite-time trajectory tracking control algorithm is proposed. An adaptive estimator is designed to promptly estimate and compensate the unknown disturbances imposed during the trajectory tracking process, so that the UAV can successfully track the desired trajectory in a finite time. To meet the control requirements of along-track and cross-track error distances in the UAV trajectory tracking control history, a barrier Lyapunov function is constructed to limit the along-track and cross-track error of the UAV. Simulation results verify that the proposed adaptive finite-time trajectory tracking control algorithm achieves satisfactory performance, and can track the desired trajectory promptly and accurately.

articleTitle: A power allocation strategy to maximize CR-NOMA throughput
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the total throughput of secondary users is not maximized, considering the fairness between secondary users and the interference of primary users to secondary users, a power allocation strategy to maximize the throughput of CR-NOMA is proposed. Firstly, the elementary matrix is established according to the equivalent channel gain, and the secondary user is selected and multiplexed to the primary user sub-channel. Then, for the selected secondary users, the minimum transmission rate is dynamically adjusted based on fairness, and the optimal power scaling factor under the maximization of the total throughput of the secondary users is calculated. Finally, power distribution is performed. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce the complexity of the algorithm and maximize the total throughput of the secondary users compared with the HPPA and CR-OMA algorithms.
