articleTitle: A protection strategy of critical nodes in power communication networks considering the coupling with power grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Attacks against power communication nodes in coupled networks cause the loss of communication network services while also making the failure of the power grid unaware and uncontrollable. During the protection of the power communication network, the attacker's attack target and the number of attacks cannot be predicted, while the protection resources that the protector can use are limited. Based on the network characteristics of the power-communication coupled network, this paper constructs an attack and defense game model for the power-communication coupled network, and quantifies the game process between the attacker and the protector with the goal of maximizing their own gains when the attack target is unpredictable and the protection resources are relatively limited. For the game process of the two, a population competition firefly algorithm is proposed to calculate the optimal protection strategy to reasonably allocate protection resources and improve the robustness of the coupled power-communication network.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Space Robot Based on Multiple-phase Gaussian Pseudospectral Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to low calculation efficiency of traditional path planning methods for free floating space robot and not meet the real-time requirements, a path planning method based on multiple-phase Gauss pseudo spectrum method for free floating space robot was designed. First, considering the constraints such as joint angle constraints, joint angular velocity constraints, and various other constraints, the space robot path planning problem is considered as the optimal control problem that satisfies a series of constraints and boundary conditions and achieves the optimal performance index. Secondly, combining the multiple-phase Gauss pseudospectral method and nonlinear planning technology, the optimal control problem is solved, and the space robot trajectory satisfying the constraints and having the best performance index is obtained. Finally, data results verified the algorithm is optimal.

articleTitle: Research on Anomaly Detection Method for the Executive Motor of Six-Rotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to achieve real-time anomaly detection for the motors of multi-rotor UAV, this study proposes a anomaly detection method based on improved multivariate state estimation technique. The anomaly detection method proposed in this study includes two sections: offline and online. The offline section includes data preprocessing, memory matrix (MM) construction, and anomaly detection threshold calculation. The online section includes obtaining estimated states based on improved multivariate state estimation technique and anomaly detection based on residuals. By analyzing the flight logs of DJI Matrice600 and collecting monitoring data of the executive motor, a training set, a validation set, and a testing set were obtained. The effectiveness of the improved method was verified based on the validation set, and the results showed that estimated states obtained by the improved multivariate state estimation technique is closer to the actual states compared to traditional methods. Based on the test set, the anomaly detection method proposed in this study was tested. The experimental results showed that the proposed anomaly detection method based on improved multivariate state estimation technique can detect the operating status of the six-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle’s executive motor. Compared with the actual fault information recorded by the unmanned aerial vehicle’s executive motor, abnormal states can be detected 22 time points in advance. Compared to traditional anomaly detection method, the anomaly detection method proposed in this study can effectively reduce the error detection rate and improve the detection efficiency by 10%.

articleTitle: Scheduling Optimization of Flexible Job Shop Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Flexible job shop scheduling (FJSP) is an important problem in manufacturing systems, and many researchers have used the non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) to solve this problem. However, NSGA-II has been criticized for its slow convergence speed and low search efficiency. To address these issues, this paper proposes an optimization algorithm that combines automata with NSGA-II. By using automata, the constraints and limitations of the job shop system can be accurately, intuitively described. By using a self-locking algorithm, the generated automata model is screened for better results, which can be the initial population for NSGA-II. Thus, convergence speed and solution quality are improved. The feasibility of the proposed algorithm is verified by simulating the MK04 example in the Brandimarte benchmark dataset.

articleTitle: Research on correction power calculation and preventive measures of superimposed metering fault
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to man-made mistake,a 10 kV high supply and low meter user, the number of turns of the primary side of the three current transformers is changed from 2 turns to 1 turns, and the polarity of the A-phase current transformer is reversed, which forms a superimposed metering fault of metering rate error and wrong wiring, resulting in power metering error. This paper analyzes the curve data of the acquisition system in the three stages before and after the fault treatment, and uses the correction coefficient method and the relative error method to calculate the correction power in the two stages when the fault occurs, and puts forward detailed preventive measures to effectively prevent the risk of wrong measurement.

articleTitle: Compatibility analysis of AeroMACS and RLAN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The AeroMACS (Aeronautical Mobile Airport Communications System) is planned as a new data link to support airport surface applications. It is expected to be implemented in the 5091-5150 MHz frequency band which is adjacent to the radio local area network (RLAN) frequency band. It is essential that the RLAN does not cause harmful interference to, or from the AeroMACS. The objective of this paper is to investigate the compatibility studies between the AeroMACS and the RLAN in the adjacent frequency band, and to propose mitigation measures that include frequency assignment planning, geographical separation and power control as appropriate.

articleTitle: Overview of the Application of SVG in New Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the new power system, the proportion of power electronic devices is gradually increasing. Therefore, it is even more necessary to use SVG reactive power compensation devices reasonably to improve the transmission stability and capacity of the new power system, avoid voltage fluctuations and harm, and ensure low harmonic content, fast response speed, and high reliability in the output of photovoltaic power plants. The article provides a detailed analysis of the working principle and main technical characteristics of the Static Var Generator (SVG). The application of SVG reactive power compensation devices in new power systems can achieve stable, fast, and accurate compensation.

articleTitle: A semi-physical simulation method for underwater gravity measurement based on velocity observation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the improvement of the measurement accuracy of inertial navigation system, the technology research of gravity matching assisted navigation has gradually been applied. Considering that the difficulty of gravity assisted navigation itself lies in the acquisition of prior maps and the measurement of gravity anomaly, and the cost and cycle of the early underwater test are too high, it is not suitable for a large amount of data collection and algorithm improvement and optimization. Therefore, this paper proposes a semi-physical simulation method of underwater gravity measurement based on velocity observation, to verify the feasibility of combined gravity anomaly measurement of new sensor and inertial survey with real ocean data and simulation and external information. In this paper, the trajectory generator based on the measured trajectory, with the laser Doppler meter (LDV) and depth meter replace acoustic Doppler meter (DVL) and GPS height information, finally use the actual sea data for simulation and data analysis, and verify the influence of velocity change and height error on the results. When the velocity error within 0.1m / s and height error within 1m, after the leveling treatment of gravity abnormal discrepancy value changes within 0.1 mGal, so that through the trajectory simulation and add velocity, height error can approximate simulation velocity and depth meter gravity device measurement results, and verify the feasibility of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Reducible Edge Coloring of Points with Distance of 2 in some Associative Graphs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The edges of simple graph G(V, E) are mapped to the set of positive integers {1, 2 … k}, makes the color set of any two points with the same degree whose distance is not greater than positive integer 2 the same, which is called D(2) − Vertex Reducible Edge Coloring, or D(2) − VREC for short. In this paper, a new D(2) − VREC algorithm is designed based on the existing graph coloring concept. The algorithm uses iterative optimization method to solve all non-isomorphic graph sets within finite points. Through the analysis of experimental results, the coloring characteristics of several types of associative graphs are found, and some theorems are summarized and proved.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Multimodal Data Fusion in Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The medical images produced by different medical detection equipment have different image modes, which have their own advantages and disadvantages. In order to improve the accuracy of medical diagnosis and make up for the limitations of single mode in information description, the different modes of the same disease information are fused to build diagnostic models, and the artificial intelligence technology and methods are used to organically combine multimodal medical data for clinical diagnosis and efficacy evaluation, Combining X-ray and CT scanning can improve the accuracy and reliability of the detection and diagnosis of lung diseases, help doctors evaluate the quality of the disease, reduce misdiagnosis and missed diagnosis, and also contribute to the formulation of treatment plans and disease monitoring.

articleTitle: Prediction of Electric Field of Overhead Power Transmission Line Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The electric field poses great influence on the flight safety of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) for power grid patrol inspection. Aiming at prediction of the electric field strength around overhead power transmission lines, a back propagation (BP) neural network model is proposed in this paper. The proposed model consists of 3 input nodes (including the coordinates of a planar point and soft measured electric field at this position), 10 hidden nodes and 1 output node. The results show that the maximum error between the predicted value and the hard measured value is around 5%, making it promising for the proposed model to facilitate the optimization of UAV patrol route planning for transmission line inspection.

articleTitle: Fast Variable Channel Simulation and Parameter Improvement Based on the Sum-of-Cisoids Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of efficient and accurate simulation of fading channels in complex scenarios of wireless channels, this paper proposes an accurate Doppler expansion method based on the simulation method of Sum-of-Cisoids (SoC) to improve the calculation of model parameters, and applies it to common applications, such as classical 3dB, Jakes classic, flat spectrum and Gaussian spectrum. Complex fading channel with arbitrary Doppler power spectrum. The simulation results show that the statistical distribution of channel fading and Doppler power spectrum output from the parameter calculation method based on SOC are consistent with the theoretical values. This method can be applied to real and fast reproduction of the propagation characteristics of wireless fading channels indoors.

articleTitle: Research on The Location of General Information Systerm Equipment Inventory Warehouse Based on Immunooptimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The location of the equipment reserve of the general information system determines the cost and timeliness of logistics transportation, and the factors that have the greatest impact on the location of the warehouse are often the distance of logistics transportation and the cost of transportation. Layout designers often want to obtain the optimal reserve warehouse layout scheme to achieve economic efficiency optimization. The paper uses immunooptimization methods to generate initial schemes from alternative warehouse locations and continuously iteratively optimizes to obtain the best layout scheme. Through case calculation and analysis, the reliability and effectiveness of the immunooptimization algorithm in dealing with the location problem of the combat readiness reserve warehouse of the general information system equipment are verified.

articleTitle: Customer Side Load Measurement and Control Technology Basing Power Consumption Information Monitoring and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the inability to store electricity on a large scale, when the load suddenly increases, there may be a power gap, causing risks such as voltage fluctuations, decreased power quality, and even power supply interruption. To ensure the operation of important loads and ensure the normal functioning of key equipment such as medical, safety, and protection when the power supply is insufficient, this article proposes a precise load regulation technology based on power monitoring and control for the customer side, By intelligently identifying typical critical equipment of customers, the size of important loads in the event of insufficient power supply is determined. Based on electricity information collection technology, power monitoring and control are achieved, effectively limiting the operation of non essential loads without power interruption, achieving precise load regulation and balancing the safety of power grid operation and the necessary electricity needs of customers. This has been proven to have high practical significance and practical value.

articleTitle: Research on Identity Authentication and Vehicle Security Method of Electric Vehicle Charging System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the increasing number of electric vehicles, the charging demand of electric vehicles is also increasing, which poses load challenges to the normal operation of the power grid. Many researchers have studied charging scheduling to address the grid’s load problem. However, most of the current research on charging scheduling uses a centralized system, which cannot fully guarantee the security of the identity of connected vehicles and has potential security risks.This paper proposes a trusted charging system architecture based on the alliance chain using blockchain technology in the traditional vehicular ad hoc network (VANET) authentication framework. Furthermore, by combining the RSA cryptographic accumulator algorithm, the performance of the block is improved to achieve rapid identity authentication and updates. The system is built using Hyperledger Fabric technology and its performance is evaluated through simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Research on knock simulation of dual fuel engine based on two-zone model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Since natural gas is different from the combustion characteristics of diesel and gasoline, gas engines are more likely to knock during operation. This paper aims to establish a relationship model between the knock phenomenon of dual-fuel engines and the operation management parameters, analyze the influence of different operation parameters on the knock phenomenon. The Wärtsilä 6L34DF dual-fuel engine simulation model is established using the two-zone combustion model, the frame data is used for model calibration, and the knock integral model and the knock intensity index (KI) model are combined as indicators for knock phenomenon simulation to analyze the influence of the intake temperature, compression ratio, jet timing and other parameters on engine knock. The results show that the combination of the knock integral model and the KI model can effectively simulate the performance and knock trend of the engine. Engine knock can be avoided by controlling the intake temperature below 338K, the compression ratio not exceeding 14 or the injection timing control at -12.5° ATDC.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Coding Matrix based Detection Strategy of Deception Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a detection strategy based on coding matrix is to cope with various types of deception attack. Deception attack sequences, namely replay attack, false data injection(FDI) attacks on sensors and actuators are designed from the perspective of the attacker. The attacks achieve a significant state estimation error and keep stealthy by maintaining residue signals not to trigger the alarm. Then, a compound coding matrix based detection strategy is designed to detect stealthy attacks by encoding/decoding the data transmitted/received without affecting performance of the normal system. Finally, simulation results are given to prove the effectiveness of the detection strategy.

articleTitle: Adaptive Modulation and Coding for Underwater Acoustic
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive modulation and coding (AMC) scheme is proposed that aims to maximize the energy efficiency of a single link by jointly scheduling the coding rate, modulation order and transmission power. Considering the complexity of UWA channels, a deep neural network (DNN)-based bit-error-rate (BER) estimation method is proposed that allows channel estimation, feature extraction, and BER estimation by using a fixed guide frequency of the feedback link. A channel classification method based on BER for all modulation and coding methods (MCS) is designed, and the UWA channel is further modeled as a finite-state Markov chain (FSMC) with unknown transfer probability. to formulate the AMC problem as a Markov decision process (MDP), and a DDQN method was used to achieve near-optimal energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of Fire Guidance and Rescue System Based on ROS Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to quickly search for disaster victims in a fire and carry out rescue activities while ensuring the safety of rescue personnel, this article designs a fire guidance and rescue system based on ROS platform, with Nano as the core controller, the upper computer as the remote monitoring platform, and multiple sensors. The main function is to use Lidar and apply the Gmapping-Slam algorithm for on-site map information collection. At the same time, a odometer is used to achieve real-time relocation, and a camera is used to transmit on-site images to the upper computer to assist rescue personnel in locating the affected population. Then, based on the marked points on the map, The RRT-Connect algorithm fused with KD-tree is applied for shortest path planning, guiding rescue personnel to achieve short-term rescue. The experiment shows that the system can meet the function of quickly guiding rescue personnel to rescue in case of fire, reduce the time required for rescue, achieve the basic requirement of reducing the possibility of secondary injury to rescue personnel, and meet the expected expectations.

articleTitle: Investigating the PTF Fully-Isolated NTA Space-grade CMOS Image Sensor Pixels
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Space radiation can easily cause damage to the performance of CIS pixel devices, leading to varying degrees of failure in aerospace-grade microelectronic systems and a significant decline in image quality. This article proposes a PTF fully-isolated NTA radiation-hardening technology, which effectively suppresses the dark current generated by radiation-sensitive nodes by isolating the PPD photosensitive N-doped region, TG channel, FD-doped region, and STI edge. The results show that this technology can reduce the dark current growth rate to less than 72% following 50krad(Si) radiation exposure, down from 193%. The dark current growth per unit radiation dose is only 0.28pA•cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>•krad(Si)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, providing a solid theoretical basis and technical support for the development of advanced space-grade CMOS image sensors.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of High Reliability FIFO Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Developed a highly reliable FIFO for real-time Ethernet cards on trains utilizing the FPGA platform. An improved FIFO design scheme has been proposed to address the metastability issues that may arise in systems with multiple clock domains. After the second-level synchronization and gray code conversion operations across clock domains, a triple-mode redundant module is added to solve the data stability problem. Finally, the simulation verification was carried out through the Modelsim simulation platform. The simulation results show that in the case of abnormal data on one channel, the read and write function of the asynchronous FIFO are normal and the empty/full flag signals are correct, proving that the design meets the requirements for high reliability.

articleTitle: Adaptive Dynamic Routing Algorithm for 5G Integrated Networks Based on Virtual Routing Plane
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of the Internet of Things in power, the complexity of business transmission in the network has increased, and traditional routing schemes are difficult to meet the specific needs of sea volume business in 5G scenarios. This article defines the concept of a virtual routing plane for 5G fusion networks from the perspective of differentiated services. Based on the divisible characteristics of the underlying physical network, corresponding virtual routing planes are established based on the needs of different services to transmit different types of services. According to the change of service requirements, the set of virtual routing planes is adjusted. This paper proposes an adaptive Dynamic routing algorithm based on virtual routing planes. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in resource utilization and throughput was verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Effects of Cerebellar Target rTMS on Brain Network Connectivity Strength in the Frontal Lobe During a Working Memory Task
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Transcranial magnetic stimulation is a type of brain intervention technology that has been widely utilized in clinical practice. In recent years, the role of the cerebellum in learning and memory has become one of the hot topics in the field of cognitive neuroscience. In this study, we conducted transcranial magnetic stimulation on the cerebellar region of the participants and instructed them to complete an n-back working memory task before and after the stimulation. The electroencephalogram was recorded and analyzed simultaneously during the experiment. By analyzing the phase locking value network of subjects' electroencephalogram data in different frequency bands during the task state, we discovered significant changes in the brain network connection strength in the frontal lobe after applying repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation at 5Hz and 20Hz to the cerebellum. Specifically, the connection strength was found to be concentrated in the theta and alpha bands. The results of this analysis suggest that the frontal lobe became more active during the working memory task after the cerebellum was stimulated.

articleTitle: CCA Simulation Approach for the Fabrication of Micro Spoke Structures by Wet Etching Process on GaN Substrate
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: GaN, as a representative of single-crystal group III nitride semiconductors, has excellent properties suitable for processing high-power devices, and anisotropic wet etching allows the preparation of complex and precise microstructures on GaN. In this paper, we propose a simulation method based on continuous cellular automata (CCA) to simulate the etching fabrication process of spoke structures on GaN (0 0 0 1) crystallographic plane. The metamerism rate in the CCA simulation is based on the removal rate of different types of atomic groups, which can be obtained from the step flow rate model established in the GaN <0001> crystallographic zone. The interfacial evolution is based on a step-flow mechanism, with the removal of metastable cells based on the change of metastable cell occupation values. The etching process of four spoke structures spaced at 10° from the (1 0 -1 0) crystallographic plane to the (1 1 -2 0) crystallographic plane is simulated under H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>PO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>(85%wt) solution conditions at 140°C. Comparing the results after simulated etching with experiments, the tip retraction length and the sidewall shortening distance show small errors, indicating the validity of the CCA simulation.

articleTitle: Study on the Spatial Distribution and Utilization of Children's Public Service Facilities in Foshan City Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The construction of children's public service facilities is an important part of child-friendly community planning, and the improvement of the richness of such facilities has also become an important indicator of the development of urban infrastructure, and the study of this index will play an important role in the improvement and optimization of urban infrastructure service facilities in the territorial space planning of the city and county level. Based on the perspective of big data, taking Foshan City as an example, we took children's public service facilities, such as schools, parks and libraries as research objects; obtained relevant basic POI data through big data technology, visually expressed and analyzed data by geographic information system software ArcGIS, discussed the spatial distribution and utilization of public service facilities in Foshan, and put forward relevant optimization suggestions and improvement directions based on the research results.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Grey Box Detection Technology Based on Reverse engineering and Dynamic Pollution Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to reduce the security risks of application systems, reduce potential security vulnerabilities in software code writing, and improve the security protection capabilities of the application system itself, we increasingly rely on using source code security scanning tools to help software development teams quickly identify, locate, repair, and manage software code security issues. The main value of applying static source code security scanning lies in fast and accurate search, Identify and fix security risks in the code. However, software manufacturers are unwilling to provide source code, and sometimes the software is in the form of a connection library or written in assembly code. In this case, static analysis techniques for vulnerability mining that require source code cannot be applied. Therefore, this paper proposes a gray box detection technology based on the combination of Reverse engineering and dynamic pollution diffusion, which can obtain similar code and better understand the vulnerability and provide solutions through relocated code. The reverse code relocation of pollution diffusion can generate audit results that can be more intuitively presented to users, enabling them to have a clearer understanding of the principles behind vulnerabilities and take corresponding measures to prevent them, thus achieving the goal of gray box mining for source code vulnerabilities.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power Optimization of Distribution Network with Distributed Generation Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to effectively reduce the active power loss of the distribution network and ensure the safety and economy of the distribution network operation. The traditional genetic algorithm is easy to fall into ‘precocity’, weak local search ability, many iterations and long time consuming. An improved genetic algorithm is proposed, and an improved genetic operator is designed, which makes the algorithm greatly improved in convergence and iteration times, and gives full play to the advantages of genetic algorithm in global fast search. Based on the improved genetic algorithm, this paper studies the distribution network with distributed power supply, and verifies the IEEE33 node. The distribution network’s network loss and node voltage are effectively improved by the improved genetic algorithm. The outcomes demonstrate the algorithm’s excellence and applicability.

articleTitle: A Quality Evaluation Method of UAV Inspection Images Based on Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The widespread application of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in power line inspection has resulted in the collection of a large volume of images. While many researchers focus on utilizing deep learning techniques to process these images, there has been limited research on image quality assessment. Existing studies on UAV inspection images face several challenges, including overexposure, degrading and deviant shooting angles which not capture critical components effectively. To evaluate the quality of inspection images better, firstly we definite 7 common major parts mainly shoot by UAV in power transmission lines: tower base, tower body, tower head, cross-arm, wire connection plate, insulator and wire clamp. Meanwhile, the DeepLabv3+ model is employed for semantic segmentation and utilize Densenet121 as the backbone network. Transfer learning and fine-tuning are employed to enhance the performance of the backbone network. Based on the segmented results, every segmented part is evaluated and the overall evaluation result is derived through the weighted composite calculation of evaluation result of all segmented parts. With the proposed method, the evaluation result is closer to the actual needs, focusing on the power line targets. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in identifying UAV inspection images and this research contributes to the field of image quality assessment in UAV-based power line inspection.

articleTitle: Intelligent Search and Recommendation of Power Grid Based on Data Lineage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the expansion of the power grid scale, the amount of power grid operation data is increasing rapidly. Faced with massive power grid data with complex relationships, how to judge the implicit relationship between data and quickly and accurately query the data required by users is an urgent problem to be solved. This paper proposes a set of intelligent search and personalized recommendation algorithms based on data lineage, uses power grid data to build knowledge graphs, manages data through data lineage analysis, and designs three modules: sentence intent classification, knowledge search matching, and result organization. Realize intelligent search of power grid data, and finally realize personalized recommendation for similar user groups by classifying users. According to the proposed method, this paper designs experiments to verify, and the results show that the proposed method is accurate and efficient, and can well meet the search needs of power grid users.

articleTitle: Research on the Business Interaction Interface of Digital Station Basic Digital Base
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The new power system carries the historical mission of energy transformation and is an important component of a clean, low-carbon, safe and efficient energy system. It has the characteristics of clean, low-carbon, safe and controllable, flexible and efficient, intelligent and friendly, and open interaction. At the same time, with the profound adjustment of the energy landscape, profound changes have been brought to the power structure, load characteristics, power grid morphology, technical foundation, and operational characteristics. The new features and changes of the new power system have put forward a series of new requirements for the digitization of the power grid. This article starts with the construction of a new type of basic digital base for power systems, using digital technology to promote smarter power grids, platform empowerment to promote more efficient operations, business innovation to promote better services, dual carbon layout to promote greener energy, establishment of platform based standard service capabilities, aggregation of all factor data resource pools, and research on digital station basic digital base business interaction interface technology. According to the principle of unified collection, storage, and utilization of power grid information, modeling is based on the SG-CIM model specification to provide standardized data. By unifying basic software and hardware facilities, equipment information models, and application development specifications, a unified data interface for digital station information is formed, achieving device centric panoramic data aggregation and sharing, and visualizing operation and maintenance business. Deeply implementing the new national energy security strategy and building new power system related requirements, the goal of digital construction is to improve equipment management and production control penetration.

articleTitle: Design of body motion control posture robot system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Human motion recognition technology has been widely used in many fields, which has created huge social value and considerable economic value for the society. The current research focuses on how to improve the accuracy and stability of body movement recognition, so that the machine can understand the human movement more quickly, and better meet the needs of people and understand the expression of people. In this paper, Kinect Perceptron is used to track human bone points and obtain bone point data, MFC is used to design a visual interface to complete the establishment of a static limb action database, K-NN algorithm is used to complete the recognition of limb actions, and finally the recognized limb actions are transformed into robot language and transmitted to the posture robot, so that the limb action can control the posture robot, so as to achieve the goal of robots entering dangerous places to work instead of people. The test results show that the system can control the attitude robot accurately in real time.

articleTitle: Research On Superposition Effect Of Unbalance Degree Of 500kV Multi-circuit Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of the new power system, the 500kV main grid structure in various regions has been continuously strengthened, and energy storage resources such as pumped storage power stations will also be connected to the grid one after another. Full transposition, while the line with length less than 50km basically adopts partial transposition or no transposition. With the continuous increase of outgoing lines, the total length of substation outgoing lines may exceed 200km. The unbalance degree of the outgoing lines with a length of less than 50km exceeds the limit, which affects the safe and stable operation of the power grid. Therefore, based on the grid-connected project of a pumped storage power station in a certain area, an electromagnetic transient model is built using PSCDA to simulate and verify the busbar and each outgoing line of a 500kV substation. The effect of unbalance degree is calculated, and the superposition effect of unbalance degree between outgoing lines is calculated and researched. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Network Line Calculation Algorithm Based on Multisource Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The accuracy of distribution network parameters is of great significance for its optimal operation. However, in recent years, the structure of the distribution network has become increasingly complex, and there is a significant error between the distribution network parameters calculated using traditional theories and the actual values. At the same time, there are errors in the actual measurement data, making it difficult to accurately identify its parameter information. To this end, a comprehensive identification of distribution system line parameters is proposed based on the introduction of PMU measurement information into the traditional distribution network parameter estimation topology model, and the construction of a hybrid multi period measurement system based on PMU/SCADA. Firstly, establish a line model for the distribution network, analyze and evaluate the line parameters; Secondly, construct a line parameter identification model based on multi-source measurement data; Finally, an example analysis was used, and the results showed that the proposed method can accurately identify parameters such as line impedance, transformer impedance, and admittance in the distribution network, providing basic support for the safe and reliable operation of the distribution network and subsequent control analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability Analysis of Diodes in Energy Meters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Analyze the common failure mechanisms of electric energy meter diodes and conduct reliability analysis on them. The main Failure cause of diode is the failure caused by the defect of device itself and the failure caused by improper application. The reliability of diodes can be described by long-term Failure rate. Analyzing the characteristics and selection of transient voltage suppressors, summarizing the principles of TVS selection, is conducive to better completing the analysis and selection of energy meter diodes.

articleTitle: Development of a long-cycle data acquisition system based on silicon resonant pressure sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Long-term stability is one of the key performance for high-precision pressure sensors. The aim of this paper is to design a long-cycle test data acquisition system for the silicon resonant pressure sensors to analysis the reasons that affect long-term stability. By analyzing the working principle of the sensor, a high-precision synchronous acquisition of two frequencies is achieved, and a polynomial surface fitting algorithm is used for adaptive compensation of temperature and pressure, and a logic switching chip is used for multi-channel networking. An automatic test platform is setup subsequently, which is based on the C/S architecture developed in C# and uses four listening threads to store the collected data into SQLite and SQL SERVER respectively ensuring lightweight and reliable data storage. By comparing the test data with standard frequency meters and pressure controllers, a high accuracy acquisition of silicon resonant pressure sensors with accuracy of 0.02% FS is achieved, which meets the demand for long-cycle testing of resonant pressure sensors.

articleTitle: Research on Information Integration Technology of Ro-ro Passenger Ships Based on Multi-network Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the coming of the whole island closing operation time of Hainan Free Trade Port, Qiongzhou strait ro-ro passenger transportation will play a vital role in it. In order to better support the upgrading of transportation safety operation capability in strait, this paper first analyzes the main challenges faced by passenger rolling transportation in strait. Secondly, around the key communication transmission problem, a ship-shore networking mode based on multi-network convergence is proposed. Finally, a five-layer information integration framework for ro-ro passenger ship is proposed for the data users related to ro-ro passenger ship transportation, so as to realize the integrated application of ro-ro passenger ship information and provide support and guarantee for better supporting the development of ro-ro passenger transportation in the straits.

articleTitle: Research on SQL Injection Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern information technology, web applications have gradually become important service providers in people's daily work and life. However, while web applications bring convenience, they also face various challenges. Among them, SQL injection attacks, characterized by their diversity, rapid changes and strong concealment, have always been one of the main threats to web applications. Currently, most mainstream SQL injection detection tools on the market are based on established rules and cannot cope with the constantly changing challenges. Therefore, this paper proposes a deep learning-based approach using pretraining and fine-tuning with BERT for SQL statement pretraining. An improved TextCNN algorithm is used as the classification algorithm. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has significant improvements compared to other text vectorization algorithms in terms of detection performance and has certain application prospects.

articleTitle: Research on Measurement Error Analysis and Prevention Strategy of Voltage Out-of-limit of Smart Meter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to voltage losing, wrong wiring, voltage displacement and other reasons, smart meter in operation often occurs voltage out-of-limit, which affects the safety, accuracy and reliability of the operation of electric energy metering devices. Based on two field examples, this paper expounds the voltage out-of-limit caused by equipment failure and wrong wiring, and establishes a mathematical model of voltage out-of-limit, and analyzes the risks of measurement inaccuracy, safety, electricity stealing and power supply service, and puts forward detailed prevention strategy to improve the operation and management level of smart meters and effectively prevent various risks.

articleTitle: Research on Requirement Analysis Method of Space Equipment Technology System based on capability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: "Demand traction and technology promotion" is the main law of equipment system construction and development. Scientific determination and quantitative evaluation of key technologies in the field of military equipment is the key and difficult point of system macro demonstration. Based on the analysis of the technical structure of space information equipment technology, this paper proposes a capability-based requirement analysis framework and process of space information equipment technology system, establishes a requirement analysis model of technology system, and constructs its technical system by taking space situation awareness system as an example. It provides technical basis for the requirement analysis of space information equipment technology system.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Smart Water Meter Monitoring System Based on NB-IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the increasing shortage of water resources and the improvement of environmental awareness, intelligent water meter monitoring systems have become a hot research topic in the field of water conservation. This paper studies and designs a smart water meter system based on NB-IoT, and discusses its effect in practical applications. This smart water meter monitoring system adopts STM8 microcontroller as the main control chip of the water meter, and adopts the low-power NB-IoT module BC28 module to upload the monitored voltage data, network signal quantity, current water consumption and collection time to the TLink cloud platform in real time, which solves the problems of unstable communication in the working environment, high power consumption of long-term sensor collection and transmission data. At the same time, the water meter can achieve the function of remote control of the water valve switch by driving the stepper motor, which perfectly solves the problems and shortcomings of the current traditional water meter and smart water meter, and greatly meets the development needs of the water industry.

articleTitle: Research on Ship Positioning for Spaceborne SAR based on WVD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Spaceborne synthetic aperture radar plays a crucial role in marine target detection due to its ability to image such targets and perform all-time, all-weather surveillance. However, when the ship is moving, the imaging results will be offset in azimuth due to radial velocity. In order to correct the offset and restore the exact position of the ship, a large number of methods were proposed to correct the offset by estimating the radial velocity. In this paper, the idea of using the signal energy center to directly estimate the real azimuth position of the target is adopted, by using the Wigner-Wiley distribution(WVD) as a time-frequency transformation method to process signal from the range gate where the target is located, the energy center of the signal is estimated, resulting in accurate positioning and motion state estimation of the ship. The simulation results show that the proposed method has high estimation accuracy and strong robustness, even if the SNR reaches 14 dB, it can still accurately position ships(error within 50 m). Moreover, it has the potential of iterative calculation to improve the estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of improved adaptive LMS algorithm in GNSS receivers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the field of navigation signal processing, the adaptive LMS filtering algorithm is widely used, but it is always difficult to reconcile the convergence speed and the steady-state error. To solve this problem, the existing LMS adaptive filtering algorithm is improved. This paper introduces the basic principle and limitations of the traditional LMS algorithm, and introduces a function relationship between error and step size for the existing Sigmoid function-based variable step minimum mean square algorithm to further enhance the stability of the algorithm. Simulation results show that the improved adaptive filtering algorithm effectively improves the anti-narrowband interference ability. While maintaining the accuracy of the algorithm, the convergence speed of the algorithm is significantly accelerated. When the white noise is set to -10dB and the CW is set to -20dB, the bit error rate after filtering is reduced by approximately 8%. The improved adaptive LMS filtering algorithm can realize the automatic adjustment of step size, which has strong reference value.

articleTitle: Design of new energy control terminal on generation side of new electrical power system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the security and stability problems such as voltage overlimit, three-phase imbalance and islanding protection in low-voltage distribution network caused by a large number of decentralized access of distributed power sources in the new electrical power system, this paper focuses on the intelligent monitoring and control of operation data and status of generation side equipment based on the hierarchical collaborative comprehensive regulation idea of the new power system. A new energy control terminal is proposed, which integrates multiple composite functions such as intelligent collection of composite information of new energy power station and implementation of regional dispatching strategy. The terminal integrated the generation side cooperative control device and the cooperative software carrying the regional power scheduling algorithm.

articleTitle: UWDepth:Underwater image Depth estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a robust and efficient end-to-end model named UWDepth for fast monocular depth estimation that incorporates underwater domain knowledge into it as a supervised learning pipeline. We employ a new input space RMI for underwater domain-aware learning, including the red channel (R), the maximum of the green and blue channels (M) and the grayscale intensity (I). Since the attenuation constraint of the underwater light pillar (M) depends on the wavelength (M), the relative difference between the R and M channels embeds useful scene depth information in the I channel to preserve the structural content of the image. More importantly, visual results of experimental data show that its coarse pre-representation is quite accurate and can be used for 3D perception of low-cost underwater robots.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of STAR-RIS-assisted NOMA communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the outage probability of a non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) system assisted by a reconfigurable smart surface (STAR-RIS) with simultaneous emission and reflection. Among them, the link between the base station and the user is a non-line-of-sight link, which requires relay communication through STAR-RIS. We assume that the channel is a Rayleigh channel, and derive the closed-form expressions of the outage probability of the reflected and refracted users in the NOMA system. The numerical results show that: 1) the outage probability decreases with the increase of the reflective element of STAR-RIS; 2) the outage probability decreases with the decrease of the deployment range of STAR-RIS; 3) increasing the power allocation factor can effectively reduce the outage probability of users; 4) the average energy efficiency of reflective users is inversely proportional to that of refractive users.

articleTitle: Thermal Power and Energy Storage Flexible Adjustment Demand Calculation Method in High Proportion Renewable Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Tapping the flexible and potential adjustment ability of thermal power + energy storage to adapt to the fluctuation and intermittency of renewable energy has become a necessary condition for the security operation of power systems. In this paper, the increased installed capacity of the thermal power units that do not satisfy the power and electricity balance constraints is solved firstly based on typical load days. Combined with the typical load daily guaranteed power supply requirements on energy storage configuration and system required generation, system power and electricity balance scenarios are analyzed when energy storage is configured and not configured. Next, the installed capacity of the thermal power units that need to be increased when energy storage is not configured is obtained through calculation. And the energy storage configuration capacity is also calculated when it is configured. Then, the capacity benefit index of supporting power supply and the capacity replacement benefit index of supporting power supply is proposed to analyze the capacity utilization efficiency of thermal power units and the utilization efficiency of thermal power units replaced by energy storage. Finally, a provincial power grid is used to verify the effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Management System Based on Work Order
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to implement the requirements for digital transformation and upgrading of customer service, China Telecom Group promoted the network-wide centralization of the 10,000 number system to improve the intensive operation efficiency of the 10,000 number system in 31 provinces . Based on the current pain points of China Telecom customer service work order operation system, this paper proposes a digital intensive work order operation management system to better assist in providing decision-making analysis support. Using artificial intelligence technology to empower 10,000 numbers in each province, the group company will adopt a model of intensive construction and provincial docking, and build a unified digital work order operation management cloud platform, seamlessly docking with the 10,000 number platforms of each province, and further clarify and unify the types of work orders across the network, management principles and processing norms, and comprehensively improve the intelligent service level of 10000 numbers.

articleTitle: Design of greenhouse environment monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Nowdays, most greenhouse planting in our country still relies on manual management with low level of automation, which is not convenient for the accurate control of environmental parameters inside the greenhouse, and is not conducive to the release of labor force and the realization of increased production and income. In recent years, with the popularization of Internet of Things technology and the rapid advancement of agricultural modernization, environmental monitoring systems have been widely used in the field of greenhouses, realizing the precision and automatic adjustment of greenhouses parameters, saving a lot of labor and improving the output of crops. This design uses the Internet of Things technology, based on STM32 microcontroller in the UCOSIII operating system to collect the temperature and humidity environmental parameters of the greenhouse, and through the LAN uploaded to the top computer for remote monitoring. And in automatic mode, the single chip microcomputer through pid algorithm automatic control switch, realize the switch solenoid valve, water pump and other electrical functions. In manual mode, you can adjust the environment parameters as required. Realize the control of two modes and adjust the parameters inside the greenhouse accurately. In addition, the upper computer mounted access database for visitors to view environmental parameter data. Through the combination of soft and hard, the waste of labor is reduced and the environmental parameters of greenhouses are precisely controlled.

articleTitle: Power battery charging device design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a fast charging circuit integrating charge and discharge of power battery is studied. The optimal charging current is set by analyzing the SOC of the power battery, and then the constant current charging is carried out in segments to ensure that the charging curve is close to the optimal charging curve. This method can improve the charging efficiency and reduce the polarization phenomenon of the battery and the generation of gas extraction. Finally, the circuit modeling and simulation analysis were carried out by Simulink. The simulation results show that the expected results are highly similar to the simulated waveform.

articleTitle: Self-reconfiguration Method of an Intelligent Multi-mode Linkage Finger Based on Quantitative Reconstruction of Center Point
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Long-term effective rehabilitation training is crucial for assisting patients with hand function disorders caused by neurological damage to recover and improve their abilities in daily life. Hand rehabilitation exoskeletons are effective rehabilitation aids for hand function, which can assist patients in repetitive rehabilitation training. However, the current single degree-of-freedom hand exoskeleton has a limited range of motion training modes, making it difficult to effectively improve rehabilitation outcomes. Here, we propose a method based on the secondary design of the center point of the link mechanism, to achieve the multi-motion mode design of single degree-of-freedom linkage exoskeleton mechanism. By conducting a loop analysis of the Stephenson-II six-bar linkage, the position of the center point was optimized for the second motion mode of the linkage within the design domain, resulting in the second configuration of the six-bar linkage. The Stephenson-II six-bar linkage exoskeleton mechanism obtained through optimization method can achieve rehabilitation training for two motion modes of the hand. The motion simulation experiment demonstrated that the second motion mode of the link exoskeleton has a high degree of fit with the motion mode of the human hand. The optimization method provides novel insights into the multi-mode self-reconfiguration design of intelligent robots.

articleTitle: Weld Defects Detection by Neural Networks Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Welding technology plays an indispensable role in ship construction, and its maturity has a direct impact on the quality of shipbuilding. The weld seam, being the weakest part of a welded structure, significantly affects the structural strength, service life, and safety reliability of ships. However, the current identification of weld defects in the ship industry relies on manual methods, which are subjective and prone to error. To address this issue, this paper presents a novel approach by collecting weld images from actual ship scenes, preprocessing them to eliminate noise and highlight defect features, and proposing a Transformer-based improved target detection model (T-OBJDETC) to enhance the recognition accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Power image retrieval model based on serial code verification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the principle of coding check, this paper proposes a deep hash method of serial hash coding, serial hash coding network, which is different from traditional hash coding method. In this method, the hash coding network layer structure is designed as a serial mode, and the previous part of the hash code generated by the serial is checked in the process of generating the hash code, so as to make full use of the relevance and redundancy of the encoding to generate the hash code with more information, more compact and stronger discrimination. mAP is used as the evaluation criterion for retrieval performance, and the proposed method is compared with the current mainstream hash method. The experimental results show that the method has good effectiveness.

articleTitle: AXIM: A Programmable Simulation Environment for FPGA Kernels with AXI Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the recent decade, the development of FPGA kernels raises its level of abstraction from RTL to HLS C or OpenCL. And so are the simulation and debugging software suites. However, it makes some existing high-quality RTL simulators incompatible to use. Therefore, we propose AXIM, a programmable simulation environment that integrates existing RTL simulators for FPGA kernels with interfaces at a high-level abstraction via AXI buses. AXIM consists three modules, including AXIM hardware driver, AXIM runtime library, and AXIM debugger. Experimental results show that AXIM runs faster than the one integrated with Xilinx Vitis. Besides, another experiment demonstrates that visualization analysis of DRAM's activities generated by AXIM can help developers optimize the design of kernels. As a side product, we also identify an inconsistent behavior in hardware emulation in Xilinx Vitis 2019.2 about data transfer using AXI interfaces.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Fluctuation Pressure Analysis Software for Running Perforated String in Oil and Gas Wells
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the structure of the tubing transmission perforating string, this paper applies analytical solution calculation methods to simulate and calculate the fluctuation pressure changes during the lowering process of the string, analyzes the fluctuation pressure generated during the lowering process of the string, obtains the fluctuation pressure changes of the ignition head during the lowering process of the string, provides a theoretical calculation method to avoid the accidental explosion of the ignition head due to the fluctuation pressure during the lowering process, and develops corresponding analysis software based on the analysis and calculation methods, The average error of this software is 3.4% after comparing the theoretical calculation and measured results for six wells. This software provides a practical theoretical calculation software for the safe lowering of tubing strings in oil and gas wells.

articleTitle: Pricing Strategies for Online Video Platforms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As network technology advances and online video platforms become increasingly popular, subscription-based pricing has become the dominant pricing model for such platforms. This article explores the dynamic investment and pricing strategies for online video platforms utilizing the subscription-based pricing model. An optimal control model is developed, taking into account the perishability of platform resources. Through the application of the maximum principle to solve the optimal control model, the most effective dynamic investment and pricing strategies are obtained. It is observed that during the final stage of platform development, investment rapidly decreases to zero, and the platform scales down accordingly.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Vulnerability Detection Technology for Power Grid Intelligent Terminal Protocol Based on High Order Attribute Grammar
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the advancement of the smart grid, various terminal devices such as smart meters, intelligent distribution terminals, and collection concentrators are widely used, providing remote measurement and control, mobile operations, and customer service, and have become an important component of the smart grid. The IoT terminals in the power grid are characterized by intelligence, networking, and interactivity, and are often deployed in uncontrolled environments. There are security risks such as physical protection being difficult to ensure, real-time interactive control instructions being tampered with, and insufficient attack monitoring methods, which pose a huge challenge to the security of the power grid. Based on the context semantic relationship of the Internet of Things terminal protocol in power grid, this paper proposes to design a terminal protocol Parse tree based on higher-order attribute grammar. Through the association analysis of the context semantics and node variation, and according to the terminal message interaction response, the in-depth mining of protocol vulnerabilities is realized, which effectively overcomes the problems of low protocol vulnerability coverage and vulnerability mining efficiency of the traditional vulnerability mining technology that does not consider semantics. This technology can effectively detect and block in a timely manner, avoiding attackers from implementing network attacks on the smart grid by controlling power IoT terminals, leading to grid security incidents.

articleTitle: ERT image reconstruction based on spatial adaptive hybrid regularization-Newton algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the pathology problem of electrical resistance tomography (ERT) in the inverse problem and improve the quality of the reconstruction image, on the basis of the comparative study of Tikhonov regularization and onestep Newtonian method (NOSER), the two algorithms are fused, and the conductivity and regularization matrix are corrected at the same time, a spatial adaptive hybrid regularization-Newtonian algorithm is proposed, which effectively improves the pathology of the inverse problem, improves the resolution of the target object, and can effectively improve the imaging quality. Experimental results show that the algorithm is feasible for image reconstruction of ERT inverse problem, and can effectively improve the shortcomings of the algorithm in terms of pathology, artifacts, and image resolution.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Solving Tripping and Closing Faults of Three Phase Intelligent Energy Meters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the tripping and closing fault of Three phase intelligent energy meter, and puts forward the fault solution. Analyze the principle and faults of the coil drive circuit, and propose an optimized and improved H-bridge drive circuit in the form of a pair of transistors to reduce the phenomenon of excessive power consumption. Simulate and test the coil drive circuit to eliminate any tripping and closing faults one by one. Complete simulation testing of transient voltage suppressors and add bidirectional TVS for coil protection. The analysis of tripping and closing fault of Three-phase electric power lays the foundation for more optimal design of intelligent electric energy meter circuit.

articleTitle: Power Balance Warning Method of Regional Power Grid Considering Photovoltaic Capacity Ratio
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Power balance is the key to the security of power system operation. It is a great challenge for the high proportion of renewable energy power systems in the future. The increasing capacity ratio of photovoltaic power station construction and the change of photovoltaic station output power leads to the problems of obstructed renewable energy consumption and increased risk of power balance. In this paper, the capacity ratio of photovoltaic development in the future is considered. Then, the probability of satisfying the simultaneity rate constraint is analyzed and solved based on the historical operation data. The warning index of the transmission line transmission power between the regional power grids is proposed. The early warning of the regional power grid structure and power balance caused by future load or renewable energy development is given. The capacity ratio of photovoltaic development is analyzed based on the simultaneity rate deviation index. Finally, a provincial regional power grid is used to verify the effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed method, which is conducive to improving the accuracy of power balance analysis when the installed photovoltaic capacity of the regional power grid increases.

articleTitle: A Improved Spatial-Reduction Attention Transformer for Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Among various medical segmentation network models, due to the limitation of traditional CNN convolutional operations, it does not learn the dependencies of contextual features well, while Transformer is designed with sequence-to-sequence prediction, which can learn the dependencies of global features and information interactions at a distance well. In this paper, we propose a network model that combines the advantages of both Transformer and U-Net, and the Spatial-Reduction Attention mechanism is used to replace the traditional Multi-Head-Attention mechanism for high-resolution features. On the one hand, the Transformer performs image serialization encoding of the features extracted by the convolutional neural network as the input sequence of the global context. On the other hand, the Decoder performs upsampling reduction and then performs feature map fusion using jump layers for accurate segmentation. The model was evaluated on the 2017 public liver tumor segmentation dataset. The experimental results show that the model in this paper outperforms traditional image segmentation models such as FCN, V-Net and U-Net on the tumor segmentation task, with image segmentation evaluation metrics mean_dice reaching 94.26 and mean_hd95 reaching 19.59, and achieves good performance on other medical image segmentation tasks as well.

articleTitle: Research on Facial Expression Recognition Based on Improved VGGNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on VGGNet for facial expression recognition, this paper compares the training test results of three different structures of VGNet16-C, VGGNet16-D, VGGNet19 on FER2013 face expression data set, among which the highest accuracy (68.475%) of expression VGGNet16-D network model for performance improvement. In order to promote network training to prevent over-fitting and enhance the generalization capability, this paper uses the optimized policy of batch normalization strategy, cross-entropy loss function, stochastic inactive, and data entry enhancement to scale up the network model accuracy toward expression recognition by 3.909%, and 1.223% higher than the champion preferable mode in ICML2013. In this paper, the performance improvement method of VGGNet-D facial expression recognition with joint optimization strategy is effective.

articleTitle: Bus Communication Interruption Leads To Low EH Oil Pressure Shutdown Event
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Bus communication is widely used in power system, but field personnel are not familiar with the principle of bus communication and network topology. EH oil pumps on side A and side B of a company's device are distributed in the same bus link. During the operation of the unit, due to the operation timeout, the link photoelectric converter fails, resulting in the fault of the field bus from the safety section to DCS. Because the motor controller of EH oil pump does not have the function of communication interruption self-retention, the A-side EH oil pump trips. B side EH oil pump and A side EH oil pump are located in the same link. After communication interruption, the motor controller of EH oil pump at B side could not receive DCS instruction, and the joint start of EH oil pump at B side failed, which eventually led to the EH oil pressure low stop.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Power Business Data Service Based on Indicator Simplification and Weights Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Power business data services explore the potential value of power data by analyzing and mining power big data to assist in the development of new power systems and smart grids. This paper looks into the potential of power data by exploring power business data services. To evaluate the service, we consider four aspects: service benefit, data quality, service quality, and data service performance. The DEMATEL-ISM method is used to simplify the indicator system. Additionally, the DEMATEL method is combined with the AHP and coefficient of variation methods to form a subjective-objective combination of weighting methods for determining the weights of the indicators. This method addresses the lack of objectivity in the weights caused by the interaction between indicators and the overlap of meanings. The proposed method is validated through examples to show its feasibility and validity.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of ARIMAX and BP Neural Network Models in the Prediction of Spodoptera Frugiperda Occurrence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This study compares the performance of the ARIMAX (Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average model-X) and BP (Backpropagation) neural network models in predicting the quantity of Spodoptera Frugiperda in grassland. The Spodoptera Frugiperda is a crop pest that causes significant losses in agricultural production. Accurately predicting its quantity is crucial for implementing appropriate prevention and control measures. We collected quantity data of Spodoptera frugiperda from 2021 to 2022 in grassland and extracted several exogenous variables that might influence its quantity, such as temperature, humidity, and precipitation. Firstly, we employed the ARIMAX model for prediction, which combines autoregressive, moving average, and integrated methods, while also incorporating the adjustment of the quantity using exogenous variables. Next, we utilized the BP neural network model, which employs the backpropagation algorithm to learn and train the network, in order to capture the nonlinear relationships within the data. By comparing the performance of the two models in quantity prediction, we found that the ARIMAX model demonstrates outstanding performance in short-term forecasting. It accurately captures the trends and periodic variations in quantity. The research findings can provide a scientific basis for pest control in agricultural production and serve as a reference for further improvement of prediction models.

articleTitle: Design and practice of information technology empowerment based on multi-objective relationship model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The construction of the multi-objective information technology empowerment relational model is based on the practical experience of the Research College of China Academy of Railway Sciences. The four main participants of the empowerment activities are the organizer, the client, the enabler and the empowered. Through the analysis of key activities such as demand research, information technology empowerment design, enabler organization and effect evaluation, six basic relationships between the enabler and the empowered, the enabler and the organizer, the t enabler and the client, the empowered and the organizer, the empowered and the client are formed. Based on the model, the evaluation index system of empowerment activities is designed. This paper takes the empowerment of X Railway Bureau Group Co., Ltd.as an example for analysis and verification. The results show that the construction of the model provides an implementation path for the standardization and specialization of empowerment activities, and also provides a reference basis for research and organization of information technology empowerment activities.

articleTitle: Physical Layer Identification for Wireless Local Access in the Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this article, a secure technology for authenticating communication access within a private wireless network is presented. The device is identified through physical radio frequency fingerprint authentication at the physical layer which enhances the security of device access.
