Furthermore, the concept of distributed authentication is employed to ease the device authentication burden on the core network side and enhance the speed of access device authentication.

articleTitle: Optimization Method of Guide Roller Manufacturing Resources Set for Cloud Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty in selecting the optimal manufacturing resources set during the collaborative manufacturing process of guide roller, this paper proposed an optimization method of guide roller manufacturing resources set. Firstly, this paper determined the manufacturing resources of guide rollers, and established an ontology-model of guide roller manufacturing resource according to the analysis of the guide roller manufacturing. Secondly, the improved K-means clustering algorithm is used to cluster the manufacturing resources of guide roller. Then, the extension comprehensive evaluation method was used to evaluate the manufacturing resources of the cluster center to obtain the optimal manufacturing resources set. Finally, the experimental using guide roller manufacturing data verifies the effectiveness and feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Structural Design and Simulation Calculation of Air Traffic Control Radar Radome
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Wind load and snow load are one of the main control loads that affect the air traffic control radar radome. This article first introduces the structure of the air traffic control radar radome, and then uses finite element software to simulate and calculate the two working conditions of the radome under wind and snow loads. The maximum stress and stability coefficient of the air traffic control radar radome are calculated. The analysis results show that the maximum stress of the air traffic control radar radome is less than the ultimate strength, and the stability coefficient meets the requirements. This structure can meet the requirements of engineering applications.

articleTitle: Multibody Dynamics Modeling and Experimental Study of Kink Resistance of CTO Guidewires
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The kink resistance test method and mechanical analysis of coronary chronic total occlusion (CTO) guidewires are important techniques to improve the performance of guidewire design. In order to test the mechanical properties of guidewires and verify the theoretical method of multi-body kinetic model, this paper proposes a set of kink resistance test equipment based on modular design. This paper firstly designs the kink resistance test equipment according to the kink resistance performance index of the guidewire, and then uses the equipment to test the kink resistance of various types of guidewires, and finally establishes a multi-body kinetic model for the kink resistance of the guidewire, and verifies the feasibility of the guidewire model by comparing the experimental data with the simulation data. The experimental results show that the kink resistance of different types of guidewires under different working conditions is different.

articleTitle: Visible and Infrared Light Image Fusion Method Based on Adaptive Gaussian Filtering and NSST
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Visible and infrared light image fusion under multi-scale fusion rules generally suffers from blurred edges, unclear contrast, and loss of detailed information. This paper proposes a visible and infrared light image fusion method based on the combination of an adaptive Gaussian filter and a Non-Subsampled Shearlet Transform(NSST) with gradient value change. The method dynamically adjusts the scale of Gaussian filtering by calculating the gradient to maximize the retention of edge information based on ensuring the denoising ability. Combining it with NSST makes the final fused image have rich background information while retaining more edge information. The experimental results indicate that compared with other fusion algorithms, the algorithm in this paper has different magnitudes of improvement in several objective evaluations such as information entropy, average gradient, and spatial frequency.

articleTitle: The 2 GHz to 5 GHz GaAs Down Conversion Multi-Function Chip
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A down conversion multi-function chip with GaAs pHEMT technology is presented in the paper. The whole chip contains a switch, a low noise amplifier (LNA), an attenuator and a down conversion mixer. The input RF frequency and the LO frequency are from 2 GHz to 5 GHz. The maximum gain of the whole circuit is about 17 dB. The noise figure is below 1.5 dB, and the RF input return loss、the LO input return loss are below -10 dB, which demonstrate a good performance. The whole chip works at a supply voltage of ±5 V with a power consumption of less than 450 mW.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of the Data Information Processing Model on the Impact of Sensation Seeking Personality Traits on Middle School Students' Mobile Phone Addiction Behavior
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The use of mobile phones is widespread and universal. Middle school students are in the adolescence stage, and due to a lack of good self-control, they are more likely to develop mobile phone addiction behavior, which can have adverse effects on their physical and mental health. Therefore, studying the mechanism of mobile phone addiction is of great significance. This study used a questionnaire survey method to investigate 312 middle school students. The data were subjected to differential testing, descriptive statistics, and correlation analysis using Spss 26.0. Finally, regression analysis was used to test the moderating effect of parent-child communication problems and bad peer relationships between sensation seeking and mobile phone addiction. The research results show that: (1) Sensation seeking personality traits can significantly predict mobile phone addiction behavior; (2) In the impact of sensation seeking on mobile phone addiction behavior, parent-child communication problems and bad peer relationships play a moderating role. The results of this study can provide a theoretical basis for preventing and intervening in adolescent mobile phone addiction, thereby better promoting the physical and mental health development of middle school students.

articleTitle: A sample and strong method for image cloud removal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Optical remote sensing imagery is at the core of many Earth observation activities. The regular, consistent and global-scale nature of the satellite data is exploited in many applications, such as cropland monitoring, climate change assessment, land-cover and land-use classification, and disaster assessment. However, optical remote sensing system are often affected by clouds during the acquisition process, resulting in low clarity of the acquired images, which affects the judgment of feature information and subsequent use, and thick cloud occlusion causes the surface information below to be completely invalid. We propose a spatial attention recurrent neural module based on an encoder-decoder network, which can solve the cloud occlusion problem. Furthermore, contexture transformer network is proposed by composed contexture extractor and correlation embedding to consider the relationship of remote dependencies in the network, and our network achieves good results on the RICE1 and RICE2 datasets.
